title: UMH Sparrow - REMOTE INPATIENT CODER
description:
Job Opportunity

Job ID: 56100

Positions Location: Lansing, MI Job Description General Purpose of Job: Advanced

Description:

Positions Location: Lansing, MI

Job Description

General Purpose of Job:

Advanced coding position that requires review of medical record documentation and accurately assigns ICD-10-CM, ICD-10 PCS, as well as assignment of the Medicare Severity Diagnosis Related Group, (MS-DRG) / All Patient Refined - Diagnosis Related Group, (APR-DRG) based on payor classification and abstracts specific data elements for each case in compliance with federal regulations. This position codes all types of inpatient records and follows the Official Guidelines of Coding and Reporting, the American Health Information Management Association, (AHIMA) Coding Ethics, as well as all American Hospital Association, (AHA) Coding Clinics, CMS directives and bulletins, Fiscal intermediary communications. Utilizes Optum CAC in accordance with established workflow. Follows University of Michigan Medicine – Sparrow policies and procedures and maintains required quality and productivity standards.

Essential Duties:

This job description is intended to cover the minimum essential duties assigned on a regular basis. Associates may be asked to perform additional duties as assigned by their leader. Leadership has the right to alter or modify the duties of the position.

  • Extracts, reviews, and analyzes clinical information, identifies and abstracts all pertinent information and translates data into appropriate codes for hospital billing, POA and PSI indicators, research, statistics, financial planning, compliance and marketing to ensure completeness, accuracy and compliance with established guidelines of all governmental regulatory agencies and third-party payers.
  • Reviews medical record documentation and accurately assigns appropriate ICD-10 diagnoses and procedure codes, leading to the assignment of the correct Medicare Severity-Diagnosis Related Group, (MS-DRG) or All Patient Refined Diagnosis Related Group, (APR-DRG.)
  • The Inpatient Coding Specialist is responsible for verification of the patient's discharge disposition and to ensure the appropriate present on admission (POA) indicators are assigned to each code. The assigned codes must support the reason for the visit that is documented by the provider to support the care provided.
  • Correctly abstracts required data per facility specifications.
  • Exercises independent judgment in determining case complexity by utilizing clinical knowledge to understand the etiology, pathology, signs, symptoms, diagnostic studies, treatment modalities and prognosis of diseases and procedures to be coded. Researches complex diagnoses and/or procedures as needed to enhance coding knowledge to consistently apply the correct ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes.
  • Captures the correct principal diagnosis, co-existing conditions, and principal procedure for each inpatient admission. Works in collaboration with CDI team to consult with the providers to clarify or improve documentation for correct coding assignment to ensure correct data reporting and reimbursement and to maintain compliance with Federal and State regulations.
  • Responsible for sequencing codes that capture accurate Severity of Illness/Risk of Mortality.
  • Interacts closely with the Clinical Documentation Specialists and DRG Compliance Auditors to query the medical staff appropriately and professionally to obtain accurate documentation necessary to ensure coding compliance and accuracy.
  • Expands job-related knowledge and skills by attending and participating in in-services and staff meetings. Keeps abreast of coding guidelines and quarterly AHA Coding Clinic.
  • Attends required system, hospital and departmental meetings and educational sessions as established by leadership, and completes required annual learning programs, to ensure continued education and growth.
  • Responsible for ensuring accuracy and maintaining established quality and productivity standards, as well as key performance indicators.

Job Requirements

General Requirements • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Registered Health Information Management Technician (RHIT) or Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA). • Member of the AHIMA or AAPC in good standing (i.e., has paid dues and completed required continuing education)
Work Experience • Minimum one (1) year recent facility coding experience. • Per diem candidates must have minimum three (3) years of recent inpatient coding experience
Education • High School Diploma/GED • Associate Degree in Health Information Technology/Management - preferred.
Specialized Knowledge and Skills • Must pass departmental testing as follows: • Coding – 80% or better • Experience in a major academic medical center and ICD-10-CM/PCS - preferred. • Microsoft Office skill and experience (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) - preferred. • Excellent computer skills and previous experience with computer-assisted-coding and encoder/grouper - preferred.

University of Michigan Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status.

title: Cost Intelligence & AI Analytics Professional
description:
Job Summary
Role Description: Capital Projects Data Analyst
Function: Capital Projects Data Analyst
Location: Hyderabad, India
Reporting To: Cost Estimating Lead - Global Project Services
Purpose of the Role
This role is responsible for transforming historical capital project cost data-organized by Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)-into actionable insights using AI data mining techniques and advanced analytics. The primary objective is to support network facility planning and estimating by delivering dynamic cost metrics (e. g. , cost per square foot, installation factors vs equipment cost, indirect percentages) tailored to user requirements. The role will also require support for future initiatives as necessary within the Technical Services group.
In addition, the role strengthens the Capital Governance process - which provides structure, oversight, and accountability in how Global Technical Services evaluates, approves, funds, and monitors capital investments - by supplying the performance data, analytics, and Key Performance Indicators that enable Stage Gate reviews, annual CapEx portfolio planning, and executive visibility into project cost, scope, and schedule performance.


Key Responsibilities
  • Data Mining Structuring: Source and organize historical capital project cost data segmented by WBS.
  • Data Mining Structuring: Clean, normalize, and structure data for analysis using AI tools.
  • Data Mining Structuring: Ensure data is enriched with relevant metadata (e. g. , facility type, room classification, benchmark category).
  • Data Mining Structuring: Design and maintain scalable data pipelines using SQL and modern data platforms (e. g. , Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake) to consolidate multi-source project data into a unified, query-ready repository.
  • Data Mining Structuring: Centralize scattered and legacy project cost data from disparate files and systems into a governed, single source of truth (e. g. , unified SharePoint/data platform repository), eliminating manual tracking.
  • AI-Driven Analysis: Apply machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) to extract patterns, trends, and anomalies from cost data.
  • AI-Driven Analysis: Develop models to benchmark costs across facility types (e. g. , API, fill-finish, QC labs) and scope categories.
  • AI-Driven Analysis: Leverage AI-powered assistants and agents (e. g. , Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, retrieval-augmented generation) to accelerate document intelligence, automate extraction of cost data from unstructured sources (e. g. , PDFs, contracts, change orders), and improve estimating productivity.
  • AI-Driven Analysis: Apply predictive and forecasting techniques to improve the accuracy of cost projections and support variance and root-cause analysis for significant deviations.
  • Metric Development Reporting: Generate cost metrics such as cost per square foot, cost per unit, and other KPIs based on user queries.
  • Metric Development Reporting: Build interactive dashboards and visual tools for internal stakeholders using Power BI.
  • Metric Development Reporting: Develop robust semantic models, DAX measures, and optimized datasets (including RLS/OLS security where required) to ensure dashboards are performant, governed, and scalable across the organization.
  • Metric Development Reporting: Develop and manage performance data, analytics, and KPIs related to capital portfolio and CapEx performance (cost, schedule, quality), supporting Stage Gate governance reviews, capital projection cycles, and executive reporting.
  • User Interaction Customization: Collaborate with other Global Technical Services team members to understand data needs.
  • User Interaction Customization: Translate ad hoc user requests into tailored cost analyses and reports using AI tools.
  • User Interaction Customization: Enable self-service capabilities for project teams to access cost benchmarks and trends.
  • User Interaction Customization: Lead requirements gathering and stakeholder engagement across time zones, translating business questions from Cost Estimating, Capital Governance, Finance, and Site Engineering stakeholders into clear analytical deliverables communicated in a concise, actionable manner.
  • Tool System Integration: Integrate AI tools with existing project management and cost estimating platforms.
  • Tool System Integration: Automate data ingestion and metric updates to ensure real-time relevance.
  • Tool System Integration: Automate recurring data capture, refresh, and reporting workflows using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and scripting (Python/SQL), reducing manual effort and turnaround time.
  • Tool System Integration: Support integration of workflows, approvals, and documentation into capital project lifecycle platforms, maintaining data quality so information can be leveraged for reporting and decision-making.
  • Data Governance Quality: Apply data governance practices - data quality checks, documentation, access control, and stewardship - to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of capital project data assets.
  • Data Governance Quality: Support knowledge management by helping capture benchmarks, lessons learned, and best practices in a central repository so they can be reused to improve future project outcomes.
  • Data Governance Quality: Handle confidential, strategic, and sensitive capital investment information with discretion and in compliance with organizational policies on data integrity and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Support for Other Initiatives: The role will also require supporting future initiatives as necessary within the Global Technical Services group.
  • Support for Other Initiatives: Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in AI, analytics, and digital operations; identify and implement innovative solutions and continuous-improvement opportunities in analytics and reporting workflows.


Qualifications Experience
  • Bachelor s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field; master s degree preferred.
  • 5-10+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data engineering roles, preferably supporting capital projects, engineering, construction, infrastructure, or cost management functions; pharmaceutical or other regulated-industry experience is a plus.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Power BI - including semantic/data modeling, DAX optimization, Power Query, RLS/OLS security, and deployment pipelines - with a portfolio of enterprise-grade dashboards delivered to senior stakeholders.
  • Strong hands-on skills in the Microsoft ecosystem: Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio)

EY is the only professional services firm with a separate business unit ( FSO ) that is dedicated to the financial services marketplace. Our FSO teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!
The opportunity
The Structured Finance Team specializes in addressing varying needs of market participants in the securitization marketplace across asset classes, including asset- backed securities (ABS), commercial mortgage- backed securities (CMBS), residential mortgage- backed securities (RMBS) and collateralized loan obligations (CLO). The securitization market is a dynamic marketplace, continuously evolving with new regulations and technological advances every day. This a great opportunity to work in this fast-paced transaction business, support diverse engagement teams, work with a wide variety of clients and lead business development activities on strategic and global priority accounts.
Your Key Responsibilities
The primary role of the SFT transaction team is to perform agreed-upon procedures (AUP) to help clients execute securitization transactions successfully.
  • Checking the accuracy of our financial models by comparing calculations to the governing documents
  • Creating cashflow/analytics models for securitized products, including but not limited to CDOs/CLOs (Collateralized Debt Obligations/Collateralized Loan Obligations)
  • Transaction modeling and analytics, which involves cash flow modeling, recalculating certain collateral quality and concentration limitations set out in each transaction s indenture, including bond principal and interest payments, credit-enhancement, hedging instruments, fees and waterfalls for structured deals
  • Construct independent cash flow and collateral models for various structured products utilizing Microsoft Excel
  • Create and update detailed agreed upon procedure reports summarizing our results
  • Comprehensive and methodical interpretation of prospectus/indenture information and deal structural features including but not limited to collateral, waterfall, triggers, hedges, paydown rules, loss allocation rules, and the ability to extract other pertinent information from prospectuses and indentures
  • Perform various analyses on complex excel and third party models (Like Bloomberg, various Rating Agency Portal, Markit etc.) for the valuation of Structured Products
  • Establish relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels. Consistently deliver quality client services. Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes
  • Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Remain current on new developments in advisory services capabilities and industry knowledge.

Skills and attributes for success
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and commitment to high-quality client deliverables.
  • Ability to interpret complex financial and legal documentation and connect document terms to structured data.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including concise issue articulation and client-ready reporting.
  • Collaborative mindset, professional integrity and confidence working with global stakeholders.
  • Curiosity and learning agility, including interest in understanding where AI and automation may add value while professional judgment remains decisive.
  • Awareness of AI limitations, source traceability, confidentiality and responsible-use principles. development goals.
To qualify for the role, you must have
  • A bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline and approximately 2 years of related work experience; MBA or equivalent preferred
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, including data reconciliation, formulas and structured analysis.
  • Awareness of generative AI, machine learning or intelligent automation concepts, including their potential applications, limitations and responsible use.
  • Exposure to data, automation or emerging technology tools is desirable. Examples may include advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI, Python, SQL, workflow automation or approved AI assistants.
  • Strong prioritization skills and flexibility to support client deadlines and role-based shifts when required.
Ideally, you ll also have
  • Prior structured finance, securitization, commercial real estate lending or transaction due-diligence experience.

  • Exposure to, or interest in learning about, AI, document extraction, anomaly detection, reconciliation, QA or workflow-automation solutions.

Successful candidates will embrace continuous learning, use technology thoughtfully and translate complex findings into clear actions for clients and engagement teams

From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants.   • Plan and execute purple-team exercises and collaborative adversary-emulation activities with defensive teams and authorized testing stakeholders.
  • Use MITRE CALDERA, VECTR, and other breach-and-attack simulation tools to safely emulate relevant adversary behaviors, track test scenarios, record defensive outcomes, and validate detection and response controls.

• Practical experience using MITRE CALDERA, VECTR, and other breach-and-attack simulation or adversary-emulation tools for test execution, collaboration, evidence capture, and remediation tracking.

description:
Techniek, vrijheid en intellectuele uitdaging. Elke dag opnieuw.


Ben jij een gedreven engineer die pas écht voldoening haalt uit het kraken van complexe technische noten? Werk je het liefst lekker zelfstandig, geniet je van de vrijheid om direct vanaf huis op pad te gaan en wil je dagelijks werken met de allernieuwste technologieën?


Dan is dit de perfecte plek om jouw technische expertise naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Wij bieden je een uitdagende omgeving waarin je jezelf elke dag weer kunt bewijzen.

Je komt te werken bij een internationale marktleider in de wereld van intern transport en intralogistiek. Innovatie, topkwaliteit en jouw professionele groei vormen de basis van ons succes. Als onderdeel van ons team krijg je de kans om met hypermoderne systemen te werken, waarbij je kunt rekenen op alle ondersteuning die nodig is om zelfstandig en daadkrachtig het verschil te maken voor klanten in jouw eigen regio.


Functie omschrijving


Als Service Engineer ben jij de onmisbare schakel in het draaiende houden van geavanceerde interne transportmachines bij onze klanten. Geen dag is hetzelfde: de ene keer duik je in een complexe elektronische storing, de volgende keer pak je een mechanische of hydraulische uitdaging aan. Met jouw technische expertise zorg je ervoor dat installaties altijd in topconditie blijven.


Dit ga je doen:


  • Onderhoud op maat: Je voert preventief en curatief onderhoud uit om de machines in topvorm te houden.
  • Probleemoplosser: Met jouw laptop en moderne diagnoseapparatuur spoor je storingen razendsnel op.
  • Allround technicus: Je repareert mechanische, elektrische, elektronische en hydraulische componenten alsof het niets is.
  • Duurzame oplossingen: Je stelt niet alleen diagnoses, maar bedenkt ook slimme, langdurige technische oplossingen.
  • Regie in eigen hand: Je plant en voert je interventies zelfstandig uit in jouw eigen regio.
  • Klantgericht: Je adviseert klanten proactief en levert de topservice waar ze op rekenen.


Je werkt zelfstandig op de weg, maar je staat er nooit alleen voor. Je kunt altijd rekenen op de volledige support van ons ervaren technisch team. Klaar om aan de slag te gaan?


Wat er van je verwacht wordt


Ben jij een echte doorzetter die technisch gepuzzel niet ziet als een blok aan het been, maar als een toffe uitdaging? Werk je bovendien het liefst zelfstandig en houd je ervan om het heft in eigen handen te nemen? Dan ben jij precies wie we zoeken!


Wat breng je zoal mee naar de werkplaats?


  • Een technisch diploma op zak (A2 of bachelor).
  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als onderhouds-, service- of storingstechnieker: jij hebt je strepen dus al verdiend.
  • Een dijk van een kennis op het gebied van mechanica, elektriciteit, elektronica én hydraulica.
  • Een gezonde dosis nieuwsgierigheid naar moderne technologie en slimme diagnosemethodes.
  • Heb je ook nog kaas gegeten van thermische systemen? Dan heb je bij ons een streepje voor!
  • Een klantgerichte houding: jij lost problemen op met een glimlach en stopt niet voordat alles weer draait als een zonnetje.


Wat je mag verwachten


Welkom bij een internationale klepper die al jarenlang de toon zet in de wereld van intern transport en intralogistiek. Omdat wij geloven dat jij het verschil maakt, investeren we continu in jouw groei, opleiding en de allernieuwste technologieën. Hier sta je nooit stil, behalve als je dat zelf wilt.


Wat mag je verwachten?


  • Een uitstekend salaris: Een bruto uurloon vanaf €20, uiteraard afgestemd op jouw ervaring.
  • Flexibiliteit op de weg: Een compleet uitgeruste servicewagen die je ook privé mag gebruiken.
  • Slimme uren: Je werkdag start zodra je thuis vertrekt. Werk je 40 uur? Dan betaal je slechts 37,5 uur, want de extra 2,5 uur zijn bij ons gewoon betaalde rijtijd.
  • Goede balans: Overuren zijn bij ons eerder uitzondering dan regel. Bovendien kies je zelf je starttijd tussen 06.00 en 09.00 uur.
  • Royaal verlof: Geniet van maar liefst 20 wettelijke vakantiedagen, 10 feestdagen en 13 extra ADV-dagen.
  • Extra's: Een dagvergoeding, bonusregeling, groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering.
  • Jouw ontwikkeling: Topmateriaal en professioneel gereedschap liggen voor je klaar. Wil je uitblinken in batterijtechnologie? Dan krijg je van ons drie gespecialiseerde interne opleidingen cadeau.


Waarom juist hier aan de slag?


Je wordt onderdeel van een financiële marktleider die innovatie ademt. Je komt terecht in een hecht team van meer dan 75 ervaren Service Engineers die dagelijks voor elkaar klaarstaan. Wij bieden je geen tijdelijke job, maar een langdurig carrièrepad met alle ondersteuning die je nodig hebt om de beste in je vak te worden.


Klaar voor de volgende stap?


Nieuwsgierig of dit de match is waar je naar zocht? Laten we vrijblijvend en vertrouwelijk kennismaken. We vertellen je alles over de functie, de cultuur en jouw groeipotentieel binnen de organisatie.


Solliciteer vandaag nog! We kijken ernaar uit om je te leren kennen.


Onze vacatures staan open voor iedereen: wij geloven in talent en competenties, ongeacht achtergrond, leeftijd of gender.

title: Conversational AI Engineer
description:

  • Experience with speech technologies: STT (speech-to-text) and TTS (text-to-speech) systems
  • Model deployment and integration skills, including APIs and system integrations

title: Sr Data Quality Engineer, Billing & Renewals-Salesforce & SOQL
description:
Job Summary
The Senior Data Quality Engineer, Billing Renewal Data, ensures the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of billing, subscription, and renewal data across the quote-to-cash lifecycle. This role designs automated data quality controls, validates invoicing and renewal processes, investigates data defects, and partners with Finance, Billing Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, CRM, ERP, and subscription-management teams to improve revenue operations and customer outcomes.


Responsibilities
  • Define and maintain data quality standards, validation rules, controls, and monitoring processes for billing, subscription, contract, and renewal data.
  • Design and implement automated testing, profiling, reconciliation, and anomaly-detection frameworks for invoices, charges, credits, payments, renewals, amendments, and account balances.
  • Validate billing calculations, renewal dates, contract terms, subscription status, product entitlements, pricing, discounts, taxes, credits, and payment schedules.
  • Test data flows across CPQ, CRM, subscription management, billing, ERP, payment processing, tax, collections, and reporting systems.
  • Validate renewal events, including upcoming renewals, renewal quotes, co-terming, upsells, downsells, cancellations, extensions, amendments, and term changes.
  • Investigate billing and renewal data defects, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate corrective actions with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Establish data quality metrics, dashboards, alerts, and reporting to monitor invoice accuracy, renewal readiness, recurring revenue data, and financial impact.
  • Review data models, transformation logic, APIs, source-to-target mappings, and migration processes for billing and renewal-related data.
  • Partner with Finance, Billing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Product, and Data Governance teams to improve quote-to-cash and renewal processes.
  • Document data definitions, quality rules, test scenarios, data lineage, defects, and operational procedures while providing technical guidance to other engineers.


What you will bring
  • Strong understanding of billing, subscription, contract, renewal, and quote-to-cash processes, including invoicing, credits, payments, amendments, cancellations, renewals, and recurring revenue.
  • Proficiency with SOQL and Python or comparable scripting languages for data analysis, validation, automation, and reconciliation.
  • Experience testing APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses, and integrations among CPQ, CRM, billing, subscription, ERP, payment, tax, and revenue systems.
  • Ability to analyze complex financial and transactional relationships, identify downstream business impacts, and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving, documentation, stakeholder-management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Qualifications
  • Bachelor s degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, finance, accounting, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Typically 5+ years of experience in data quality engineering, data engineering, software quality engineering, business systems, financial systems, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working with billing, subscription management, contract lifecycle, accounts receivable, renewal operations, payment processing, or revenue systems.
  • Hands-on experience developing automated data tests and quality frameworks using SOQL, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with CPQ, CRM, ERP, billing, subscription, payment, tax, or revenue-recognition integrations is preferred.
  • Experience with recurring revenue, renewal forecasting, revenue operations, data governance, metadata, lineage, or data observability is preferred.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading cross-functional data quality initiatives is preferred.

title: Customs Specialist
description:
Customs Specialist


Location: Houthalen, Belgium


Are you passionate about customs compliance and international trade? We are looking for a Customs Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring compliant, efficient, and customer-focused customs operations. In this position, you will act as the local subject matter expert for all customs-related activities and support operational excellence across the site.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary contact for customs-related matters, supporting both Belgian Customs authorities and customer inquiries.
  • Coordinate and manage Simplified Procedures and Bonded Warehouse activities, including customs declarations and globalization files.
  • Prepare, review, and maintain NCTS (T1) documentation while ensuring full compliance with customs regulations.
  • Support day-to-day customs operations, including document control and validation of supporting documentation for monthly billing processes.
  • Maintain accurate tariff classifications (HS/HTS codes), customs duties information, and provide guidance on country of origin and product classification.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders including Logistics, Purchasing, Material Management, and Trade Compliance to ensure customs compliance throughout the supply chain.
  • Partner with Neovia Global Tax & Trade and external customs advisors to support AEO controls and compliance initiatives.
  • Build strong relationships with customs brokers, freight forwarders, carriers, and customers to ensure seamless customs operations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customs processes, compliance controls, and operational efficiency.


What We're Looking For

  • Experience in customs operations, bonded warehouse management, and simplified customs procedures.
  • Good understanding of import/export regulations and customs compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of AEO processes and controls is considered an asset.
  • Strong knowledge of VAT requirements related to international trade and customs operations.
  • Experience preparing and validating Intrastat declarations.
  • Ability to analyze customs processes and proactively recommend improvements.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
  • Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, International Trade, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while collaborating across functions.


Why Join Us?

At Neovia, you'll be part of a dynamic international environment where your expertise directly contributes to compliance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence. We encourage initiative, professional growth, and continuous improvement while offering the opportunity to work with a broad range of global customs and trade activities.


Ready to make an impact?

Apply today and become a key contributor to our customs and trade compliance operations in Belgium.

title: Lead Business Analyst Engineer
description:
Senior Business Analyst - Payments
Location: | Open to any location | Occasional UAE travel
About the Role
We build compliance payment products used by banks and financial institutions across the UAE and GCC to process domestic, cross-border, instant, and WPS payments.
As a Senior Business Analyst, you will own the functional analysis from requirement through release. Youll work closely with bank stakeholders, sales, Key account Managers, architects, engineers, QA, and delivery teams.
You will be expected to understand the business problem behind each requirement, challenge unclear or impractical requests, define how the solution should behave, and stay involved through testing and release.
What Youll Own
  • Functional analysis of payment capabilities. This covers business rules, validations, exceptions, failures, returns, reconciliation, and downstream impact.
  • Requirement workshops with bank business, operations, and technology stakeholders. Youll convert ambiguous business needs into clear, complete, and testable requirements.
  • Functional specifications that engineering teams can build from. These include user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, API requirements, data mapping, and business rules.
  • Feasibility, gap, scope, dependency, and impact analysis for new requirements and change requests.
  • Requirement traceability from business need through development, testing, UAT, and release.
  • Testing support. Youll support SIT and UAT, clarify expected behaviour during defect triage, and validate delivered functionality against agreed requirements.
Must-Haves
  • 5+ years as a Business Analyst, including at least 3 years on payments products or payment projects in banking or financial services preferably in UAE or any other GCCs.
  • Experience analysing at least one end-to-end payment flow, including transaction processing, failures, returns, and reconciliation.
  • Good understanding of REST APIs, including authentication, request and response structures, validations, error handling, and data mapping.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 20022 message concepts and structures, such as pacs, pain, and camt.
  • Experience conducting requirement workshops directly with bank or business stakeholders.
  • Ability to write basic SQL queries for data validation and defect investigation.
Good to Have
  • Experience with UAE payment schemes, such as UAEFTS, WPS, and Aani.
  • Experience with payment hubs, orchestration, instant payments, open banking, clearing and settlement, or transaction monitoring.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Experience across Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.
How Youll Work with AI
We encourage analysts to use AI where it improves speed, analysis, and quality, and well support you in learning the tools. All use must follow company and client data-security policies.
Typical use cases include:
  • Diagrams as code: creating process flows, sequence diagrams, and system workflows using tools such as Mermaid, so diagrams stay close to requirements and are easy to update.

  • Within 6 months: you are the primary functional point of contact for that capability across engineering, QA, delivery, and business stakeholders.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Job Summary
This job will design and implement advanced data science models to support business needs. You will work with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Your role involves driving best practices in data science, ensuring data quality, and mentoring junior scientists.
We are looking for a Staff Data Scientist with strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals and deep, hands-on experience taking ML models and AI applications into production. We have a strong preference for candidates who have built AI applications in production and who bring a research background in ML. You will own systems end to end, from modeling and evaluation to deployment, and monitoring, and you will help shape how AI is used to detect and respond to fraud.


Essential Responsibilities
  • Lead and manage data science projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business goals.
  • Develop and maintain data models, algorithms, and reporting systems to support data analysis and decision-making.
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive strategic initiatives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and provide actionable insights.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity through regular audits and validation processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.


Minimum Qualifications
  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree or any equivalent combination of education and experience.


What you need to know about the role
This role is in the AI/ML team within the PayPal Artificial Intelligence org. This team supports Payment Services and Crypto, one of the 3 Business Units within PayPal. We partner with large, strategic customers to design, build and deploy fraud-detection solutions - machine-learning models, rules and AI-assisted tooling - that stop emerging attacks while keeping the experience smooth for good customers.


Your day to day
In your day-to-day role, you will
  • Develop, train, tune and evaluate models for fraud detection and risk assessment. Own feature development, modeling choices, reproducible experiments and error analysis as fraud patterns evolve.
  • Design, implement, and maintain ML and generative AI applications, including multi agent workflows built on payments data in production.
  • Build maintainable Python services, APIs, and SQL data pipelines that connect models with enterprise data, databases, and user applications.
  • Own full-stack delivery of ML applications: Backend API services, data pipelines on BigQuery, containerized deployments, and PR-based review.
  • Work with strategic merchants and cross-functional partners to understand their fraud challenges, design solutions together, and explain results clearly to technical and executive audiences.
  • Identify areas of improvement in internal systems and product, design, and project manage solutions end to end.
  • Independently execute projects end to end, while also mentoring and guiding junior team members, with a strong people-oriented mindset
  • Mentor Data Scientists, and ML Engineers; lead design reviews, set coding and documentation standards, and act as a bar-raiser in hiring.


What do you need to bring
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Mining or related field or equivalent practical experience
  • A minimum of 8 years of experience in building and shipping machine-learning systems to production, with demonstrated Staff-level scope, ownership and technical leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with ML models and AI applications in production: training, evaluating, deploying and monitoring models (classical ML, deep learning and/or LLMs) for real users.
  • Strong SQL and practical experience preparing data, building reliable pipelines, and integrating analytical or relational data with model workflows.
  • Experience deploying and operating services on a public cloud (GCP preferred).
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to translate business and customer needs into technical solutions and to mentor others.


Strongly preferred
End-to-end experience building and launching AI applications in production, with ownership of evaluation, reliability and user outcomes; risk or decision-support applications are especially relevant.
Research background in machine learning: PhD or MS with research experience, publications, or research-engineering work that moved from papers to products.


Nice to have
  • Experience in fraud, risk, trust safety, payments or e-commerce, including real-time decisioning or rule engines.
  • Experience with graph, sequence or anomaly-detection methods, or adversarial / drifting data.

These services are provided to EY country practices across globe enabling them to take decisions on new client acceptances and/or continuances.

The opportunity

Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Center of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.

This role will be part of the largest sub-service functions, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting client-serving teams in maintaining EY s Independence for its existing and prospective audit/non-audit clients.

Auditor Independence is a regulatory requirement that aims to create an arm s length distance between the Accounting Firm, its client serving employees and EY s audit clients. This is done to ensure that that EY Member Practices and their professionals should be (in fact) and should appear to be (in appearance) free from interests that might be regarded as being incompatible with objectivity, integrity, and impartiality of the audit.

RMS Independence team is currently 950+ people strong, operating from 3 countries and 5 centre s: India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in development of key Independence processes.

It also involves close collaboration with global teams and stakeholders to strengthen the compliance framework and foster a mindset of continuous improvement and client enablement.

A senior associate/ Lead Analyst in the team will be primarily responsible to develop good working knowledge of firm level Independence concepts. title: Volunteer Video Editor at Cameli Couturier
description:
Volunteer Video Editor at Cameli Couturier


C. COUTURIER

Helsinki Metropolitan Area | Hybrid / Remote


About the Role

Cameli Couturier (C. COUTURIER) is a Finnish startup focused on sustainable luxury fashion. We are looking for creative and motivated Volunteer Video Editors to join us in creating high-quality visual content for an emerging Finnish fashion brand with international ambitions.


You will work with real footage from fashion shoots, campaigns, behind-the-scenes content, and social media productions, transforming raw material into polished and engaging videos for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and our websites.


This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience, strengthen your editing skills, expand your portfolio with real fashion projects, and have a genuine creative impact within a small team.


What You'll Work On

Depending on your skills and interests, your work may include:

  • Editing short-form fashion videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok
  • Creating longer cinematic and storytelling-focused videos
  • Editing footage from fashion and lifestyle photoshoots
  • Selecting and arranging the best clips from raw footage
  • Creating smooth cuts, transitions, and pacing
  • Adding music, sound effects, voiceovers, and other audio
  • Basic colour correction and colour grading
  • Adding text, subtitles, graphics, and visual effects
  • Creating different versions of content for different social platforms
  • Developing and experimenting with new editing styles and creative concepts
  • Collaborating with the team on upcoming campaigns and content ideas


Editing Tools

We are especially looking for people with experience or interest in using:

  • CapCut — our main editing tool
  • DaVinci Resolve
  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Adobe After Effects
  • Other professional or creative video editing tools


You do not need to know every program listed above. Experience with CapCut alone can be sufficient, particularly if you have a strong eye for editing, storytelling, pacing, and social media content.


Working Arrangement

  • Part-time volunteer position
  • Approximately 5–15 hours per week
  • Hybrid / remote working model
  • Most video editing can be completed remotely
  • Possibility to participate in shoots and creative projects in Helsinki and elsewhere in the Helsinki metropolitan area
  • Flexible schedule that can be adapted around studies or full-time work


Why Join Cameli Couturier?

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Build your video editing portfolio with real fashion content
  • Gain practical experience working with a growing startup and fashion brand
  • Work with professionally produced fashion and lifestyle footage
  • Experiment with different editing styles and creative concepts
  • Develop your skills in short-form, cinematic, and social media video editing
  • Take creative ownership of projects rather than only completing small editing tasks
  • Work closely with a small and ambitious team
  • Expand your professional network
  • Contribute directly to the visual identity and growth of an emerging Finnish fashion brand


Working with an early-stage brand also means your ideas can have a visible impact on how our content and visual direction develop.


Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old
  • You must live in the Nordic countries (Finland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark or Iceland)
  • Fluent English or Finnish is required
  • Some experience with CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or another video editing tool
  • A good eye for visual storytelling, pacing, and aesthetics
  • Interest in video editing and creating engaging digital content
  • Ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines
  • A proactive attitude and willingness to learn
  • Interest in fashion, luxury, social media, filmmaking, or creative work is considered an advantage


You do not need to be an experienced professional. Students, recent graduates, self-taught editors, and people looking to build their portfolios are welcome to apply.


Important Information

Please note that this is an unpaid volunteer position. No financial compensation, salary, or employment benefits will be provided.

The position is intended primarily for people looking to gain practical experience, develop their skills, contribute to real projects, and strengthen their creative portfolio.


How to Apply

Please tell us:

  • A little about yourself
  • What video editing software you use
  • Your previous video editing experience
  • What kinds of videos you enjoy editing
  • Why you would like to join Cameli Couturier
  • Your approximate weekly availability


If possible, please also include a portfolio, showreel, social media account, or examples of videos you have edited. Personal projects are completely welcome.

Whether you are studying video production, already creating social media content, teaching yourself editing, or simply looking for an opportunity to work on real creative projects, we would love to hear from you.


You can apply here on LinkedIn or by email to info@camelicouturier.com. Email applications are welcome even after this post has closed.


  • Join us in shaping the visual world of Cameli Couturier and the future of sustainable luxury fashion.

In het kader van het onderzoek naar en de ontwikkeling van bergingssystemen voor radioactief afval (bovengronds en ondergronds) speel je een wetenschappelijke en redactionele rol bij het opstellen van technische rapporten en in het bijzonder van het veiligheidsdossier voor de oppervlakteberging in Dessel. In samenwerking met je deskundige collega's in verschillende wetenschappelijke disciplines werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van conceptuele modellen en aan de nodige kwalificatie-, verificatie- en validatieanalyses (QVV). Daarnaast help je de resultaten te interpreteren en te integreren en bereid je syntheses voor, ter ondersteuning van de langetermijnveiligheid van de bergingsinstallatie, de hoeksteen van duurzaam en efficiënt afvalbeheer.

Wat doe je concreet als medewerker Veiligheidsstudies?

• Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen en/of controleren van bepaalde delen van het veiligheidsdossier (het veiligheidsrapport en/of de onderliggende technisch-wetenschappelijke documenten).
• Je synthetiseert de gedetailleerde wetenschappelijke kennis van je deskundige collega's in verschillende wetenschappelijke disciplines en ontwikkelt conceptuele modellen in overleg met hen.
• Je begeleidt en controleert in detail de eventuele bijdragen van derden (onderzoekscentra, universiteiten) en ziet toe op de kwaliteit van deze bijdragen.
• Je superviseert de implementatie van modellen die resultaten kunnen opleveren die NIRAS nodig heeft, evenals de kwalificatie-, verificatie- en validatieaspecten die essentieel zijn voor deze implementatie.
• Je evalueert de verkregen resultaten met de andere leden van NIRAS om eventuele lacunes of verbeterpunten te identificeren.
• Je ziet toe op de strikte toepassing van de wetgeving en regels met betrekking tot nucleaire veiligheid en stralingsbescherming.
• Je werkt nauw samen met alle NIRAS-medewerkers uit alle disciplines en deeldomeinen en zorgt voor een optimale synergie en kennisdeling tussen de programma's.

Welke vaardigheden heb je nodig om deze opdracht tot een goed einde te brengen?

• Je hebt een master of doctoraat in (ingenieurs)wetenschappen of gelijkwaardige ervaring. Ervaring in het uitvoeren van studies over de nucleaire langetermijnveiligheid is een pluspunt.
• Je hebt interesse voor het beheer van radioactief afval. Je haalt voldoening uit het feit dat je kunt bijdragen aan een veilig en effectief beheer van radioactief afval.
• Je hebt een analytische geest, gecombineerd met een georganiseerde en nauwgezette aanpak. Je bent in staat tot een pragmatische, doelgerichte en efficiënte uitvoering van de nodige acties en taken en je bent bereid om gedurende langere tijd aan eenzelfde dossier te werken en daarbij het overzicht te bewaren.
• Je schrijft goed en vloeiend.
• Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands (mondeling en schriftelijk) en een goede kennis van het Frans en Engels.
• Je bent een teamspeler, maar bent ook in staat zelfstandig te werken.
• Je geeft blijk van initiatief en bent polyvalent.
• Je bent contactvaardig en kunt je communicatiestijl makkelijk aanpassen aan verschillende belanghebbenden en situaties.

Waarom kiezen voor een job bij NIRAS?

Als enige beheerder van radioactief afval in België biedt NIRAS je een unieke werkomgeving, waarin al onze medewerkers met passie en professionalisme naar duurzame oplossingen streven. We werken in het belang van de gemeenschap, het milieu en de toekomstige generaties, en met respect voor de regelgeving en de wetenschappelijke vooruitgang. De band die ons bindt is de maatschappelijke meerwaarde van onze opdracht.

Bij NIRAS kan je rekenen op:
● een voltijds vast contract met een comfortabel loon en extralegale voordelen als groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering en maaltijdcheques;
● een prima werk-privébalans: je hebt flexibele werkuren, minstens 41 verlofdagen per jaar en je kan twee dagen per week telewerken;
● moderne werkmiddelen en een aangename werkomgeving die samenwerken en brainstormen faciliteert;
● opleiding/coaching om je expertise en je veerkracht verder te ontwikkelen.

Waar is je werkplek?

Je werkt meestal in ons kantoor in Brussel, op wandelafstand van het Noordstation (Koning Albert II-laan 32, 1000 Brussel) en bent bereid je regelmatig te verplaatsen naar de sites waar de onderzoeksprogramma's plaatsvinden (met name NISD – NIRAS-Site Dessel) en naar het buitenland.
Het is ook mogelijk om te telewerken, na een inwerkperiode van drie maanden en in overleg met je leidinggevende.

Hoe solliciteren?

Heb je interesse voor deze functie? Solliciteer dan via de knop hieronder.
Ken je iemand die de nodige kwalificaties bezit om ze uit te oefenen? Stuur dan gerust deze vacature door.
Indien je nog vragen hebt, aarzel dan niet contact op te nemen met ons rekruteringsteam op het adres jobs@nirond.be.

title: Lead Enterprise Data Modeller
description:
Job Summary
Lead Enterprise Data Modeller
Lloyd s Register
Location: Chennai; Gdansk; Athens


Role Overview
This is a hands-on role for a modelling specialist who combines strong technical expertise with business engagement skills. You will work with business stakeholders, architects, product teams and governance specialists to create the enterprise data models that underpin reporting, analytics, integration and emerging AI capabilities.
As part of the Data Systems leadership team, you will help establish modelling standards, drive consistency across the organisation and influence the future direction of our strategic data platforms.


What we offer you
  • Fixed term contract (2 years) with option to extend
  • The opportunity to work for an organization that has a strong sense of purpose, is values-driven and helps colleagues to develop professionally and personally through our range of people development programs


Role Responsibilities
  • Lead enterprise data modelling activities
  • Develop and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models across LR s strategic analytics platforms.
  • Translate business concepts, policies, processes and information requirements into clear, reusable data structures.
  • Build and evolve enterprise models that support reporting, analytics, data products, integration and AI use cases.
  • Maintain consistent business definitions, entities and relationships across domains, systems and data products.


Establish modelling standards and best practice
  • Define and promote enterprise modelling standards, methods, naming conventions and reusable patterns.
  • Introduce modern modelling techniques and relevant industry practices across LR s data community.
  • Review models produced by internal teams, programmes and suppliers, providing practical guidance and quality assurance.
  • Act as LR s subject matter expert for enterprise data modelling and related design decisions.


Partner with business and technology teams
  • Facilitate modelling workshops with business owners, subject matter experts, system owners and delivery teams.
  • Capture business rules, information requirements and key terms in a form that stakeholders can validate.
  • Work with architects, engineers, analysts and product teams to align business outcomes with technical implementation.
  • Provide modelling leadership to strategic programmes, platform enhancements and data transformation initiatives.


Support data governance and quality
  • Work with Data Governance teams to embed agreed data standards, definitions and controls in enterprise models.
  • Define critical business entities, authoritative data sources, ownership and stewardship requirements.
  • Support data quality, metadata, lineage and maturity initiatives by connecting governance requirements to implemented models.


Influence strategic data direction
  • Shape LR s enterprise information architecture by defining shared entities, relationships and reusable information structures.
  • Guide the evolution of strategic analytics platforms, including DOP and Nexus, through coherent modelling principles.
  • Bring relevant external practices, emerging techniques and industry trends into architecture and strategy discussions.


What you bring
  • Minimum 8 years experience in Data Modelling, Information Architecture or a closely related discipline
  • Create conceptual, logical and physical data models within large, complex organisations.
  • Model data for enterprise warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses and modern analytics platforms.
  • Translate business processes, rules and information requirements into well-structured, implementable models.
  • Work directly with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, engineers and governance specialists.
  • Establish modelling standards, governance arrangements, review processes and quality controls.
  • Apply enterprise data governance principles to ownership, definitions, metadata, lineage and data quality.


Essential technical knowledge
A strong understanding of:
  • Conceptual, logical and physical data modelling, including the progression from business concepts to implementable structures.
  • Dimensional modelling, including star and snowflake schemas for analytical and reporting use cases.
  • Data Vault and other scalable modelling patterns used in enterprise analytical platforms.
  • Master and reference data management, including authoritative sources, shared entities and controlled values.
  • Metadata management, data lineage and information architecture within governed enterprise data environments.


Knowledge of modern analytical architectures including:
  • Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Services used to deliver governed enterprise analytics and data integration.
  • Databricks and Snowflake, including their core modelling and analytical workload patterns.
  • Enterprise lakehouse architectures and the relationship between storage, processing, semantic and consumption layers.
  • Medallion architecture, including the purpose and design of Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers.


Desirable experience
  • Use data governance and catalogue tools such as Microsoft Purview or Collibra.
  • Use data modelling tools such as erwin, IDERA, Sparx Enterprise Architect or comparable products.
  • Contribute to enterprise data governance programmes spanning business ownership, metadata, quality and controls.
  • Support large-scale cloud, data transformation or platform migration initiatives.
  • Support analytics platform modernisation while maintaining continuity for live reporting and data services.


General
  • Work European business hours (CET/CEST) and travel occasionally to LR offices and client sites in the UK and Europe.
  • Report to the Director of Data Systems, who is accountable for LR s Data Strategy.
  • Maritime industry experience is desirable.
  • Experience preparing data for AI and integration use cases, with an understanding of AI governance and security, is desirable.
  • Manage strategic offshore supplier relationships, promoting effective collaboration across LR and partner teams and establishing consistent Agile and DevOps delivery practices.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an AI Engineer to design, build, and productionise agentic AI systems and machine learning solutions that power our analytics and automation platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role: you will own the full lifecycle - from problem framing and model/agent design through to deployment, evaluation, and ongoing monitoring in production.
Location: Noida
Job Type: Full-Time
Work Arrangement: Onsite


What youll do

Agentic AI LLM Systems
  • Design and build multi-agent and single-agent workflows using LangGraph - including state graphs, conditional routing, checkpointing, memory, and human-in-the-loop interrupts.
  • Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients to expose internal tools, data sources, and APIs to LLM agents in a standardised, secure way.
  • Design robust tool/function-calling interfaces: schema design, argument validation, error handling, retries, and graceful degradation.
  • Implement RAG pipelines end to end - ingestion, chunking, embedding, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citation, and grounding.
  • Engineer and version prompts systematically; build structured-output pipelines with schema enforcement.
  • Build evaluation harnesses for agents and LLM features (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites) and drive measurable quality improvements.
  • Implement guardrails: prompt-injection defence, PII redaction, output validation, cost and token budgeting, rate limiting.


Machine Learning
  • Build, train, and evaluate ML models for classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, and clustering on structured enterprise data.
  • Own feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and rigorous offline/online evaluation.
  • Fine-tune or adapt open-source LLMs where warranted (LoRA / QLoRA / PEFT, instruction tuning, embedding model fine-tuning).
  • Monitor deployed models for drift, degradation, and data-quality issues; own retraining cycles.


Engineering Deployment
  • Write production-grade Python: clean, typed, tested, and reviewed.
  • Build and expose AI services as APIs (FastAPI), with async handling, streaming responses, and queueing where needed.
  • Containerise and deploy workloads to cloud with CI/CD, environment management, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Instrument systems with tracing and observability for latency, cost, token usage, tool-call success rates, and failure modes.


Collaboration Delivery
  • Translate ambiguous business or client requirements into concrete AI system designs with clear scope and success criteria.
  • Write clear technical documentation, architecture notes, and handover material.
  • Support UAT cycles, client demos, and production issue triage.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal engineering standards.


What were looking for
  • Python (expert) - 3+ years; async/await, typing, packaging, testing (pytest)
  • FastAPI or equivalent for API development
  • SQL - complex queries, joins, window functions, query optimisation
  • Git, code review workflows, branching strategies
  • LangGraph - required; production experience building stateful, cyclic agent graphs
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex - chains, retrievers, document loaders, output parsers
  • Exposure to at least one other orchestration framework: CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK, Pydantic AI, or Semantic Kernel
  • Agent design patterns: ReAct, plan-and-execute, reflection, supervisor/worker, tool-use loops, multi-agent handoff
  • Building MCP servers (tools, resources, prompts) and integrating MCP clients
  • Transport handling (stdio, SSE, streamable HTTP), authentication, and tool-scoping
  • Designing safe, well-described tool schemas for reliable LLM invocation
  • Working with commercial and open models: Claude (Anthropic), GPT (OpenAI), Gemini, Llama, Mistral, Qwen
  • Prompt engineering, few-shot design, structured outputs, JSON-mode / tool-calling
  • Embedding models, chunking strategies, hybrid (BM25 + dense) search, cross-encoder reranking
  • Context management: caching, compression, summarisation, long-context handling
  • PostgreSQL - schema design, indexing, joins, window functions, query optimisation; familiarity with the pgvector extension
  • MongoDB - document modelling, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, and knowing when a document store beats a relational one
  • Vector databases: pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, or Milvus - collection design, metadata filtering, and index tuning
  • Comfort working across both relational and NoSQL stores in the same system, including data modelling trade-offs
  • scikit-learn, XGBoost / LightGBM, pandas, NumPy
  • PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for deep learning and fine-tuning workflows
  • Hugging Face ecosystem: transformers, datasets, peft, sentence-transformers
  • Time-series forecasting, imbalanced-data handling, cross-validation, model interpretability (SHAP)
  • Solid grounding in statistics and evaluation metrics - knowing which metric matters for the business problem
  • PII detection and redaction; data residency and compliance awareness
  • Prompt-injection and jailbreak mitigation; least-privilege tool access
  • Bias, fairness, and explainability considerations in model deployment
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
  • 3-4 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with at least 1 year building LLM-based or agentic systems in production
  • Demonstrable track record of shipping AI systems that reached real users - not only prototypes or notebooks


Nice to have
  • Experience deploying AI systems in BFSI / fintech / regulated environments
  • Regulatory or compliance reporting automation experience
  • Document AI: OCR, layout parsing, table extraction (Docling, Unstructured, Textract, Document AI)
  • Conversational AI / chatbot systems with multi-turn state management
  • Knowledge graphs (Neo4j) or GraphRAG

Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues including governance, controls, culture and data insights to full organizational design and structural implementation. We want to help companies safeguard and restore financial and brand reputations. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over.

Your key responsibilities
  • Job Role Description- DFIR Analyst DFIR Analyst is responsible for investigating security incidents, analysing digital evidence and helping in containment and remediation of cyber security incident. The Analyst should be having experience on hands-on investigations, triage, evidence collection and documentation of complex cyber security incidents. 1. Key Responsibilities
  • Understand incident details, affected systems, business impact and available infrastructure context.
  • Identify relevant evidence sources, including logs, endpoint data, network data and security platform telemetry.
  • Review alerts and logs from SIEM, EDR, SOAR, IDS/IPS, email security and other available sources.
  • Validate suspicious activity and correlate events to reconstruct the probable attack path.
  • Support initial containment actions such as endpoint isolation, IOC blocking and access restriction.
  • Acquire forensic images, memory captures, logs and volatile data using approved procedures and tools.
  • Preserve evidence integrity by minimizing contamination and maintaining proper chain-of-custody records.
  • Analyse forensic artifacts such as event logs, registry, prefetch, LNK files, browser artifacts, metadata and EDR telemetry.
  • Investigate endpoint, malware, email and network indicators to identify persistence, lateral movement, exfiltration and root cause.
  • Enrich indicators using threat intelligence sources and map attacker behaviour to MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
  • Prepare triage and investigation reports covering timelines, findings, impact, corrective actions and recommendations.
  • 2. Tools & Technology Knowledge
  • Hands-on knowledge of forensic tools such as Autopsy, Sleuth Kit, FTK Imager, EnCase, Cellebrite and Volatility.
  • Working familiarity with EDR and incident response platforms including Microsoft Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne and Carbon Black.
  • Ability to analyze logs using SIEM and log analytics platforms such as Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel and QRadar.
  • Basic understanding of network and packet analysis tools including Wireshark, NetFlow analyzers and related investigation utilities.
  • Awareness of malware analysis and triage tools such as KAPE, sandbox platforms, VirusTotal and OTX.
  • 3. Required Skills and Competencies
  • Strong understanding of Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and common cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.
  • Knowledge of common cyber-attack techniques, including phishing, ransomware, credential theft and lateral movement.
  • Ability to review logs, identify anomalies and correlate suspicious activities across multiple evidence sources.
  • Basic scripting capability in PowerShell or Python to support investigation automation and data analysis.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills during incident response activities.
  • Ability to work under pressure while maintaining attention to detail in evidence handling and documentation.
  • 4. Experience & Qualifications
  • 24 years of experience in DFIR investigations.
  • Bachelors degree in IT/CS or equivalent experience.
  • Preferred certifications: GIAC GCIH / GCFA, CEH/ CHFI, EnCE and FTK AccessData Certified Examiner, or in any SIEM tool related.
Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have
  • Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
Experience
  • Digital Forensic and Incident response, investigations

title: Projects Portfolio Lead (non-product projects)
description:
Ve 2N budujeme budoucnost přístupu do budov a pohybu po nich - pro všechny, ať už máte plné tašky nákupu nebo nějaký zdravotní hendikep. Naše interkomy a přístupové systémy najdete od Dubaje po New York: v rezidenčních domech, kancelářích i nemocnicích. Možná jste na jeden z nich zvonili, aniž byste to tušili.

Jsme na trhu 35 let, stabilně rosteme a prosperujeme. Dnes je nás přes 500 a vyvíjíme vlastní hardware i software, včetně celého životního cyklu produktu. Staráme se o sladění pracovního a soukromého života.





Popis nabídky práce

O čem role je?

Jako Projects Portfolio Lead budete odpovědný/á za vedení a rozvoj portfolia non-produktových (korporátních a transformačních) projektů ve 2N – od prioritizace a kapacitního plánování přes zavádění governance až po zajištění kvality dat, na kterých portfolio řízení stojí. Jde o zakladatelskou roli: převezmete rozjetou agendu po prvním ročním běhu a posunete ji na další úroveň, systematicky a s jasným dopadem na provoz organizace, zákazníky i business.

Budete úzce spolupracovat s dalšími manažery a leadery napříč organizací – z Financí, Operations, R&D i mateřské společnosti Axis – a reportovat přímo CFO. Hledáme člověka, který umí kombinovat expertizu v portfolio a projektovém řízení, procesech, leadershipu a schopnosti měnit zaběhlý způsob práce. Tým bude zpočátku menší – velkou část vedení dalších kolegů budete zajišťovat nepřímo, formou maticového řízení.



Co u nás budete dělat:

  • Vytvoříte strategii portfolio managementu pro ne-produktové (korporátní a transformační) projekty ve 2N, budete ji dále rozvíjet a řešit strategická témata spojená s růstem firmy.
  • Portfolio projektů budete spravovat a průběžně aktualizovat, nastavíte prioritizaci a zavedete kapacitní simulace (dnes na nich ve firmě teprve začínáme – vy na to navážete).
  • Zavedete projektovou governance a metodiku tam, kde dosud chybí – šablony, procesy, rozhodovací fóra (portfolio review, steering committee). Harmonizujete s částí pro produktové projekty.
  • Povedete vybrané strategické a komplexní projekty end-to-end – od iniciace přes plánování až po realizaci a uzavření.
  • Stav portfolia, projektů a kapacit budete pravidelně reportovat CFO i vedení firmy a facilitovat rozhodovací fóra.
  • Úzce spolupracujete s Financemi, ICT, R&D PMO/POM i mateřskou společností Axis, abyste sladili produktové a ne-produktové portfolio i technické kapacity.
  • Do řízení portfolia i napříč organizací zavedete automatizaci, digitalizaci a AI nástroje a zajistíte kvalitu projektových dat jako základ pro budoucí AI-driven analýzy a scoring.
  • Postupně vybudujete vlastní tým a zároveň budete silní v nepřímém/maticovém vedení spolupracujících kolegů napříč organizací.
  • Prosadíte změny napříč firmou – získáte podporu managementu i týmů a nastavíte tempo změn podle potřeb organizace.
  • Projekty mají blízko k procesům. Proto se budete podílet na jejich řízení, mapování a popisování – především u těch klíčových end-to-end procesů s velkým dopadem na celkovou efektivitu firmy.





Kvalifikace

  • Máte minimálně 5 let zkušeností s projektovým/procesním řízením a portfolio managementem, ideálně ve větší organizaci se složitější maticovou strukturou.
  • Projektovou governance a metodiku umíte zavést od nuly, a tam, kde už existuje, jste ji zefektivnil/a a vylepšil/a – nejde jen o udržování toho, co už funguje.
  • Máte businessový cit – rozumíte obchodnímu modelu a KPI 2N a dle toho umíte stanovovat priority; zároveň máte technologický i ekonomický mindset (děláte věci s přidanou hodnotou a efektivně, neřešíte, co není potřeba).
  • Umíte si získávat lidi, jste silná osobnost a zároveň týmový hráč.
  • Lidi a týmy vedete a rozvíjíte (přímo i nepřímo) už 5 a více let.
  • Vládnete silnými komunikačními a interpersonálními dovednostmi – umíte jednat na úrovni C-level, vést i bez přímé pravomoci a spolupracovat napříč útvary, divizemi i s mateřskou společností Axis.
  • Vedl/a jste komplexní projekty a transformační programy s výrazným dopadem na firmu a umíte formulovat víceletou vizi portfolia/PMO.
  • Znáte waterfallový, agilní i hybridní přístup k řízení projektů.
  • Ovládáte principy portfolio managementu, risk/change managementu a KPI řízení a umíte pracovat s nástroji pro PM/portfolio/reporting (např. Jira, MS Project, Power BI, PPM nástroje s AI funkcemi).
  • Vítaná je zkušenost z technologicko-výrobní firmy zabývající se HW i SW, zkušenost s rolí business analytika, procesním řízením (BPM) a Lean přístupy, případně přehled v oblasti ISO/kvality.
  • Mluvíte plynule anglicky a zvládnete vést jednání i v angličtině.
  • Velmi dobře pracujete s daty a jejich analýzou – ovládáte pokročilé postupy (výhodou jsou základy Pythonu nebo R) a aktivně využíváte AI včetně pokročilých promptovacích technik. Práci si rozdělujete na tu, kterou děláte sami, a na tu, kterou přenecháváte AI agentům (nebo se na to aktivně připravujete).

Další informace

Proč se Vám u nás bude líbit:

  • Umožňujeme sladit pracovní a soukromý čas.
  • 5 týdnů dovolené.
  • Sabbatical - 20 dní placené dovolené navíc za každých 5 odpracovaných let.
  • Roční bonus při splnění ambice (až 1,8 násobek měsíční mzdy).
  • Příspěvek na stravování 120,- Kč/odpracovaný den.
  • Příspěvek 12 000,- Kč ročně do Benefit Plus k čerpání dle vlastního uvážení - MultiSport karta, penzijní připojištění, příspěvěk na dopravu do práce a další dlenabídky (čerpání po zkušební době).
  • Flexibilní pracovní doba a home office.
  • Vzdělávací a jazykové kurzy.
  • Práci s moderními nástroji a podporu při využívání AI, digitalizace a datových analýz.
  • Firemní snídaně, ovocné dny.
  • Pravidelné firemní akce - sportovní turnaje, teambuildingy, grilování po práci, atd).
  • Slevy u partnerů a zvýhodněné ceny na naše produkty.
