title: Data Science Systems Architect
description:
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Data Science Systems Architect / Engineer who can bridge deep software-engineering and systems-architecture expertise with hands-on Data Science and Machine Learning capabilities. The ideal candidate brings 6-15 years of overall technical experience, with around 2 years dedicated to data-science, ML, and AI-driven system design. In this role, you will lead the architectural definition of ML pipelines, model-inference platforms, and intelligent systems that integrate with Mavenirs core network products. You will collaborate closely with RD, Product Management, Sales Engineering, and global account teams to deliver production-grade solutions. Telecom / IMS / VoLTE domain experience is a strong add-on advantage.


Key Responsibilities
  • Architecture System Design: Lead architectural and functional discussions for ML-enabled network solutions, defining end-to-end data, pipeline, and model architectures.
  • Architecture System Design: Design scalable, production-grade ML pipelines covering ingestion, feature engineering, model training, inference, and monitoring.
  • Architecture System Design: Draft comprehensive functional and development requirements for data/ML systems, APIs, and integration points with core network products.
  • Architecture System Design: Collaborate with RD to review code, ensure implementation meets architectural requirements, and guide CI/CD and deployment practices.
  • Data Science Machine Learning: Analyze network and operational data using statistical techniques; identify data distributions, correlations, and causation patterns.
  • Data Science Machine Learning: Identify preprocessing and post-processing requirements aligned with business logic and telecom protocol specifications.
  • Data Science Machine Learning: Experiment with algorithms, architectures, and frameworks to identify the best solutions for network-analytics and automation use cases.
  • Data Science Machine Learning: Develop, train, and optimize classical ML, deep-learning, and generative-AI models (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, etc.).
  • Data Science Machine Learning: Implement explainability frameworks (SHAP, LIME) and model-monitoring practices to ensure transparency and reliability in production.
  • AI / Agentic Emerging Technologies: Build LLM-powered applications, RAG workflows, and agentic systems using modern frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, vector stores).
  • AI / Agentic Emerging Technologies: Integrate ML models with API-based microservices, backend services (FastAPI / Flask / Django), and external telecom systems.
  • AI / Agentic Emerging Technologies: Experiment with GANs for synthetic data generation and augmentation where applicable.
  • Domain Customer Collaboration: Work with customers, product managers, and industry experts to identify and design ML / AI requirements for telecom solutions (VoLTE, IMS, 5G, Enterprise network).
  • Domain Customer Collaboration: Understand protocol specifications and telecom KPIs to gain deeper insight into data sources, distributions, and business logic.
  • Domain Customer Collaboration: Assist Sales Engineering and Business Development in creating technical proposals, RFP / RFI responses, competitive analyses, and white papers.
  • Domain Customer Collaboration: Develop positioning papers and technical presentations that demonstrate Mavenirs leadership in AI-driven network solutions.
  • Leadership Intellectual Property: Mentor junior data scientists, ML engineers, and software developers; promote best practices in coding, testing, and model quality.
  • Leadership Intellectual Property: Protect Mavenirs intellectual property through patent filings, invention disclosures, and competitive-technology tracking.
  • Leadership Intellectual Property: Attend occasional off-hour conference calls with offices across the US, Europe, and Asia to support global delivery.


Job Requirements
  • Experience Profile: 6 - 15 years of professional experience in software engineering, systems architecture, or telecom/network engineering.
  • Experience Profile: ~2 years of focused, hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI engineering, including production ML pipeline design and deployment.
  • Experience Profile: Demonstrated track record of leading technical discussions and delivering complex, multi-system solutions.


Technical Skills - Core
  • Strong hands-on programming in Python and SQL; experience with data modeling, feature engineering, and database technologies.
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle - regression, classification, clustering, time-series, anomaly detection, classical ML (Bagging / Boosting), and Deep Learning (CNN, RNN, Transformers).
  • Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, and model-evaluation / explainability frameworks (SHAP / LIME).
  • Experience building REST APIs, microservices, and backend integration workflows (FastAPI / Flask / Django) for ML model inference.
  • Proficiency with version control (Git), modular code structure, debugging, code optimization, and basic CI/CD practices.


Technical Skills - Architecture Integration
  • Experience with API-based systems, service-oriented / microservice architectures, and containerization (Docker / Kubernetes).
  • Understanding of virtualized product architecture, NFV, cloud-native deployment, and scalable data storage / object-store technologies.
  • Ability to design and document comprehensive functional / non-functional requirements for data and ML systems.


Generative AI Agentic Systems (Plus)
  • Practical exposure to LLMs, embeddings, vector stores, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Langflow, MCP) for multi-step AI workflow orchestration.
  • Familiarity with GANs for synthetic data generation (optional but valuable).


Preferred / Add-on Advantages
  • Telecom Domain Experience: Understanding of telecom network architectures and protocols (VoLTE, VoWiFi, IMS, 5G, Enterprise solutions) - strong plus.
  • Telecom Domain Experience: Experience with telecom KPIs, network analytics, signaling data, and protocol-level data interpretation.
  • Telecom Domain Experience: Prior work with telecom core-network products, NFV infrastructure, or operator-grade deployment environments.


Advanced Education Certifications
  • Masters or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, AI / ML, Electronics / Telecom Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Relevant certifications (TensorFlow Developer, PyTorch, AWS / GCP / Azure ML, Kubernetes, etc.) are a plus.


Soft Skills Attributes
  • Effective oral and written communication skills; ability to explain complex ML / architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to decompose complex issues into actionable tasks and deliver under tight timelines.

Position: Manager Data Privacy
Experience: 12+ years
Location: Mumbai
Role Overview:
We are looking for an experienced Manager – Data Privacy to lead and support data privacy and compliance initiatives across the organization. The role will involve working closely with DPOs, CISOs, Compliance, Legal, Product, Engineering and Digital Operations teams to assess privacy requirements, drive compliance initiatives, and embed privacy-by-design practices across products and processes.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage data privacy and compliance initiatives across business and technology functions.
  • Interpret and provide guidance on global data protection regulations including GDPR, CCPA, VCDPA, PIPEDA and India DPDPA.
  • Partner with DPOs, CISOs, Compliance, Legal, Product and Engineering teams to understand privacy requirements and translate them into actionable controls and processes.
  • Conduct privacy assessments and audits to identify compliance gaps and recommend remediation measures.
  • Drive Privacy by Design principles across new products, features, integrations and business processes.
  • Manage and improve Data Subject Request (DSAR) processes, including access, deletion and other applicable data subject rights.
  • Oversee consent management and privacy preference processes and ensure appropriate controls are implemented.
  • Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, process documentation, training material and compliance guidelines.
  • Conduct privacy awareness and training sessions for internal teams and business stakeholders.
  • Work with technology/product teams to ensure privacy requirements are incorporated during product development and implementation.
  • Support vendor/third-party privacy assessments and evaluate data processing and privacy risks.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their potential impact on business operations and products.
  • Prepare privacy compliance reports, risk assessments and management updates.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely closure of identified privacy and compliance gaps.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience in Data Privacy, Privacy Compliance, Data Protection, Information Security Governance or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, VCDPA, PIPEDA and DPDPA.
  • Experience working with DPO, CISO, Legal, Compliance, Product and Engineering stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience with DSAR, Consent Management, Privacy Audits and Privacy-by-Design.
  • Strong understanding of data privacy controls, compliance frameworks and risk management.
  • Experience in SaaS, technology, consulting or data-driven organizations preferred.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical business and technology requirements.

Preferred Certifications:

  • CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM, CIPT or equivalent privacy certification.
  • ISO 27701 / ISO 27001 knowledge or certification would be an advantage.

title: Sr Business Analyst
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and client-facing Senior Business Analyst to join our growing organization and play a critical role in shaping the future of Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Enterprise Service Management solutions.
The ideal candidate will serve as the voice of the customer within the delivery team, partnering closely with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and development teams to translate business challenges into scalable technology solutions. This role requires exceptional stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, business analysis, and communication skills, with experience working on Salesforce, ITSM, Service Management, or Digital Transformation platforms.
As a trusted advisor, you will engage with senior business stakeholders, facilitate discovery sessions, document requirements, support solution design, validate delivered functionality, and demonstrate business value throughout the project lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
Business Analysis Client Engagement
  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and technology teams.
  • Conduct discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, design thinking workshops, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Engage confidently with senior client stakeholders, business leaders, process owners, and executive sponsors.
  • Analyze current-state business processes and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and digital transformation.
  • Serve as the "Eyes and Ears of the Customer" throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring business objectives remain aligned with delivery outcomes.
  • Facilitate discussions that help define business priorities, scope, success criteria, and roadmap initiatives.
Requirements Management
  • Elicit, analyze, document, prioritize, and manage business requirements.
  • Create detailed:
    • Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
    • Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs)
    • User Stories
    • Process Flows
    • Use Cases
    • Acceptance Criteria
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear and actionable development specifications.
  • Maintain backlog grooming, requirements traceability, and stakeholder alignment throughout project execution.
  • Partner with Product Owners and Project Managers to define implementation priorities and release plans.
Salesforce ITSM Solution Delivery
  • Work closely with architects and development teams to design solutions leveraging Salesforce and Enterprise Service Management platforms.
  • Support the delivery of solutions spanning:
    • ITSM Platforms
    • Agentforce and Conversational Experiences
    • Enterprise Integrations
  • Collaborate with technical teams to ensure requirements are accurately interpreted and implemented.
  • Participate in solution reviews and validate alignment to business requirements.
Testing, Validation Demonstrations
  • Define and execute business validation strategies.
  • Develop test scenarios, test cases, and user acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate and support UAT activities with business users and stakeholders.
  • Validate completed functionality against requirements and business expectations.
  • Conduct solution demonstrations, sprint reviews, and showcase sessions to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
  • Gather feedback, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvements.
Stakeholder Relationship Management
  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
  • Act as a trusted business advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Anticipate stakeholder concerns and proactively manage expectations.
  • Facilitate decision-making and conflict resolution across business and technical teams.
Required Qualifications
Must Have
  • 6 to 10 years of Business Analysis experience in enterprise technology programs.
  • Proven experience working with:
    • Salesforce platforms (Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud), and/or
    • ITSM / Enterprise Service Management platforms.
  • Strong experience conducting stakeholder workshops and requirement elicitation sessions.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and communicate effectively with senior client stakeholders.
  • Expertise in creating:
    • BRDs
    • Functional Specifications
    • User Stories
    • Process Maps
    • Acceptance Criteria
    • Business Workflows
  • Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and iterative delivery methodologies.
  • Experience supporting testing, UAT, and solution validation activities.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working on Salesforce transformation programs.
  • Experience in IT Service Management (ITSM) implementations.
  • Exposure to Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Customer Service, Employee Service, or Enterprise Service Management solutions.
  • Experience working with integration-heavy platforms involving APIs and enterprise systems.
  • Knowledge of AI-enabled service management, conversational platforms, or Agentforce capabilities.
  • Salesforce Business Analyst Certification or related Salesforce certifications.
  • CBAP, PMI-PBA, or equivalent business analysis certifications.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for professionals who:
  • Excel at building relationships and earning stakeholder trust.
  • Can confidently interact with senior business leaders and executive stakeholders.
  • Possess strong business acumen and a consultative mindset.
  • Are passionate about translating business problems into technology solutions.
  • Enjoy working in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Thrive on collaboration and cross-functional teamwork.
  • Can bridge the gap between business vision and technical execution.
  • Want to grow with a rapidly expanding organization focused on innovation and customer success.
Why Join Us
  • Be part of a strategic transformation journey focused on Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Agentic Service Platforms.
  • Work alongside experienced architects, consultants, and technology leaders.
  • Engage directly with business leaders and influence enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Gain exposure to emerging technologies including Salesforce, Agentforce, AI-driven service experiences, and enterprise automation.
  • Join a growing organization where your ideas, leadership, and customer-centric mindset will have a direct impact.
  • Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model from Kochi, Bangalore, or Hyderabad.
Join Us
If you are a customer-focused Senior Business Analyst who enjoys engaging with senior stakeholders, driving requirements from concept to delivery, and acting as the trusted bridge between business and technology, wed love to hear from you. Join us and help shape the future of Conversational, AI-powered Enterprise Service Management on Salesforce.

description:

title: LEAD DATA PRODUCT ENGINEER
description:
Job description: Lead Data Product Engineer


1. Role overview


The Lead Data Product Engineer will provide technical direction, hands-on engineering leadership, and stakeholder leadership for the project. The role combines the responsibilities of a Technical Lead and Data Architect with active, hands-on data engineering. The Lead will guide the engineering delivery team in line with technical standards.


The Lead will use deep technical knowledge to guide delivery teams, challenge assumptions, assess design quality, manage dependencies, identify risks, and support informed decision-making. They must be able to explain processes, issues, and Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) to stakeholders from a business-outcome and KPI perspective, not only from a platform or engineering perspective.


Role type: Lead role leading the engineering delivery. This is not a line-management role.


Experience: 8-10 years as a Lead Data Product Engineer in the Life Sciences / Pharma Commercial domain.


Expected balance of the role:


The Lead Data Product Engineer is expected to perform all three of the following areas and must demonstrate a strong balance across them:


Technical leadership and hands-on engineering: design, build, review, and optimise data products and pipelines, and lead engineering delivery.

Stakeholder management: act as the primary point of contact and engage confidently with business stakeholders at a KPI and business-outcome level.

Governance, documentation, and transition support: provide oversight to ensure the solution is documented, governed, and supportable.


2. Technology and domain context


Platform and tooling:


Orchestration: Apache Airflow

Cloud: AWS

Data platforms: Databricks and Snowflake

Source control: Bitbucket

Reporting: Power BI (primary visualisation layer)

Architecture: Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) is already implemented. The Lead is responsible for owning, maintaining, enhancing, and, where required, redesigning it.

Business domain:


Claims data and commercial performance data, including PP and NPP KPIs and their business context

Field team data, and how commercial stakeholders use it for reporting

3. Key responsibilities


Technical leadership and engineering delivery


Provide technical leadership and direction across the project and lead engineering delivery in line with AZ technical standards.

Hands-on design, development, and optimisation of data pipelines and data products on Airflow, Databricks, and Snowflake.

Own the Medallion Architecture, ensuring the purpose and boundaries of each layer are clear and consistently applied.

Review and challenge proposed architecture, data flows, integration approaches, data models, and reporting solutions.

Design and manage Airflow workflows, including orchestration, scheduling, dependencies, refresh mechanisms, and operational management of pipelines.

Define and apply data partitioning strategies to improve scalability and performance.

Review delivery plans and technical designs to confirm that data movement from source systems to reporting layers is feasible and appropriately controlled.


Data modelling, business rules, and reporting


Review proposed data models using knowledge of facts, dimensions, data grain, relationships, KPIs, and aggregation logic.

Confirm that business rules and metric definitions (including PP and NPP KPIs) are clearly understood, consistently applied, and traceable to agreed requirements.

Review data lineage, dependencies, ownership, and downstream consumption of Gold-layer datasets in Power BI.

Assess the impact of changes to source systems, pipelines, transformation logic, Gold-layer datasets, semantic models, and reports.


Issue investigation and RCA


Coordinate the investigation of data discrepancies, refresh failures, performance issues, and delivery concerns.

Create RCA documents for issues identified across source, transformation, and reporting layers.

Ensure technical issues are assigned to the correct owners and progressed to resolution.

Stakeholder management


Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders and the business.

Build effective relationships with business representatives, commercial and field stakeholders, product owners, delivery leads, data engineers, architects, Power BI teams, suppliers, and support teams.

Translate technical considerations into clear impacts, risks, options, and recommendations.

Communicate complex topics clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge.

Manage expectations by explaining what is known, what remains uncertain, and what decisions are required.

Identify technical risks, cross-team dependencies, assumptions, and delivery blockers early.

Governance and transition to business-as-usual (BAU)


Assess whether the solution is technically and operationally ready for transition into BAU support.

Maintain full knowledge of the required transition artefacts: architecture diagrams, data lineage, runbooks, monitoring, SLAs, support models, ownership, and data quality rules.

Identify readiness gaps and agree remediation plans with delivery and operational stakeholders.

Provide a clear recommendation: ready for transition, ready with agreed risks, or not ready for sign-off.


4. Required knowledge and skills


Data architecture and engineering


Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) and the implications of each layer

Data lineage, source-to-target dependencies, ownership, and downstream consumption

ETL and ELT patterns, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, scheduling, and refresh mechanisms

Apache Airflow: workflow design, orchestration, and operational management

Databricks: architecture, engineering practices, and hands-on implementation

Snowflake: architecture, platform capabilities, and data engineering best practices

Data partitioning strategies for scalability and performance optimisation

Common pipeline failure points, data quality issues, integration risks, and operational dependencies

End-to-end data flow from source systems through transformation layers to reporting and analytics

AWS cloud services and Bitbucket-based code management

Data modelling and reporting


Fact and dimension tables, data grain, relationships, keys, measures, and aggregation logic

KPI definitions, business rules, semantic models, and consumption of Gold-layer datasets by Power BI

Investigating data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues

Producing RCA documentation across source, transformation, and reporting layers

Domain knowledge (life sciences / pharma commercial)


Claims data and commercial performance data, including PP and NPP KPIs and their business context

How field teams operate and how commercial stakeholders use field data for reporting

Ability to engage at a business outcome and KPI level

Technical leadership and governance


Experience reviewing solution documentation, delivery plans, operational models, support arrangements, and transition artefacts

Understanding of risks from incomplete documentation, unclear ownership, insufficient monitoring, weak data quality controls, and unsupported dependencies

Ability to make balanced recommendations based on technical evidence, business impact, delivery constraints, and operational risk

Stakeholder and delivery management


Proven experience working with senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary delivery teams

Ability to influence outcomes without direct line management responsibility

Experience managing expectations, resolving ambiguity, facilitating decisions, and communicating risks

Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting technical information to non-technical audiences


5. Desired abilities


Fact-based approach and an eager-to-learn mindset

Credible technical direction, acting as the businesss point of contact

Ability to explain bronze, silver, and gold architecture implications to both technical and business audiences

Effective challenge of data engineering, modelling, reporting, and integration proposals

Early identification of risks and dependencies before they become delivery or operational issues

Clear understanding and assurance of business rules, KPI definitions, data lineage, and ownership

Coordination of stakeholders and technical teams to reach timely, well-informed decisions

Confidence-building that the solution is supportable, governed, documented, and transition-ready

Clear communication of readiness recommendations at each project stage


6. Qualifications and experience summary


Experience: 8-10 years as a Lead Data Product Engineer


Industry: Life Sciences / Pharma Commercial domain


Core platforms: Airflow, AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, Bitbucket


Reporting: Power BI


Architecture: Medallion Architecture (existing; ownership and evolution required)


Role type: Lead engineering delivery, hands-on, no line management


Role balance: Strong balance across technical leadership and hands-on engineering, stakeholder management, and governance and transition support

title: Research Data Modeler
description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Research Data Modeler to design, build, deploy, and maintain reliable, scalable, and governed research data pipelines and reusable data products supporting Research Discovery, translational science, analytics, reporting, AI, and scientific decision-making.
Working with Research scientists, Data Product Owners, Domain Data Architects, Data Governance Specialists, Data Scientists, and Platform Engineers, this role transforms raw scientific and laboratory data into trusted assets on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform across Astellas medallion architecture.
The successful candidate will combine strong data modeling expertise with knowledge of pharmaceutical Research and Discovery data and an ability to facilitate alignment among scientific, business, governance, architecture, engineering, and AI stakeholders.


Responsibilities and Accountabilities
  • Design and maintain conceptual, canonical, logical, semantic, and physical data models for Research and Discovery data products.
  • Translate scientific, experimental, and business requirements into reusable enterprise information models.
  • Define core Research entities, attributes, identifiers, relationships, hierarchies, experimental context, events, and scientific business rules.
  • Establish canonical representations across laboratories, research sites, source systems, external providers, and data products.
  • Model structured, semi-structured, unstructured, and multimodal scientific data while preserving provenance and experimental context.
  • Ensure models support scientific analysis, advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, knowledge graphs, and application integration.
  • Apply relational, dimensional, graph, document, event-based, and other modeling techniques based on scientific and technical requirements.
  • Maintain clear separation between source-aligned models, canonical domain models, governed data products, and consumption-specific assets.
  • Work with the Domain Data Architect and Data Product Owners to translate the approved domain data product roadmap into actionable modeling deliverables.
  • Define the information models needed to support planned data products, use cases, releases, and AI capabilities.
  • Identify common entities and reusable modeling components that can serve multiple data products.
  • Sequence modeling work based on product priorities, source dependencies, governance readiness, and engineering needs.
  • Provide modeling estimates, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and decisions required for product delivery.
  • Participate in backlog refinement and help define modeling stories


Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor s or master s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Management, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Five or more years of experience in data modeling, information architecture, data architecture, analytics engineering, or enterprise data management.
  • Experience working with research data, research data platforms, and pipelines
  • Demonstrated experience developing conceptual, logical, canonical, dimensional, semantic, and physical data models.
  • Strong knowledge of relational modeling, normalization, dimensional modeling, entity-relationship modeling, and metadata management.
  • Experience translating complex scientific requirements into reusable information models.
  • Experience defining entities, relationships, identifiers, hierarchies, reference data, and business rules.
  • Experience collaborating with architects, Product Owners, engineers, Governance Specialists, and business subject matter experts.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences Research and Discovery.
  • Knowledge of one or more Research areas such as discovery biology, target biology, medicinal chemistry, compound and assay data, translational science, or preclinical research.
  • Experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, or comparable cloud data and metadata platforms.
  • Experience with data modeling tools such as ER/Studio, erwin, SAP PowerDesigner, Hackolade, or comparable solutions.
  • Experience with scientific ontologies, knowledge graphs, controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, or semantic modeling.
  • Familiarity with Genie, natural-language analytics, semantic layers, or AI agent enablement.
  • Familiarity with FAIR data principles and scientific data provenance.

We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas Responsible Flexibility Guidelines. Global collaboration and limited travel may be required.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We seek a deeply hands-on senior infrastructure engineer to assess and stabilize complex data-center platforms, identify technical risk and implement durable remediation. The role requires both infrastructure operations expertise and the ability to design enterprise storage, backup/recovery, hardware-refresh and hybrid-cloud solutions. The engineer must convert incomplete current-state information into defensible technical decisions and lead approved changes; routine ticket support is a secondary responsibility.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Assess the estate and remove critical risk

  • Lead hands-on technical assessment of VMware ESXi/vCenter clusters, host/VM dependencies, Windows Server and RHEL/Linux workloads; interrogate configuration, health, patch levels, hardware supportability, capacity headroom and single points of failure rather than relying only on inventory lists.
  • Examine SAN/NAS and scale-out platforms including Qumulo, Pure Storage, HPE Nimble/Alletra and Dell enterprise storage. Validate NFS/SMB, iSCSI/FC, multipathing, snapshots, replication, capacity/IOPS/latency, protocol compatibility and performance constraints for application and imaging data.
  • Map service-to-VM-to-host-to-storage-to-backup dependencies; reconstruct missing architecture diagrams and technical runbooks; prioritize risks by likelihood, service impact and remediation feasibility, with specific engineering options and rollback paths.

Engineer stabilization, patching and recoverability

  • Own complex Windows/Linux and virtualization remediation: WSUS/MECM or equivalent patch workflows, AD/GPO-related hardening, Linux package and kernel patching, ESXi lifecycle upgrades, maintenance windows, workload validation and tested rollback.
  • Assess and improve protection with Rubrik, Commvault or equivalent platforms: policy-to-workload coverage, backup job health, immutable/off-site copies, retention, ransomware recovery, snapshot consistency and actual restore performance against defined RPO/RTO.
  • Design and technically lead backup/storage movement between facilities, including replication or seeded-copy strategy, delta synchronization, integrity checks, chain-of-custody where applicable, recovery-site dependencies and failback/rollback criteria.

Design modernization, refresh and migration

  • Translate capacity and lifecycle evidence into server, virtualization and storage refresh designs: host sizing, HA/N+1, shared-storage topology, storage tiering, compatibility matrices, OEM BOM validation, cutover sequencing and selective investment vs consolidation trade-offs.
  • Architect hybrid/cloud migration options on Google Cloud using relevant services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Filestore, Storage Transfer Service and Transfer Appliance where appropriate; validate data-transfer throughput, metadata/ACL handling, checksum/reconciliation, cost and restore/retrieval behavior.
  • Engineer large-scale file and image-archive migrations with the network/security team: classify hot/cold data, differentiate backup copies from primary datasets, plan bulk transfer plus delta cutover, and validate clinical/application data integrity before system retirement.
  • Develop feasible data-center footprint-reduction options using workload dependencies, VM consolidation, storage reclamation, contract/support expiry and decommission sequencing; show which physical assets and recurring costs can be released.

JOB DESCRIPTION Recruitment profile • Senior individual-contributor engineering role

Technical ownership and collaboration

  • Provide practical design authority for assigned changes: high-/low-level designs, test and back-out plans, proof-of-concept evidence, vendor/OEM technical evaluation, troubleshooting of cross-stack failures, and handover to the run team.
  • Partner with network, security and solution architecture teams to shape an operable future-state data center and managed-service transition, contributing validated asset, risk, skill/coverage and recovery information; retain personal accountability for hands-on technical decisions.
  • Handle priority operational escalations and major-incident stabilization where needed; routine ticket handling is secondary to assessment, remediation and engineering improvements.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in enterprise infrastructure engineering, including substantial personal responsibility for production design, migrations, upgrades and issue resolution in highly available data centers.
  • Expertise in VMware ESXi/vCenter, x86 virtualization/compute, Windows Server, Active Directory/GPO and enterprise Linux (RHEL or equivalent), including complex patching and upgrade risk management.
  • Demonstrated engineering across enterprise block/file storage: Qumulo or comparable scale-out NAS, plus exposure to Pure Storage, HPE Nimble/Alletra and/or Dell arrays; strong NFS/SMB/iSCSI/FC, snapshots, replication and capacity/performance diagnostics.
  • Strong experience with Rubrik, Commvault or equivalent backup platforms and with designing, executing and validating infrastructure restores, DR replication and failure scenarios.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Google Cloud storage/compute options, secure hybrid migration, dataset integrity verification and the network/storage interactions that constrain large data transfers.
  • Practical scripting and repeatable deployment skills using PowerShell, Bash, Ansible, Terraform or similar tools, plus documented change/rollback discipline.
  • Ability to challenge vendor refresh sizing and propose workable technical architectures, migration methods and infrastructure retirement decisions from imperfect source data.

PREFERRED / DIFFERENTIATING EXPERIENCE

  • Direct hands-on experience with multi-petabyte NAS/object/file data, large-scale replication, tiering, archive modernization and high-throughput bulk transfers.
  • Experience supporting healthcare imaging environments, including PACS/RIS, DICOM/DICOMweb storage and retrieval, HL7 interface dependencies, clinical data retention and validation requirements.
  • Qumulo administration/engineering; Pure FlashArray, HPE Alletra/Nimble, Dell PowerStore/PowerScale; Rubrik/Commvault; GCP migration certifications or comparable real-world delivery.
  • Experience reducing data-center footprint through technical consolidation and decommissioning, with evidence of operational continuity and released costs.

The Regional Manager Provider Recruitment is responsible for the day-to-day operational leadership and management of the Provider Recruitment function. This role provides oversight of recruitment activities, workflows, team performance, candidate engagement, and provider onboarding processes to ensure an efficient, consistent, and high-quality experience for candidates, providers, and internal stakeholders.

    • Use recruitment data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring intervention.

title: Senior Postdoctoral Fellow
description:
Senior Postdoctoral Fellow - Precision Immunorads


Exciting opportunity immediately available for an accomplished and highly motivated Senior Postdoctoral Fellow to join the Precision Immunorads Group led by Dr. Constantinos Koumenis (International Group Leader) at the Cyprus Cancer Research Institute (CCRI), Nicosia, Cyprus. The research programme is supported by an ERC Synergy Grant and involves collaborations with the University of Heidelberg, Germany, and the University of Pennsylvania, USA.

The Cyprus Cancer Research Institute (CCRI) is a non-for-profit research institute based in Nicosia, Cyprus. It was established to advance cancer research in Cyprus and the wider region, bringing together leading universities and clinical partners. Its modern research building provides laboratory space and core facilities to support impactful research for patients in the Eastern Mediterranean and beyond.

Reports To:

The post holder will report to Dr. Constantinos Koumenis (International Group Leader).

Job Overview

The successful applicant will lead independent projects investigating how radiotherapy and cellular stress responses shape the tumour microenvironment and anti-tumour immunity, and will identify new targets for CAR-T cell therapy of solid tumours. The Senior Postdoctoral Fellow will contribute to the scientific direction of the group, mentor junior researchers and collaborate with international partner institutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and lead independent research projects using in vitro models, mouse tumour models and patient-derived samples (organoids).
  • Apply spectral flow cytometry, CRISPR-based genetic manipulation, single-cell and bulk transcriptomics, and in vivo pharmacology.
  • Analyse and interpret research data and publish findings in high-impact peer-reviewed journals.
  • Write and contribute to competitive grant and fellowship applications to European and local funding agencies
  • Supervise and train PhD students, research assistants and undergraduate researchers.
  • Present research at international conferences and contribute to laboratory management and day-to-day operations.

Qualifications:

  • PhD or MD/PhD in cancer biology, immunology, molecular biology or a related field.
  • At least two years of postdoctoral research experience and a strong first-author publication record.

Desirable specialist knowledge and skills:

  • Hands-on experience with in vivo tumour models and immunological techniques is a major advantage.
  • Experience in stress signalling, metabolism or radiation/therapy response.
  • A track record of securing independent research funding or fellowships.

Personal attributes:

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and bring research projects to completion.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, mentor junior researchers and contribute to a dynamic research team.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Employment Type

Fixed-term contract: The position is offered on a fixed-term contract basis for a total duration of up to three (3) years. Initially, a one-year contract will be offered, including a six-month probationary period, with the possibility of renewal for up to two additional years, subject to satisfactory performance and the Institute’s requirements. The gross monthly salary will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience.

Location: Nicosia, Cyprus

Remuneration: Competitive salary of €34,000 – €40,000 yearly (€2830 – €3330 monthly) gross, depending on experience and qualifications.

Closing Date: March 15, 2027

Application Procedure:

All applicants should submit the following documents as a single PDF to this address: https://www.ccri.org.cy/open-senior-postdoctoral-fellow-precision-immunorads/

The PDF must include the following:

  • A cover letter (maximum two pages) describing research achievements and interest in the position.
  • A full Curriculum Vitae (CV), including a publication list.
  • Names and contact details of three referees.

For informal inquiries about the research project you may visit the Lab’s page at CCRI:

https://groups.ccri.org.cy/pir/

title: Compliance Engineer Radioactive Waste Conditioning
description:
Onze vaste partner Belgoprocess is binnen België verantwoordelijk voor het ontmantelen van radioactieve gebouwen en installaties, en het verwerken en opslaan van het hieruit voortkomend afval. Voor de optimalisatie en operationele werking van de processen te borgen, zijn we op zoek naar een Compliance Ingenieur voor conditioneringstechnieken van radioactief afval.


Tijdens het conditioneringsproces wordt het radioactief afval, dat vaak al gedeeltelijk behandeld is, ingekapseld in een stabiliserende matrix van glas, cement of bitumen. Deze matrix zorgt ervoor dat de radioactieve deeltjes veilig worden vastgehouden waarna het ingekapselde afval verpakt wordt in stalen vaten. Zodra deze stap is voltooid, wordt het afval beschouwd als geconditioneerd en klaar voor verdere opslag of verwerking. Je zorgt op een onderbouwde en traceerbare manier ervoor dat de gebruikte conditioneringstechnieken en de daaruit voortvloeiende eindproducten voldoen aan de geldende kwaliteits- en acceptatiecriteria.


Wat ga je doen?


  • Opstellen, beheren en actualiseren van erkennings- en technische dossiers rond conditioneringstechnieken.
  • Verzamelen, structureren en verwerken van technische gegevens, analyseresultaten en kwaliteitsinformatie.
  • Technisch onderbouwen van de conformiteit van processen en eindproducten met geldende normen, eisen en acceptatiecriteria.
  • Bewaken van volledigheid, correctheid, consistentie en traceerbaarheid binnen dossiers en erkenningstrajecten.
  • Ondersteunen van kwaliteitsborging door QA/QC-resultaten te interpreteren, afwijkingen te beoordelen en compliance te verifiëren.
  • Analyseren en interpreteren van laboratoriumtesten en technische onderzoeken, in samenwerking met technische experts.
  • Vertalen van testresultaten naar technisch onderbouwde conclusies, nota’s en erkenningsdossiers.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van expertise inzake conditioneringstechnieken, materiaaleigenschappen, normen en regelgeving.
  • Fungeren als inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor verschillende interne stakeholders.


Wat breng je mee?


  • Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in een technisch-wetenschappelijke richting, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Je hebt minstens enkele jaren relevante werkervaring met QA/QC, kwaliteitsdossiers, validatie, kwalificatie of erkenningsdossiers in een technische en/of sterk gereglementeerde omgeving.
  • Je beschikt over voldoende chemisch en technisch inzicht om processen, materialen, analyses en testresultaten te begrijpen en kritisch te beoordelen.
  • Kennis van cementchemie, mortels, betontechnologie of conditioneringstechnieken is een pluspunt, maar geen absolute vereiste wanneer je bereid bent je hierin verder te verdiepen.
  • Je kan technische informatie analyseren, structureren en vertalen naar duidelijke en goed onderbouwde dossiers.
  • Binnen de nucleaire sector kennen projecten doorgaans een lange doorlooptijd van vele jaren, wat goed aansluit bij jouw toekomstvisie.


Wat bieden wij?


Dankzij onze persoonlijke aanpak en doorgedreven technische kennis willen we jou de ideale springplank bieden voor jouw carrière. Hierdoor kun je jouw expertise en kennis in jouw vakgebied aanzienlijk uitbreiden, terwijl je blijft doen wat je het liefste doet.

title: IS Senior Security Consultant
description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.


Role
Senior Security Consultant


EY Technology
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:
  • Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  • Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) - EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  • Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


The opportunity
As a Security Consultant within EY's internal Global Information Security team, the individual will be a trusted security advisor to the Client Technology Platforms Delivery organization within IT Services. The Client Technology Platforms delivery organization is responsible for end-to-end delivery of technology programs and projects supporting EY's Client Technology service lines including delivery of a global managed services platform, big data and analytics solutions as well as individual line of business solutions and services. This role will directly engage in supporting a team of architects, engineers, and product managers for delivery on programs and projects, defining security risks and control, providing security guidance, identifying and prioritizing security-related requirements, promoting secure-by-default designs and facilitating delivery of information security services throughout the system development life cycle (SDLC). The role will also develop and directly communicate appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security vulnerabilities translated vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for communication to business stakeholders.


Your key responsibilities
  • Support a technical team with a focus on the following responsibilities:
  • Provide security architectures and provide pragmatic security guidance that balance business benefit and risks.
  • Engage IT project teams throughout the SDLC to identify and prioritize applicable security controls and provide guidance on how to implement these controls
  • Perform threat modeling and risk assessments of information systems, applications and infrastructure
  • Maintain and enhance the Information Security risk assessment and certification methodologies
  • Define security configuration standards for shared and multi-tenant platforms and technologies
  • Develop appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security risks identified during security review or audit
  • Translate technical vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for business units and recommend corrective actions to customers and project stakeholders
  • Provide knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
  • Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) in responsible technologies and have deep technical understanding of responsible services and technology portfolios


Skills and attributes for success
Significant working security experience and knowledge in the design, implementation, and operation of security controls in one of the following areas:
  • Cloud Security Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud-based solutions e.g., Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services or another cloud platform (GCP, AWS, IBM, AliCloud, etc.)
  • Infrastructure Security Experience with the integration of cloud native infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity access management, Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), Application and API Gateways, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
  • Application Security - Experience with the design and testing of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and microservices architecture.
  • Identity and Access Management Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design and integration with API, IDaaS, and Federation technologies.
  • Agile DevSecOps Methodologies Experience promoting automated security features in pipelines and security testing as a central feature in Agile workflows as a contributing member within an Agile development or DevOps environment.
Although not required, it is preferred that candidates possess additional working security experience and knowledge in one or more of the following areas:
  • Operational Security Experience with defining operational security models and procedures for business solutions including the operation and maintenance of infrastructure and application security controls.
  • Information Security Standards Knowledge of common information security standards such as: ISO 27001/27002, CSA and CIS Controls, NIST CSF, PCI/DSS, FEDRAMP.
  • Product Management working with broader business and technology teams on aspects of security that affect all phases of PI Planning from concept to design to implementation and then operational support.


To qualify for the role you must have:
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
  • Candidates are preferred to hold or be actively pursuing related professional certifications within the GIAC family of certifications or CISSP, CISM or CISA or similar cloud-security oriented certifications.
  • Five or more years of experience in the management of a significant Information Security risk management function
  • Experience in managing the communication of security findings and recommendations to IT project teams, business leadership and technology management executives


Ideally, you'll also have
  • Exceptional judgment, tact, and decision-making ability
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Excellent, communication, organizational, and decision-making skills
  • Strong English language skills are required

title: Business Analytics Advisor - HIH - Evernorth
description:
INTRODUCTION TO EVERNORTH:

Evernorth Health Services India, established in Hyderabad in 2024, is an innovation hub for Evernorth Health Services, the pharmacy, care and benefits division of The Cigna Group. The innovation hub will support innovation-focused areas, such as generative AI, product development, process improvement, analytics, and software engineering across The Cigna Group and its businesses. Evernorth Health Services India builds on The Cigna Group s existing presence in India.

About Evernorth Health Services:

Evernorth Health Services (Evernorth) is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group - a Fortune 16 global health company with 75,000 employees, 186 million customers in more than 30 countries and jurisdictions around the world. Evernorth exists to make the prediction, prevention, and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. We do this by creating and connecting premier health services offerings, such as benefits management, pharmacy, care solutions, insights and intelligence.

About Cigna:

The Cigna Group is a global health company committed to improving the health and vitality of individuals and communities around the world and includes products and services marketed under its Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services subsidiaries. Cigna Healthcare is the health benefits provider of The Cigna Group, serving customers and clients through its U.S. Employer, U.S. Government, and International Health business. Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an Advisor, Business Analytics to join our Prospect Analytics team in Hyderabad.

In this role, you will use healthcare and pharmacy data to answer meaningful business questions, identify trends and opportunities, and develop insights that support prospective client opportunities and business decisions.

You will work across the analytical lifecycle, from understanding the business question and evaluating incoming data to developing analyses, validating results, and communicating what the findings mean.

This is an opportunity for an analyst who wants to build deeper expertise at the intersection of healthcare, analytics, technology, and business strategy, while gaining exposure to complex analytical challenges and collaborating with experienced colleagues across the organization.

What youll do

Analyze complex healthcare and pharmacy data

  • Perform analyses supporting prospective client opportunities, RFPs, and other business needs.
  • Work with large healthcare and pharmacy datasets to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and opportunities.
  • Assess source data for completeness, consistency, and usability.
  • Transform, validate, and analyze data using established analytical methodologies and business rules.
  • Investigate unexpected results and resolve data-quality or analytical issues.
  • Document analytical methods, assumptions, business rules, and findings.
  • Produce accurate, reproducible, and decision-ready analytical outputs.

Turn analysis into insight

  • Analyze healthcare utilization, population characteristics, cost drivers, and pharmacy trends.
  • Support analyses involving pharmacy utilization, formulary considerations, member disruption, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, and clinical trends.
  • Look beyond individual metrics to identify relationships and meaningful patterns within the data.
  • Work with subject-matter experts to understand the healthcare and business context behind analytical results.
  • Translate findings into clear observations and implications that business partners can understand and use.

Solve analytical problems

  • Translate defined business questions into structured analytical approaches.
  • Apply sound analytical judgment when working with incomplete or complex datasets.
  • Identify inconsistencies or unusual results and investigate potential causes.
  • Determine when established approaches can be applied and when a problem requires additional investigation or escalation.
  • Balance analytical rigor, business priorities, and delivery expectations.

Build scalable analytics

  • Identify opportunities to make recurring analytical work more efficient and consistent.
  • Develop and maintain reusable workflows, queries, datasets, reports, and analytical components.
  • Help automate manual analytical and data-processing activities.
  • Contribute to documentation, quality controls, and analytical standards.
  • Work with platforms and technologies such as SQL, Python, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, Databricks, AWS, PostgreSQL, or Teradata, depending on the analytical need.
  • Explore responsible uses of automation and AI to improve productivity, quality, and insight generation.

Collaborate across the business

  • Partner with colleagues across Analytics, Sales, Clinical, Underwriting, Product, Finance, Data, and Technology.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to understand the business need behind an analytical request.
  • Clearly explain findings, methodologies, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Present analyses in concise, business-friendly formats.
  • Incorporate feedback from technical experts, business partners, and analytical leaders.
  • Develop trusted relationships through responsiveness, analytical quality, and follow-through.

Continue developing your expertise

  • Build deeper knowledge of healthcare, pharmacy benefits, claims data, and prospective-client analytics.
  • Strengthen technical capabilities and analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Learn from more experienced analysts and subject-matter experts.
  • Share new techniques, findings, and lessons with colleagues.
  • Stay curious about developments in healthcare, analytics, automation, and AI.

What youll bring

Required qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent practical experience in analytics, data science, statistics, economics, computer science, engineering, pharmacy, public health, business, or a related discipline.
  • 11-13 years of experience
  • Professional experience in business analytics, healthcare analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, claims analytics, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL or comparable analytical querying tools.
  • Experience working with large or complex datasets.
  • Understanding of data transformation, validation, data quality, analytical workflows, reporting, or visualization.
  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, health insurance, pharmacy benefits, life sciences, healthcare consulting, or claims analytics.
  • Experience analyzing medical or pharmacy claims, healthcare utilization, or healthcare cost data.
  • Exposure to RFPs, pricing, underwriting, sales analytics, client analytics, US Pharmacy business or commercially focused analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more technologies such as Python, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, Databricks, AWS, PostgreSQL, or Teradata.
  • Knowledge of pharmacy utilization, specialty pharmacy, formulary, pharmacy-network, or member-disruption analytics.
  • Experience creating reusable analytical workflows or automating recurring processes.
  • Advanced education or professional development in an analytical, technical, healthcare, or related discipline.

What will help you succeed

Youre curious about the data.
When something looks unusual, you want to understand why.

You care about accuracy.
You recognize that an analytical result has to be trustworthy before it can influence a business decision.

You connect details to the bigger picture.
You want to understand the business question behind an analysis, not simply complete the requested output.

Youre comfortable solving problems.
You can work through complex data and imperfect information systematically.

You communicate clearly.
You can make analytical findings understandable to people who dont spend their day working with data.

Youre willing to challenge assumptions.
When the evidence points in a different direction, you investigate and raise the question constructively.

You look for better ways to work.
When a process is repetitive or unnecessarily manual, you look for opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate it.

Youre committed to learning.
You want to deepen your knowledge of healthcare, pharmacy, analytics, technology, automation, and AI.

Why join us

This role provides an opportunity to build a career at the intersection of healthcare, analytics, technology, and business decision-making.

You will work with complex healthcare and pharmacy data, solve real analytical problems, learn from experienced business and technical professionals, and develop insights that help support prospective client opportunities.

Youll also have the opportunity to develop expertise that goes beyond technical execution by learning how to connect data to insight, insight to business context, and analytical work to better decisions.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.

About Evernorth Health Services

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Data Analyst
description:
1. Role Overview

We are seeking a high-caliber, analytical Data Analyst to join our specialized Managed Service Provider (MSP) practice dedicated to a premier End-User Computing (EUC) Product OEM. In this high-visibility role, you will serve as the primary data and analytical bridge to the OEM's US-based Senior Point of Contact (SPOC) and executive leadership team, operating in US Eastern/Pacific time zones. You will govern data analysis across our portfolio of 100+ enterprise clients covering Design, Build, and Run services. Leveraging advanced Excel (XLS), AI-driven analytics tools, and business intelligence platforms, you will transform complex operational ticketing, customer wins, churn risk factors, NPS scores, and revenue impact metrics into actionable strategic insights that drive retention and account growth.

2. Key Responsibilities

  • US Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration: Partner directly with the OEM's US-based Senior Point of Contact (SPOC), regional directors, and customer success leaders to define analytical requirements, deliver ad-hoc reports, and present data-backed recommendations in US working hours.
  • Ticket & Operational Analytics: Analyze 24/7 service desk ticketing datasets (Incident, Problem, Change) across 100+ enterprise accounts.
  • Customer Wins & Pipeline Tracking: Monitor and report on new client onboarding, account expansion wins, and project milestone achievements..
  • Churn Risk Modeling & Retention Intelligence: Develop predictive churn models and early-warning indicators by correlating support ticket volumes, severity escalation rates, and CSAT scores with contract renewal cycles.
  • NPS & Customer Experience (CX) Analytics: Synthesize customer feedback, CSAT surveys, and Net Promoter Score (NPS) trends across accounts. Map sentiment analytics against service delivery performance to quantify the direct impact of support quality on client loyalty.
  • Revenue Impact & Commercial Linkage: Bridge operational data with financial performance by tracking revenue realization.
  • Executive Dashboarding & AI-Driven Insight Generation: Design, build, and maintain real-time executive dashboards and automated reporting suites. Utilize AI-driven analytics tools and advanced Excel models to uncover hidden patterns and deliver predictive insights.

3. Required Skills & Technical Competencies

  • Advanced Excel & Modeling (XLS/XLSX): Mastery of advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, complex formulas (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH), VBA/Macros, financial modeling, and dynamic data consolidation for rapid ad-hoc analyses required by US stakeholders.
  • AI-Driven Analytics & Modern Tools: Hands-on experience leveraging AI-powered data analytics assistants, automated insight generators, and machine learning libraries (Python/SQL) to accelerate data processing and predictive modeling.
  • Data Visualization & BI Platforms: Demonstrated expertise in building interactive executive dashboards using Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or Google Looker Studio, integrating multi-source datasets (ITSM tools like ServiceNow/Jira and ERP/Billing systems).
  • Domain & Business Acumen: Deep understanding of IT Managed Services (MSP) business models, ITIL service management frameworks, and End-User Computing (EUC) concepts (VDI, DaaS, Workspace management).

4. Candidate Profile & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Information Technology, or a quantitative business discipline.
  • Experience: 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Operations Analyst within an IT Managed Services Provider (MSP), SaaS organization, or Enterprise Technology environment.
  • Work Schedule Flexibility: Willingness to work in US time zones (Evening/Night shifts from India) to ensure seamless real-time collaboration with the OEM's US-based leadership.
  • Communication & Presentation: Exceptional interpersonal and data-storytelling skills with the ability to present complex analytical findings clearly to senior US stakeholders.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job description

The Principal Business Analyst possesses in-depth knowledge of the business domain, relevant technologies, and organizational strategy to provide holistic, enterprise-wide consulting advice. In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of interconnected systems, overseeing initiatives with full autonomy and leading analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation.

Description of the area

Within RDT Pharma Technical Operations and specifically in the context of Manufacturing Technologies, this Solution Architect for Process Data ensures the seamless fit of our manufacturing business solutions into the Roche ecosystem. This is crucial for implementing and running stable, robust, and highly performing solutions while maximizing the return on investment (ROI) on our manufacturing data. The Process Data area is part of the digital backbone of our production environment, ensuring that complex scientific processes are translated into reliable, executable, and reportable digital formats.

Our scope includes:

  • Process Parameter Definition Tracking: Ensuring the precision and integrity of data that defines our manufacturing steps.

  • Enterprise Recipe Management: Orchestrating the blueprints for our medicines across different sites to ensure consistency and scalability.

  • Data Historian Solutions: Managing the high-frequency, real-time data streams from the shop floor to enable deep analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous process improvement.

  • Shop-Floor Data Accessibility: Streamlining the extraction and availability of raw manufacturing data to ensure it is readily accessible for higher-level systems, analytics, and operational decision-making.

Job Responsibilities

  • Scope / (Content Leadership): Oversees initiatives or streams with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale. Defines and leads analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces, navigates complex frameworks, and delegates work while managing the quality of business analysis content.

  • Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, defining the problem space and driving comprehensive root cause analysis that may span organizational boundaries. Proactively prevents scope creep, manages the complexity of various scopes of change, and is ultimately accountable for business analysis deliverables ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives.

  • Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders, including management, across organizational boundaries. Shapes strategy as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and empowers teams in stakeholder management.

  • Impact/Strategy: Drives significant impact on projects and programs by ensuring the delivery of high-value solutions that align with business strategy. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, including advanced value analysis and risk assessment, and actively shapes long-term roadmaps.

  • Complexity / (Product Size): Works typically on a product or product line level, effectively managing highly ambiguous and evolving requirements in dynamic environments. Demonstrates a holistic viewpoint to analyze problems, considering potential micro and macro implications across related domains.

  • Business / Technical ability: Uses in-depth knowledge of the business or technical domain and relevant technologies to inform business strategies. Leads the application of tools, principles, and techniques across complex and cross-functional initiatives, anticipating challenges and proactively integrating analysis into broader solution design.

  • Proven track record of recommending optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation and working on unusually complex problems with highly innovative solutions.

  • 2+ years of experience with pharmaceutical manufacturing IT solutions.

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of the product discovery and development lifecycle. Familiarity with GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations (GDPR).

title: Head of Digital, Data & Analytics
description:
Job Purpose\:

The Head Digital, Data & Analytics is accountable for the digital channels and the data, analytics and AI capabilities through which the Group advances its strategic priorities across Insurance, Investments, Regions and Shared Services. The role shapes the digital, data and analytics roadmap, recommends investment priorities through the Group's governance process, and owns delivery of the approved roadmap. Its purpose is to increase digital acquisition and servicing, improve customer experience and decision-making, reduce cost to serve, and deliver measurable business value within the Group's risk appetite.

The role provides leadership across the Group's Digital, Data & Analytics capability, bringing together digital product management, Business Analysis, UI/UX, software engineering, data engineering, analytics and AI disciplines under a single accountable function. It is responsible for converting approved priorities into secure, scalable and reliable digital products, trusted data and analytics, and appropriately governed AI capabilities that improve customer and business outcomes.

Performance is measured through digital adoption and transaction uplift, customer experience, cost-to-serve improvement, delivery quality and reliability, trusted and consistently governed Group data that improves reporting and decision-making, and measurable business value realised from analytics and AI.

Key responsibilities\:
A. Digital Product & Customer Experience
• Own the approved Group digital product roadmap, aligning products, channels and customer journeys to enterprise priorities across Insurance, Investments, Regions and Shared Services.
• Identify high-value digitization and digital product opportunities and develop business cases covering benefits, costs and expected outcomes to support prioritization and investment decisions.
• Lead the evolution of digital channels and customer-facing capabilities with clear product objectives, adoption measures and accountable business outcomes.
• Champion seamless, consistent and accessible journeys across web, mobile and other digital touchpoints, using customer insight and channel analytics to increase adoption, self-service and straight-through processing.
• Maintain digital channel performance measures covering adoption, conversion, availability, response time and customer experience to guide continuous improvement and investment.
• Drive digital adoption across priority journeys with business stakeholders and product owners, translating prioritized needs into product propositions, releases and measurable outcomes.
• Design digital capabilities for reuse and scale across markets where appropriate and recommend retirement or consolidation where duplication or cost is no longer justified.

B. Business Analysis, Discovery & UI/UX
• Lead the Business Analysis capability so prioritized demand is translated into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes, with analysts engaged early to reduce rework.
• Lead the UI/UX capability, maintaining consistent experience-design standards, the Group design system, user research, prototyping and usability testing before significant build investment.
• Maintain effective collaboration between Business Analysts, UI/UX, developers, data teams, business product owners and delivery teams throughout the product lifecycle.

C. Software Engineering & Technical Delivery
• Lead the Digital and Data engineering capability through the Principal Developer, partnering with the Head of Software Development on Group standards for solution design, coding, testing, documentation, integration and maintainability.
• Ensure Full-Stack Developers apply approved engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, DevSecOps, API-led integration and technical-debt management, improving delivery speed without compromising quality, security or supportability.
• Work with Enterprise Architecture to ensure digital, data and analytics solutions align to target-state architecture, integration standards and approved technology patterns.
• Embed secure-by-design and privacy-by-design with Cybersecurity, ensuring vulnerabilities and material control gaps are addressed before release.
• Promote reusable engineering components that reduce duplication and improve delivery efficiency across business lines and markets.

D. Data, Analytics & AI
• Lead the Group Data & Analytics capability through the Manager - Data & Analytics, ensuring trusted data and actionable insight, including approved AI use cases, support business, customer and operational decisions.
• Implement and continuously improve approved data governance practices covering ownership, quality, definitions, lineage, access and appropriate use of data.
• Drive trusted management information, dashboards and analytics that provide consistent measures of business performance and reduce competing versions of the truth.
• Work with business stakeholders to identify and deliver high-value analytics and AI use cases that improve growth, efficiency, customer experience and risk management within the Group's approved AI framework.
• Expand access to governed data and self-service analytics while maintaining security, privacy and data-quality controls; partner with Enterprise Architecture and Infrastructure & Cloud on scalable data platforms.
• Measure adoption and business value from data, analytics and AI products, and rationalize reports or data products that no longer add value.

E. Reliability, Release Readiness & Leadership
• Maintain visibility of the health, performance and reliability of customer-facing digital platforms and data services, working with Service Management and Infrastructure & Cloud to address recurring weaknesses and root causes.
• Work with the Head of Enterprise Delivery & Change Management to ensure material digital, data and analytics releases meet production-readiness, support, documentation, rollback and recovery requirements before go-live; own post-release stabilization until acceptance into Run.
• Assess delivery success beyond go-live through adoption, stability, performance, defect levels and achievement of intended business outcomes.
• Provide leadership, coaching and accountability to the three direct reports and wider multidisciplinary team, building capability and career pathways across Digital Product, Business Analysis, UI/UX, Software Engineering, Data and Analytics.
• Build a culture of customer focus, engineering excellence, data-driven decision-making, ownership, collaboration and continuous learning.
• Manage technology partners and vendors where required to support delivery outcomes, knowledge transfer and capability development.
• Ensure Digital, Engineering and Data activities comply with enterprise governance, architecture, cybersecurity, data privacy, risk and audit requirements, and provide clear executive reporting on performance, progress, outcomes, risks and decisions required.
