title: RMS-Independence-Supervising Analyst -AM 1
description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Career Family
Risk Management Services (Independence)

Role Type
Supervising Associate/Assistant Manager

Competency
AQIP / PCIP (Core) / Private Equity (Core)
Supervising Associate - Independence - Risk Management Services (RMS)
This role requires the candidate to build and demonstrate an in-depth technical knowledge of specific Independence support processes which are developed globally in accordance with the EY Global (EYG) Independence policies aimed towards safeguarding EY as an Independent auditor. These processes are standardized in nature and are performed by the RMS teams on behalf of EY engagement teams. The candidate will be responsible for coaching, mentoring and supervising a team of about 10-30 members on technical matters and should be able to handle and resolve their queries. The role also involves liaising with Global Independence process owners and a variety of stakeholders and end users across countries and geographies. The candidate is also expected to contribute to the GDS wide priorities and initiatives
and help in building a better working world for our EY professionals and team members.
The opportunity
Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Center of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.
This role will be part of the largest sub-service functions, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting client-serving teams in maintaining EY s Independence for its existing and prospective audit/non-audit clients.
Auditor Independence is a regulatory requirement that aims to create an arm s length distance between the Accounting Firm, its client serving employees and EY s audit clients. This is done to ensure that that EY Member Practices and their professionals should be (in fact) and should appear to be (in appearance) free from interests that might be regarded as being incompatible with objectivity, integrity, and impartiality of the audit.
RMS Independence team is currently 950+ people strong, operating from 3 countries and 5 centre s: India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in development of key Independence processes.
The role offers opportunities to work in a dynamic, growth-focused environment, with a special emphasis on protecting EY s reputation as an independent auditor, by providing support on niche profiles to EY member firm practices. It also involves close collaboration with global teams and stakeholders to strengthen the compliance framework and foster a mindset of continuous improvement and client enablement.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Expertise:
  • Being a subject matter expert in the process and possess strong understanding and ability to interpret client s company structure, applicability of different entity attributes and relationships in accordance with audit client and affiliate definition as per EYG Independence policy
  • Achieve mastery in the use of various internal Independence tools
  • Consistently drive team to deliver high-quality project outcomes by thoroughly understanding audit/pursuit team requirements and adhering to best practices and standard operating procedures
  • Expertise in performing secondary research using a wide range of internal and external databases
  • Effectively facilitate and implement process changes/updates, ensuring comprehensive knowledge sharing sessions are conducted
  • Establish strong credibility by consistently sharing deep insights and technical expertise, and actively engaging in high-level discussions with both engagement teams and stakeholders
  • Continuously develop and refine technical expertise in Independence processes, positioning oneself as a go-to subject matter expert within the team
  • Ensuring process documents and SOPs are updated periodically and approved timely.
  • Lead the process training schedules for new and existing members of the team
  • Effectively address resolve service delivery issues / escalations using tools like RCA (Root cause analysis) and CAPA (Corrective and preventive actions)
  • Conduct second level audits for reviewers in the team to ensure strong quality assurance model is maintained.
  • Act as an account manager for assigned accounts and effectively coordinate with the client serving teams to provide high quality deliverables and positive client experience.
  • Consistently evaluate current processes and propose innovative solutions or ideas to enhance efficiency and drive improvements.
  • Understand and work towards to meet/exceed the defined individual and team level KPIs for the role.
Client Management:
  • Maintain regular and proactive communication with audit/pursuit teams to keep them informed about project progress, potential issues and any changes in timelines or scope.
  • Conduct regular client satisfaction surveys to gauge their experience and identify areas for improvement.
  • Actively engage with Global Independence to implement any process changes, enhancements and improvements.
  • Develop effective conflict resolution and escalation management strategies to address and resolve any issues or escalations promptly and professionally.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to client management to ensure high standards of service delivery.
  • Act as a point of contact between the client teams, members of other Independence competencies, and relevant GDS functions to effectively coordinate efforts for a project/request.

  • Contribute towards reporting activities prepared for internal and external stakeholders
  • Prepare and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the team.

  • Coaches and mentors team members for professional development and recommends training requirements to address identified gaps.
  • Promote a healthy work-life balance by encouraging flexible working arrangements and supporting team members well-being.

  • Responsible for achieving customer satisfaction / project critical success factors.

Technologies and Tools

Enterprise Technology is a global organization that delivers reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to enable an exceptional technology experience for EY people. As part of the Enterprise Technology Risk & Compliance (ETRC) team, the Risk & Controls Analyst will support the day-to-day execution of RACM governance, control assessment, certification and strategic risk and control initiatives across Enterprise Technology. Reporting to the Risk & Controls Governance Lead, this role will maintain risk and control information, support control impact and gap assessments, coordinate assigned initiatives and provide analysis and governance materials that enable consistent risk and control decisions.

Responsibilities

The Risk & Controls Analyst will support the operational delivery of risk and control governance activities and assigned transformation initiatives under the direction of the Risk & Controls Governance Lead.

Key responsibilities include

  • Maintain application inventory, control owner and delegate registers, and attestation and certification records that support the ET and Finance control landscape.
  • Support assessments of applications, processes and technology changes to identify potential requirements for new or updated controls, including IT general controls, SDLC controls and interfaces.
  • Perform control gap analysis, document findings and contribute practical remediation recommendations for review by Risk & Controls Governance leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Support control rationalization, control impact assessments and analysis of control design or ownership changes.
  • Support risk and control initiatives
  • Manage assigned project plans and delivery activities, including milestones, actions, decisions, dependencies, risks, issues, approvals and stakeholder communications.
  • Prepare governance materials, status packs, ad hoc analysis and trend insights, and identify recurring control issues or themes for escalation and continuous improvement.
  • Support workflow automation and maintain project and compliance repositories, SharePoint sites, Planner boards and Teams channels where relevant to assigned work.
  • Share insights and recommendations from control assessments and risk investigations across ETRC teams and collaborate with Finance and Non-Finance RACM stakeholders, Operations & Reporting, Assurance & Compliance and Policy & Standards Enablement.

Analytical / Decision-Making Responsibilities

The role applies analytical and problem-solving skills to evaluate risk and control information, assess changes and reported exceptions, identify potential gaps or recurring themes and develop well-supported recommendations. The individual will organize and synthesize information, manage assigned priorities and dependencies, and escalate significant control, ownership, delivery or data-quality issues appropriately.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements

The role requires a solid understanding of technology risk and controls, RACM concepts, governance processes and project delivery practices. The successful candidate will be able to analyze complex information, maintain accurate governance records and tools, and translate findings into clear documentation and practical actions. Strong organization, collaboration, attention to detail and written communication skills are essential.

Job Requirements

To qualify, candidates must have

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Risk Management, Cybersecurity, Accounting or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technology risk, internal controls, IT audit, compliance, governance, project delivery or a related field.
  • Experience supporting RACM maintenance, risk and control assessments, control documentation, certification or remediation activities.
  • Working knowledge of IT general controls, technology change, access management, SDLC, interfaces and risk management practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to organize and synthesize complex information.
  • Strong project coordination skills, including experience tracking milestones, actions, risks, issues, dependencies and stakeholder deliverables.
  • Ability to work across technology, risk, audit, information security, privacy and business stakeholder groups in a global environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear governance materials, analysis and presentation content.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power BI and collaboration platforms; experience with GRC, workflow or RACM tools is preferred.
  • Experience supporting AI governance, SAP or ERP transformation, Data Protection, TARP, SDLC or other enterprise technology initiatives is a plus.
  • Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISM, CIA, PMP or similar are a plus.

What We Offer You

At EY, we will fuel your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

functions.

• Identify opportunities for digitisation, automation and improvement of institutional

processes.

platforms and MIS for institutional operations, investment management, financial

title: Sr. Data Research Analyst II
description:
Job Summary

Senior Data Research Analyst II

As a Data Discovery and Enrichment Expert II, you will operate at the intersection of data, AI, and domain knowledge. You will take ownership of complex data initiatives end-to-end, contribute to shaping how the team leverages AI and data science methods, and work closely with product and customer stakeholders to drive meaningful outcomes. This role is for someone with an execution mindset who thrives on turning ambiguous problems into structured, scalable solutions.

Responsibilities

Data AI-Driven Discovery

  • Lead complex data discovery, enrichment, and curation initiatives with a high degree of autonomy
  • Apply data science techniques and AI/ML tools to improve the quality, coverage, and scalability of data assets
  • Design and implement intelligent workflows for source evaluation, entity resolution, and information extraction
  • Develop and maintain taxonomies, ontologies, and knowledge graphs that power downstream products
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging AI tooling relevant to data enrichment and research intelligence

Product Customer Collaboration

  • Partner with product managers to translate data insights into product features and improvements
  • Engage directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand data needs and validate solutions
  • Contribute to the product roadmap by identifying data-driven opportunities for domain growth
  • Communicate findings, recommendations, and data strategies clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Project Execution Team Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of data projects, from scoping and planning through execution and review
  • Define and drive policies, procedures, and quality standards across the DDE team
  • Mentor and support junior team members, providing technical guidance and performance feedback
  • Identify and close process gaps; champion a culture of continuous improvement and execution excellence
  • Work within agile or project management frameworks to deliver reliably on commitments

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with large, complex, and multi-source datasets
  • Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, entity extraction, and classification
  • Data science skills: ability to prototype, analyse, and iterate on data pipelines and enrichment models
  • Familiarity with relevant databases, data tools, and curation platforms
  • Experience creating and maintaining taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, or ontologies
  • Track record of applying QA standards rigorously and improving them over time

Project Management Execution

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver complex projects on time
  • Experience with agile methodologies or structured project management approaches
  • Execution-oriented: comfortable moving from strategy to delivery with minimal oversight
  • Strong problem-solving skills; able to collect data, identify root causes, and act decisively

Communication Stakeholder Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to adapt style for different audiences
  • Confident engaging with customers, product teams, and senior stakeholders
  • Ability to translate complex data concepts into clear business language
  • Collaborative team player who also takes individual ownership

Education & Experience

MS degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative, information, or research-related field, with 7+ years of relevant experience. Experience in academic publishing, research intelligence, or bibliographic data is a strong advantage.

We particularly welcome candidates whose background spans data science and a domain-adjacent field (e.g. research analytics, information science, knowledge management), and who are motivated to grow into product and customer-facing responsibilities.

title: Computer Vision Developer-2
description:
Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer s and partner s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What Were Looking For:

Responsible for designing, optimizing, and deploying production-grade computer vision algorithms and deep learning pipelines for Zebra s AI offerings and AI Data Capture solutions. In this role, you will take autonomous ownership of core vision modules-accelerating model inference on edge/mobile hardware, refining high-throughput image processing pipelines, and bridging algorithm research with robust embedded software architecture. You will mentor junior developers, drive performance profiling across edge accelerators (NPUs, DSPs, GPUs), and ensure reliable, low-latency AI performance across enterprise frontline devices.
  • Design, implement, and maintain modular CV and AI components for document parsing, OCR/scene text extraction, object detection, and automated package/symbology recognition.
  • Profile and optimize algorithmic bottlenecks for latency, memory footprint, and CPU/GPU/NPU utilization using modern C++ (C++17/20), multithreading, and SIMD/hardware acceleration.
  • Quantize (INT8/FP16), convert, and integrate deep learning models into embedded runtimes such as ONNX Runtime, Qualcomm QNN/SNPE, or TFLite.
  • Collaborate with Technical Leads to build clean, extensible APIs for the AI Data Capture SDK and ensure cross-platform compatibility across Android (NDK) and Linux edge environments.
  • Design automated validation pipelines, regression test suites, and continuous benchmarking frameworks to ensure model accuracy and functional stability across releases.
  • Develop robust data ingestion, automated ground-truth labeling, and synthetic image augmentation pipelines to improve model generalization under challenging optical conditions (motion blur, low light, reflections).
  • Work closely with Algorithm Researchers to translate experimental models into production-ready software, and partner with QA/Application teams to debug issues in the field.
  • Conduct thorough code and design reviews, promoting engineering best practices and mentoring Developers / Associate team members.

Job Requirements - Bachelor or Masters in Computer Engineering/Computer Science (preferably with specialization in computer vision and machine learning);

Work experience (years): 2-5 years

Benefits:

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. description:
Responsibilities
  • Define and maintain data quality standards, validation rules, controls, and monitoring processes for revenue, contract, billing, and revenue-recognition data.
  • Design and implement automated testing, profiling, reconciliation, and anomaly-detection frameworks for RightRev data and related financial systems.
  • Validate revenue contracts, performance obligations, transaction prices, allocation inputs, recognition schedules, accounting treatments, and revenue-related adjustments.
  • Reconcile data across RightRev, billing, CPQ, CRM, ERP, general ledger, subledger, and reporting platforms.
  • Validate revenue data flows for new contracts, amendments, renewals, cancellations, credits, refunds, upgrades, downgrades, and other contract modifications.
  • Investigate data defects, reconciliation variances, failed integrations, and revenue schedule exceptions; perform root-cause analysis and coordinate remediation.
  • Establish data quality metrics, dashboards, alerts, and reporting to monitor completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and audit readiness.
  • Review data models, transformation logic, APIs, source-to-target mappings, and migration processes for revenue and accounting data.
  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Billing, Engineering, Product, and Data Governance teams to improve quote-to-cash and revenue-recognition processes.
  • Document data definitions, lineage, quality rules, test scenarios, defects, controls, and operational procedures; provide technical guidance to other engineers.


Knowledge, Skills Abilities
  • Strong understanding of revenue data and revenue-recognition processes, including contracts, performance obligations, allocation, deferred revenue, recognized revenue, modifications, credits, refunds, and adjustments.
  • Experience working with RightRev or comparable revenue-recognition, revenue-management, subledger, or accounting platforms.
  • Proficiency with SQL and Python or comparable scripting languages for data analysis, validation, automation, and reconciliation.
  • Experience testing APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses, and integrations among billing, CPQ, CRM, ERP, general ledger, and revenue systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, stakeholder-management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Qualifications
  • Bachelor s degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, accounting, finance, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Typically 5+ years of experience in data quality engineering, data engineering, software quality engineering, financial systems, revenue operations, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working with RightRev, revenue-recognition systems, accounting subledgers, billing platforms, or enterprise financial systems.
  • Hands-on experience developing automated data tests and quality frameworks using SQL, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with ASC 606, IFrevenue accounting, contract lifecycle management, or revenue subledger processes is preferred.
  • Experience with ERP, CRM, CPQ, billing, general ledger, or financial reporting integrations is preferred.
  • Experience with data governance, metadata, lineage, data observability, audit controls, or master data management is preferred.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading cross-functional data quality initiatives is preferred.

title: Manager, IS Vendor & Contract
description:
Position Summary

The Vendor and Contract Manager is responsible for building, maintaining, and enhancing solid relationships with IS Product/Service vendors, as well as internal business stakeholders across the organization. This position is accountable for sourcing, contract negotiations, vendor performance management and relationship management in collaboration with Legal Counsel, Supply Chain, and IS and Business Leadership. The Vendor and Contract Manager will develop and implement standard vendor management processes and policies that protect ECU Health's financial, intellectual, and legal interests while maximizing our technology investments, minimizing cost, and ensuring alignment of such to ECU Health's immediate and long term strategies. This role will assist IS and Business leaders to drive vendor performance best practices through scorecards, service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs). This position reports to the Office of the CIO.

Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing and Contract Management:

  • Demonstrates a commitment to supporting the business needs of ECU Health by collaborating with business stakeholders, legal counsel, supply chain and IS leaders to negotiate hardware, software and professional services agreements -
    • Develops and implements negotiating and sourcing strategies that drive adaptability of best-in-class software and hardware products and IS-related professional services at competitive prices.
    • Works closely with IS leaders and business owners to develop and implement sourcing strategies for IS related products and services that include, but are limited to, market scans, RFIs/RFPs, reference checks, site visits, and total cost of ownership analyses.
    • Serves as the IS Lead in contract negotiations and onboarding for assigned new vendors. Act as internal consultant to stakeholders by acting as a subject matter expert in information technology software and hardware contracting and vendor management principles.
    • Tracks and manages contract status based on terms and conditions for rate increases, eligible discounts, renewals, options with expiration dates, and other important business terms. Ensures existing vendor agreements are amended over time to reflect current regulatory and legal requirements such as confidentiality terms, business associate agreements, and compliance with Meaningful Use regulations.
    • Coordinates periodic true-ups and reconciliations for volume-based agreements.
    • In conjunction with Legal Counsel, develops standard terms and conditions for the different types of IS related contracts to facilitate negotiations and protect the interests of ECU health.

Vendor Management:

  • Demonstrates a commitment to optimal operating and financial performance of ECU Health by ensuring that vendors deliver on contractual commitments and value added services over time -
    • Develops and implements a common vendor management program including policies, processes, toolkits and balanced scorecards for evaluating, managing and reporting on external product/service providers to ECU Health.
    • Ensures vendors provide service, support, and quality products as outlined in contract terms and based on agreed upon performance goals.
    • Tracks annual spend, cost savings, and vendor financial health assisting IS managers with annual budget preparation and periodic validation of vendor value proposition.
    • Partners with internal stakeholders to develop and manage key performance metrics for strategically important third party vendors. Coordinates regularly scheduled meetings with external product or service providers, in collaboration with internal product owners and IS Management, to review performance to service levels.

Talent Management:

  • Demonstrates a commitment to employee professional development by providing opportunities for assuming new and varied responsibilities, training and development, and coaching and mentoring by management and staff -
    • Recruits and develops IS leaders and staff to create a high-performing organization capable of supporting current systems while developing new skills needed to transform the IS organization and leverage next generation technologies.
    • Provides promotional and career development opportunities for IS employees within a system that includes career paths, succession plannng, and on-the-job training opportunities.
    • Conducts regular performance appraisals and recommends appropriate personnel actions.
    • Provides effective on-boarding and on-going coaching, mentoring, and feedback to improve performance, foster personal growth, and let employees know they are valued.
    • Creates a team-oriented, professional work environment providing the requisite challenges to retain talented IS professionals.
    • Contribues to the design of recognition systems that reward employees for their contributions.
    • Demonstrates a commitment to personal development by maintaining professional knowledge of current trends and developments in the information technology and health care industries through related seminars, independent study, professional associations, and conferences.

Universal Criteria:

  • Ensures utilization of ECU Health's IS project management methodology to improve processes to select, prioritize and implement IS enabled business initiatives so they are delivered on-time, within budget and meet the stated business objectives. Contributes to the on-going development of ECU Health's IS project management methodlology.
  • Promotes the philosophical direction of ECU Health IS in the adoption of IT Service Management (ITSM) by managing team compliance with IS governance and ITSM processes and ensuring ITSM subject matter expertise within the team.
  • Develops and maintains a culture that promotes service excellence and employee empowerment to act in the best interest of IS customers who are directly caring for our patients.
  • Demonstrates commitment by promoting and adhering to the ECU Health Code of Conduct, which includes the objectives of ECU Health's compliance program, policies and procedures and ethichal business practices. Promotes open, effective, and ongoing communication and the sharing of information among employees, and sets the expectation that matters of concern get reported immediately.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by appropriate personnel.

Review of Agreements:

  • Performs initial review of information technology agreements, including software license agreements, SaaS agreements, cloud service agreements, maintenance agreements, statements of work, business associate agreements, and vendor agreements. Identifies and negotiates business, operational, privacy, security, cybersecurity, service level, data governance, and risk allocation provisions in collaboration with Legal, Supply Chain, Information Services, IT, Finance, Compliance, Risk Management, and operational stakeholders.

Contract Processes and Issues:

  • Identifies contractual issues involving privacy, information security, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data use, reimbursement, and healthcare regulatory requirements and coordinates review with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Finance, and Information Security leaders.
  • Leads the administration and governance of the contract lifecycle management process for information services agreements, including contract intake, review, approval workflows, execution, amendments, renewals, terminations, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
  • Develops and maintains contracting metrics, dashboards, and performance reports, including cycle times, renewal management, workload analysis, savings realization, compliance trends, and operational improvement opportunities.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree- or higher- in business, healthcare administration, computer technology, information management or related field strongly desired.
  • Three or more years of progressive experience with contract negotiation and management, procurement, spend forecasting, and support of product roadmaps in a healthcare IT environment.
  • Direct experience with large vendor management of IT product and service providers. Ideally with one or more of the following Cisco, EMC, HP, Dell, and Microsoft.
  • Strong attention to detail as applied to contract language, software licensing, complex spreadsheets and statistical analysis as well as report generation.
  • Developing strategy, negotiating partnerships and structuring agreements for a full range of products and services in the form of perpetual licenses, third party hosted (SaaS, cloud) solutions, hardware, and professional services.
  • Experience with leasing arrangements for hardware purchases.
  • Partnering with a wide variety of IT and business discipline experts in the establishment and enhancement of IT services and related technologies.
  • Applying a strong understanding of ITIL frameworks and ITSM to the development and implementation of effective procurement and contracting with IT vendors and service providers.
  • Acting as a single point of contact for other departments such IT, Legal, Procurement, Operational and Asset/Vendor Management resources on all portfolio matters.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively evaluate and negotiate strategic business partnerships.
  • Knowledge of contemporary contract terms and conditions for IT related software, hardware and professional services including regulatory requirements, industry standards, payment terms, and performance commitments.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of information technology contracting concepts, including software licensing, SaaS/cloud computing arrangements, data privacy and security requirements, business associate agreements, service level commitments, indemnification, limitation of liability, cybersecurity obligations, audit rights, intellectual property rights, and vendor risk management.
  • Ability to influence, work with, and coordinate cross-functional teams of technical and non-technical staff to successfully achieve organizational goals and objectives.
  • Ability to implement and continuously improve processes.
  • Polished interpersonal skills to communicate tactfully, effectively and with discretion within all levels of management.
  • Acute attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple assignments simultaneously. Proven experience in maintaining schedules, documentation, communications, and meeting deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills. A critical thinker who uses their expertise to make sound decisions.
  • Ability to remain calm, helpful, and productive in all situations. Is able to maintain composure under pressure. Is seen as the voice of reason during difficult situations.
  • Travel:
    • Frequency and duration of travel is dependent on organizational priorities and the need for face-to-face interaction with operating unit leadership and staff. Travel to ECU Health Community Hospitals, Physician Practices and off-site locations.
    • Participation in vendor user groups, education forums and other professional associations may require out-of-town travel.

Other Information
  • Hybrid role (based out of Greenville, NC)
  • Monday - Friday full-time day shift

title: Kitchen Leader
description:
CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD

Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As Kitchen Leader, you will learn how to prepare great food, grill meats, and sauté vegetables. You are responsible for making sure our food is absolutely delicious. You’ll order the food and train others to become future Kitchen Leaders.

The Kitchen Leader helps ensure the quality and safety of Chipotle’s delicious food every day. They see to it that the kitchen is clean, organized and well stocked; and that the equipment is properly maintained and in good condition. Throughout the process they are serving as a role model for Crew members, helping them learn to become future Kitchen Leaders. At its core, as with every position at Chipotle, it is about promoting teamwork and creating a great customer experience. While on the clock, the Kitchen Leaders are always busy on their feet, accomplishing their station’s goals, taking on tasks that they see that need to get done, and pitching-in to help their teammates.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • In addition to following Chipotle’s policies and procedures, principal responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Ensuring food quality by cooking and prepping food to order, and following kitchen procedures

  • Monitoring food waste and inventory levels, and resolving food quality issues

  • Supporting a strong team dynamic between back of house Crew and front of house Crew

  • Developing Crew members to be future Kitchen Leaders

  • Communicating with Crew members and customers effectively in order to ensure great customer service and throughput

  • Ensuring the kitchen is properly cleaned and sanitized

  • Monitoring kitchen equipment and ensuring it is kept in good repair; making sure malfunctioning equipment is repaired as quickly as possible

  • Ensuring that the kitchen itself and all Crew members meet the necessary guidelines to ensure there are no injuries or accidents

  • Filling out Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) and Inventory Rotation (FIFO)

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Have the ability to understand and articulate Chipotle’s Food With Integrity philosophy

  • Have the knowledge and ability to speak, write, and understand the primary language(s) of the work location

  • Have a high school diploma

  • Have restaurant experience

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Tuition assistance (100% coverage for select degrees or up to $5,250/year)

  • Free food (yes, really FREE)

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Digital Tips

  • Paid time off

  • Holiday closures

  • Competitive compensation

  • Opportunities for advancement (80% of managers started as Crew)

PAY TRANSPARENCY

Below is the base pay range for this position, which is also eligible for digital tips. Actual base pay may vary depending on skill level, experience and/or education. In addition to base pay, Chipotle offers a competitive benefits package. Visit for more details.

Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. Chipotle has restaurants in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France and Germany and is the only restaurant company of its size that owns and operates all its restaurants in North America and Europe. With employees passionate about providing a great guest experience, Chipotle is a longtime leader and innovator in the food industry. title: GIS Analyst
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented GIS Analyst with 1-3 years of experience in spatial data management, GIS mapping, geospatial analysis, and map preparation. The candidate should have hands-on experience with ArcGIS and QGIS (mandatory) and the ability to collect, process, analyse, and visualise spatial data to support urban planning, field surveys, infrastructure mapping, and evidence-based decision-making.


Required Skills and Competencies


  • GIS Software and Spatial Data Management: Hands-on proficiency in ArcGIS Pro/ArcMap and QGIS for mapping, spatial analysis, and data management, with working knowledge of Shapefile, KML/KMZ, GeoPackage, geodatabases, CSV, and Excel-based spatial data.
  • Coordinate Systems and Georeferencing: Understanding of coordinate reference systems (CRS), map projections, georeferencing, coordinate transformation, and spatial data accuracy.
  • GPS, Field Survey and Data Validation: Familiarity with GPS-enabled data collection, mobile survey applications, field data verification, and attribute data validation using Microsoft Excel.
  • Cartography and Map Preparation: Ability to prepare accurate and professional maps using appropriate symbology, labels, legends, scale bars, and map layouts.
  • Field Survey, CAD Integration: Familiarity with Google Earth Pro, GPS-based survey tools, and mobile GIS applications, along with AutoCAD drawings, CAD-to-GIS conversion, public-space inventories, and location-based spatial analysis.
  • Spatial Analysis and Urban GIS Applications: Understanding of vector and raster data processing, spatial queries, overlay analysis, proximity analysis, land-use mapping, infrastructure inventories, public-space mapping, commercial activity mapping, and accessibility analysis.
  • Communication and Documentation: Good written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, report preparation, and the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

Experience Requirements

  • 1-3 years of relevant professional experience in GIS mapping, spatial data processing, and geospatial analysis.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in both ArcGIS and QGIS.
  • Ability to work in team independently to prepare GIS maps, maintain spatial databases, and deliver accurate GIS outputs within specified timelines.

title: Intern - GIS and Data Analysis
description:

Position Overview
WRI India is seeking a GIS and Data Analysis Intern for Energy Access Explorer (EAE) in the Energy Program. EAE is an open-source, interactive data and mapping platform that accelerates the expansion of clean energy in underserved regions. By synthesizing geospatial data on energy demand, supply, and infrastructure, EAE supports integrated and inclusive energy planning.
As an intern with the Energy Program, you will support the expansion, data analysis, and stakeholder engagement efforts of the Energy Access Explorer platform. This role bridges geospatial data science, clean energy policy, and development. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of researchers and energy experts to gather data, synthesize findings, and coordinate outreach.


What you will do
The intern will undertake a range of responsibilities as listed below.
  • Assist in sourcing, curating, cleaning, and verifying spatial and demographic data related to energy demand, grid infrastructure, installed RE (large or small).
  • Support in annotating the satellite data. This dataset will be used to train and validate the machine learning algorithm to detect small scale solar panels.
  • Assist in research for nomenclature, guidelines on colours and additional areas related to data and GIS layer management
  • Support in applying the data quality guidelines to datasets.
  • Support in analysis, prioritization runs and clustering outputs using EAE.
  • Test new data and features on the EAE, verify data accuracy, and assist in documentation for open-source geospatial solutions.
  • Support to comply with the EAE's data guidelines for quality control for the grid infrastructure data.
  • Sharpen insights by complementing the analyses by working closely with project team and conducting literature review, reading policy documents and consultations to validate abovementioned findings.
  • Create appropriate documentation that allows stakeholders to understand the steps of the data analysis process and duplicate or replicate the analysis, if necessary.
  • Support in developing the training material on EAE platform.


What you will need
  • Completed or on-going higher education degree in Geoinformatics, Energy, Statistics, Data Science, Analytics, development economics, Mathematics, or related social science subjects.
  • Experience with QGIS, Google Earth Engine and spatial data analysis. Familiarity with open-source mapping tools or Python/R is a strong plus.
  • Experience in conducting data mining, evaluation, analysis, and visualizations.
  • Experience interpreting and/or analysing satellite imagery
  • Working knowledge of statistical and geo-spatial databases, and an understanding of the relationship between electricity access and socio-economic development is preferable.

title: Statistician, Human Centered Weather Forecasts Professional
company: Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab
description:
About the Trust:
The University of Chicago Trust (the Trust) is a charitable trust in India, established in 2008 by alumnus of The University of Chicago . The Trust s objectives are to provide opportunities for grants to support educational programs, research programs and activities for the betterment of India.
The Development Innovation Lab - India (DIL-India):
DIL-India , based at the Trust in India, is dedicated to using the tools of economics to develop innovations with the potential to benefit millions of people. We have work in health, education, agriculture, climate change, road safety, and others. We do so by collaborating with government agencies, firms, and non-profits in India to identify, test, and scale evidence-based solutions.
DIL-India has a fast-growing portfolio of policy-relevant research. DIL-India supports the development and dissemination of cutting- edge AI-based monsoon onset forecasts to farmers. DIL-India plans to build on this work, aiming to reach more people and expand its research to areas that have the potential to improve livelihoods and impact well-being.
Human Centered Weather Forecast Initiative:
Collaborating with HCWF , DIL-India brings together climate scientists, artificial intelligence (AI) experts and economists to build and evaluate weather forecasts that can target what citizens need to know, leveraging novel technologies, including AI, and scientific understanding. This interdisciplinary team then works to test forecast dissemination strategies, refine those strategies based on user response, and scale forecast dissemination to inform data-driven decision-making.
For example: The Indian Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare distributed AI forecasts to 38 million farmers accurately predicting the start of the monsoon in 2025, becoming a model for using advanced in AI and atmospheric science to help vulnerable populations adapt to climate change. Hundreds of millions of smallholder farmers across the tropics depend on information about when the rainy season, known as the monsoon, will come each year. This advanced knowledge allows farmers to make more informed decisions about when to plant seeds, irrigate, and hire labor. However, accurate forecasting of when the monsoon will begin, especially at long lead teams and local scales, has remained a century-old challenge. AI has revolutionized global weather forecasting, promising new tools for predicting phenomena as complex as the monsoon. DIL-India researchers lead local HCWF research that supports an international, multidisciplinary collaboration to harness advances in AI to better predict the beginning of the monsoon in India.
This job opening is part of the launch of a new DIL-India initiative.
Position Description:
The Statistician, HCWF will support research activities at DIL-India in collaboration with the Human-Centered Weather Forecasts initiative. The role involves statistical design, analysis, and modeling to both support the development of blended weather models and evaluate the accuracy and impact of AI-based weather forecasting systems. This may include the design of randomized controlled trials and quasi-experimental evaluations of forecast dissemination programs across India.
Responsibilities:
  • Develop and apply statistical models to assess forecast accuracy, calibration, and skill across a range of meteorological variables and geographic settings.
  • Work on the statistical development of one or more forecasts end-to-end, from model design through operational deployment and ongoing verification
  • Provide input on statistical analysis plans for and interpretation of the results of field evaluations and A/B tests of weather forecast dissemination programs, which may include conducting power calculations or designing sampling methods for experimental and quasi-experimental studies.
  • Clean, process, and analyze large datasets from weather forecast models, remote sensing, and household surveys.
  • Collaborate with atmospheric scientists, data scientists, and policy teams to interpret and communicate statistical findings.
  • Contribute to the preparation of research reports, policy briefs, and academic publications.
  • Maintain reproducible code (e.g., in R, Python, or Stata) and support data infrastructure for research workflows.
  • Performs other related work as assigned.
Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelor s degree in statistics, biostatistics, econometrics, or a related field; Masters degree preferred.
Experience:
  • Minimum 3 years experience in applied statistics in one or more relevant areas (predictive modelling, forecast verification, or the design and analysis of randomized controlled trials and quasi-experimental studies)
  • Experience working with climate, agricultural, meteorological, or remote sensing data.
  • Familiarity with reproducible research practices and version control (e.g., Git).
Competencies:
  • Proficiency in R, Stata, or Python for statistical analysis.
  • Experience with one or more of: forecast verification and evaluation, spatial or geostatistical methods, evidence aggregation, or causal-inference methods for program evaluation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings to non-specialist audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams across different time zones.
  • Interest in weather forecasting, development economics, climate adaptation, or agricultural development.
Working Conditions:
  • Based in Delhi with regular travel throughout India to project locations
  • Applicant must be legally authorized to work in India.
  • This is a one-year position subject to renewal.

Throughout the process they are serving as a role model for Crew members, helping them learn to become future Kitchen Leaders. At its core, as with every position at Chipotle, it is about promoting teamwork and creating a great customer experience. title: Head of IT - Business Change Management
description:
Job Purpose\:

The Head of IT Business & Change Management provides the primary interface between the Digital & Technology function and the Group’s Insurance and Investment lines of business (General Insurance, Life and Asset Management), Regions and Shared Services. The role leads the IT Business Partners, consolidates business technology demand and represents it through the group prioritization process, coordinating delivery and tracking benefits realized. The role acts as the orchestration point across business demand, build and run teams, ensuring initiatives progress from requirement through delivery into stable production operation. It does not duplicate the delivery accountabilities of individual Technology functions; rather, it ensures their respective activities, dependencies and commitments come together effectively for the business. The role provides oversight of enterprise technology change management, production readiness, cross-functional dependencies and significant service issues, while providing business leadership with clear visibility of technology priorities, delivery progress, risks and service performance.

Key responsibilities
A. Business Technology Partnering
• Lead and manage the IT Business Partners aligned to General Insurance, Life, Asset Management, Regions and Shared Services.
• Coordinate technology engagement across the Group’s Insurance and Investment businesses, Regions and Shared Services, ensuring consistent service and clear accountability.
• Ensure IT Business Partners maintain a strong understanding of the strategy, operating priorities, customer journeys, business processes and technology needs of their assigned business areas.
• Establish effective engagement forums between Digital & Technology and business leadership and act as the senior escalation point for significant technology matters.
• Ensure technology priorities remain aligned to business outcomes and enterprise strategy, with clear accountability for commitments made to the business.
• Promote a consistent and professional technology partnering model across all supported business areas.

B. Business Demand & Prioritization
• Lead the coordination and consolidation of technology demand across the organization.
• Ensure business requirements from the Insurance and Investment businesses, Regions and Shared Services are sufficiently defined before progressing into delivery.
• Challenge requests where business value, priority, ownership or expected outcomes are unclear.
• Work with Technology Planning & Value Assurance, Architecture and other relevant teams to assess feasibility, dependencies, cost, risk and strategic alignment.
• Represent consolidated business demand into the prioritization process owned by Technology Planning & Value Assurance, ensuring business value, urgency, risk and enterprise priorities are appropriately evidenced.
• Provide visibility to business and Technology leadership on demand pipelines, priorities, dependencies and constraints, and help prevent fragmented or duplicated initiatives.

C. Enterprise Delivery Coordination
• Provide enterprise-level systems change coordination across Digital, Applications, Infrastructure, Cloud, Data & AI, Cybersecurity and third-party providers.
• Ensure cross-functional dependencies affecting business areas are identified early and actively managed, with delivery commitments aligned to agreed business outcomes.
• Escalate delivery risks, resource constraints and unresolved dependencies and facilitate resolution of issues spanning multiple Digital & Technology functions.
• Ensure business stakeholders receive clear, consistent and timely updates on delivery progress, risks, dependencies and decisions.
• Work with Technology Portfolio & Delivery, which owns programme and project execution, to maintain alignment between delivery activities, business priorities and expected outcomes.
• Ensure individual Technology functions (IT BPs) retain accountability for their respective deliverables while this role coordinates dependencies and end-to-end outcomes so that all contributions come together effectively for the business.

D. Enterprise Change Management, Production Readiness & Controls
• Own the business applications change management process across Digital & Technology and act as the control point between Build and Run for material technology changes.
• Ensure changes are assessed for business impact, risk, dependencies and operational readiness, with service ownership, support arrangements, documentation, implementation, rollback and recovery plans in place before go-live.
• Coordinate with relevant change governance forums, including Change Advisory Board processes where applicable, and support go/no-go decisions for major business-impacting releases.
• Ensure conflicting changes, competing implementation windows and business constraints are resolved and stakeholder communication for material changes is coordinated.
• Ensure governance of major, high-risk and emergency changes, including appropriate segregation of duties, approvals, audit trails and compliance with architecture, cybersecurity, risk and operational resilience standards.
• Drive proportionate, risk-based change controls, including streamlined approvals and automation for low-risk repeatable changes, protecting production stability without unnecessarily slowing delivery.
• Monitor change success, failed and emergency changes, change-related incidents and significant post-implementation issues, ensuring lessons are incorporated into future delivery and change practice.

E. Technology Service & Business Outcome Management
• Maintain enterprise visibility of technology service performance affecting supported business areas.
• Ensure recurring incidents, service weaknesses and customer-impacting technology issues are assigned clear ownership and actively addressed through the service desk.
• Work with Service delivery team, who owns service levels and the incident and problem management processes, to ensure agreed service levels and business expectations are understood and managed.
• Provide consolidated business-facing reporting on significant service issues, risks and improvement actions.
• Facilitate cross-functional resolution where service issues require coordinated action across multiple Technology teams.
• Ensure delivery success is measured not only by implementation but also by subsequent service stability, reliability and business outcomes.

F. Leadership, Governance & People Development
• Provide leadership, coaching and direction to the IT Business Partners and establish clear performance expectations and accountability across the function.
• Develop IT Business Partners’ capability in stakeholder management, demand management, business analysis, technology advisory and delivery coordination.
• Promote collaboration across Digital & Technology functions rather than siloed engagement with the business, reinforcing end-to-end business and customer outcomes.
• Build a culture of ownership, transparency, responsiveness, constructive challenge, early escalation and continuous improvement.
• Ensure appropriate succession, development and capability plans are in place for the function.
• Ensure relevant delivery and change activities comply with governance, risk, audit and regulatory requirements, with material risks escalated appropriately.

description:
CERTIFIED MEDICATION AIDE - FULL TIME - 7a-7p
JOB PURPOSE:
Responsible for assisting residents with medications ordered by their appropriately licensed health care providers and as established in each residents individualized care plan. May provide medication reminders, assistance with self-administration of medications and administration of medications as allowed by state and federal laws and applicable rules according to company policies and procedures. Key communicator with the resident’s pharmacy, healthcare provider and family regarding medication management.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  1. Knowledge of assisted living policies and procedures regarding all aspects of medication management
  2. Remains current in knowledge of state and federal rules regarding scope of practice, medication storage & disposal, infection control practices & bio-hazardous waste disposal.
  3. Able to accurately read, and follow medication orders and medication labels.
  4. Able to accurately transpose medication orders to the MAR & make any needed corrections to the MAR according to physician orders.
  5. Follows the Six Rights of Medication Administration
  6. Able to identify concerns related to medication orders, medication instructions or resident reactions to medications and takes appropriate actions.
  7. Follows appropriate infection control practices related to medication administration.
  8. Follows proper medication storage and disposal practices
  9. Recognizes possible medication side effects or possible adverse reactions and takes appropriate actions
  10. Knows which medications unlicensed staff may never provide assistance with, administer or provide supervision for and never does so.
  11. Monitors resident’s medication quantities and related supplies and makes arrangements for timely procurement of refills so resident dose not miss any doses or required monitoring.
  12. Makes arrangements for timely procurement of newly ordered medications.
  13. Makes appropriate physician & family contacts in a professional manner when order clarification is needed, regarding resident reactions to medications or other medication concerns.
  14. Accurately documents assistance/administration and resident refusal of medications according to policy and professional standards.
  15. Follows policy, professional standards, and the law regarding storage, assistance/administration of, documentation and disposal of controlled medications
  16. Immediately reports and documents any medication errors to the administrator or his/her designee per policy and takes appropriate actions for resident’s well-being.
  17. Reports and documents any resident change in condition.
  18. Uses good judgment in seeking necessary assistance from peers, supervisor, administrator, physician, family and EMS as needed.
  19. Obtain accurate pulse and respiration rate; obtains accurate blood pressure, body temperature, and blood glucose reading
  20. Accurately documents the effectiveness of medications given on an as needed basis and does so in a timely manner.
  21. Monitors medications for accountability by verifying medications have been ordered appropriately, are received as ordered, and controlled med drug counts are done at change of shift.
  22. Communicates effectively from shift to shift & to others (family, pharmacy, physician etc.) as necessary to facilitate the accuracy of any needed follow-up regarding resident medications.
  23. Routinely inspects, cleans and monitors the med storage system, equipment and supplies for resident safety. Reports any concerns to the supervisor for correction or repair.
  24. Assists direct care partners with their duties as part of the direct care team
  25. Completes thorough face to face change of shift report to CMA relieving for next shift.
  26. Performs other duties as assigned that are within the scope of the CMAs practice, training, and abilities.

MINIMUM EDUCATION REQUIRED:
Some high school
MINIMUM EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
On-the-job training provided
MINIMUM LICENSURE/CERTIFICATION REQUIRED BY LAW:
CPR certification. Medication Tech certification
ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS: (Preferred qualifications)
High school diploma or equivalent preferred. Previous medication tech experience preferred. Experience with long term care or assisted living population preferred.

title: Lead - Energy Modelling (Clean Energy Programme)
company: International Forum For Environment Sustainability & Technology
description:
The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability Technology (iFOREST), is looking for a senior and accomplished professional to lead energy system modelling under the organisation s Clean Energy Programme.
A successful applicant must have a proven track record of building and running energy system or sectoral models, leading policy research and publications, and mentoring research teams. The candidate should ideally have a strong understanding of India s energy sector, including power markets, renewable energy policy, coal and the institutional landscape of central and state agencies.
Location : Noida, India (with travel to states and project sites as required)
Required Experience : 7+ years
Reports to : Programme Director, Clean Energy
About iFOREST
iFOREST is an independent not-for-profit research and innovation organisation that was established in 2019 to identify, promote and scale up solutions for pressing environment-development challenges in India and other developing countries in Asia and Africa.
Our work is rooted in regional priorities to accelerate environmental actions at the sub-national level and to improve national policies and plans to support it. Our mission is to address the unique needs of regions by leveraging our resources and expertise to scale up national action and make a global impact. We use our regional knowledge to inform national policy and plans and strengthen international collaboration.
To achieve our goals, we conduct independent evidence-based research, develop new knowledge and innovative solutions, convene stakeholders to increase awareness and build consensus, and partner with think tanks, civil society, government agencies, philanthropies and industry to scale up solutions.
The Clean Energy Programme
The Clean Energy Programme supports India s transition to a secure, affordable and low-carbon energy system. Its work spans power sector planning, renewable energy integration, energy demand across sectors, industrial decarbonisation and the just transition of coal-dependent regions.
Quantitative modelling sits at the core of this work, giving the programme a rigorous basis for its policy recommendations to central and state governments, industry and investors. Within this, the energy modelling work builds and applies energy system and sectoral models to generate scenarios and insights that inform clean energy policy design and investment strategy in India.
The Role
The Lead - Energy Modelling will be responsible for building and running the Clean Energy Programme s modelling capability and making it central to how iFOREST shapes clean energy policy in India. This would entail designing and applying energy system and sectoral models, leading research from design to publication, assuring the quality of the team s outputs, and translating model results into clear messages for policymakers, industry and the public, while mentoring a team of Researchers and Research Associates working on modelling and data analysis. In addition, they would also be expected to help set the programme s strategic direction and build partnerships that bring modelling into real-world decision-making.
Specific tasks to be undertaken are:
Model development and application
  • Design, develop and implement energy system and sectoral models covering power, industry, transport, buildings and other demand sectors, including capacity expansion, production cost, demand projection and techno-economic models.
  • Use these models to generate scenarios and insights that inform policy design and investment strategy.
  • Define model scope, structure, assumptions and scenario frameworks, and maintain clear documentation, version control and data management so that models are transparent, reproducible and usable by others in the team.
  • Track emerging modelling methods, open-source tools and datasets at global and national levels, and adapt them to Indian conditions such as state-level power markets, coal transition dynamics and sector-specific demand patterns.
Research design and execution
  • Contribute to research design, including defining research questions, methodology, work plans, activities and tasks for each assignment.
  • Lead primary and secondary research to support modelling, including literature and policy reviews, government and industry datasets, stakeholder interviews, field visits and expert consultations.
  • Establish procedures to validate input data, cross-check assumptions against official sources and flag uncertainty through sensitivity analysis.
  • Stay abreast with the latest developments in Indian and global clean energy policy, markets, technology costs and regulation, and use them to contextualise and sharpen research outputs.
Technical writing, quality assurance and mentoring
  • Write and review reports, working papers, discussion papers and policy briefs, ensuring each conclusion is grounded in robust modelling evidence.
  • Review the modelling and research outputs of junior team members for technical accuracy, consistency of assumptions and clarity of argument before publication.
  • Mentor young researchers in the team to strengthen their analytical, quantitative and technical skills through regular feedback, hands-on model training and opportunities to lead parts of projects.
  • Train and develop the internal team to build modelling capacity across the programme.
Communication of modelling insights
  • Co-author and review blogs, articles, op-eds and explainers that translate modelling results into clear, compelling messages for policymakers, industry and the public.
  • Work with the communications team to develop data visualisations, infographics, presentations and media briefings, and act as a technical spokesperson for modelling work when required.
Stakeholder engagement and dissemination
  • Organise and contribute to technical roundtables, stakeholder consultations and dissemination workshops to present, test and refine modelling outputs.
  • Present research at national and international conferences, government meetings and expert panels.
Additional duties
  • Contribute to shaping the overall strategy for the programme, aligned with institutional priorities, sector-specific issues and ongoing work of other key institutions.
  • Identify new pathways, initiatives, and partnerships that bring modelling into real-world decision-making and contribute to programmatic goals.
  • Support development of new concept notes, proposals and budgets for projects/interventions that further institutional objectives.
  • Contribute to the institution s brand building by representing iFOREST on various public platforms.
  • Execute any related assignments that may arise in relation to the tasks or for further enhancement of the programme.
Qualification Work Experience
  • A Master s degree in Energy Studies, Engineering, Economics, Environmental Science, Operations Research, Public Policy or a related quantitative field is required. A PhD in a relevant field will be preferred.
  • Proven hands-on experience building and running energy system or sectoral models , with a track record of applying results to policy or investment questions, is required.
  • A strong understanding of India s energy sector , including power markets, renewable energy policy, coal and the institutional landscape of central and state agencies, is required.
  • A record of published analytical work , such as reports, working papers, journal articles or policy briefs, is required.
  • Experience in supervising or mentoring junior researchers is required.
  • Familiarity with grid modelling, renewable energy penetration modelling, cost modelling and energy storage analysis will be preferred.
  • Experience with international modelling communities or collaborative modelling projects will be preferred.
  • Experience in writing funding proposals and managing donor-funded projects will be preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Hindi or another Indian language for field research and stakeholder engagement will be preferred.
  • A minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience in energy modelling, energy policy research or techno-economic analysis is required.
Competencies Responsibilities
The successful candidate should have the following competencies:
  • Proficiency in one or more energy system modelling frameworks , such as TIMES/MARKAL, MESSAGE, OSeMOSYS, LEAP, PLEXOS, PyPSA or GCAM.
  • Strong power sector analysis skills, including capacity expansion, production cost and dispatch modelling, renewable integration and grid flexibility.
  • Strong techno-economic assessment skills, including levelised cost analysis, cost-benefit analysis, financial modelling and technology cost projections.
  • Strong programming and data skills in Python, R, GAMS or Julia and advanced Excel, with ability to work with large datasets and build data pipelines.
  • Ability to design scenarios and sensitivity analyses and interpret uncertainty for decision-makers.
  • Ability to produce clear data visualisations and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Power BI or Python and R libraries.
  • Analytical rigour , building conclusions on evidence and stating assumptions and limits openly.
  • Excellent communication skills , with ability to write and present complex findings in plain language for non-technical audiences.
  • Proven leadership and mentoring skills, with ability to give constructive feedback and set high quality standards.
  • Strategic thinking , connecting research to policy windows and the programme s long-term goals.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams, disciplines and with external partners, and to manage several projects at once while meeting deadlines without compromising quality.
Why Choose iFOREST
  • Purpose-driven work: Contributing from sub-national to national and global goals.
  • Professional development: In areas and sectors that are contemporary and pressing.
  • Compensation: We offer a salary that is not only competitive but recognizes and rewards your commitment and talent.
  • Inclusive Culture: Benefit from a supportive and diverse work environment.
Remuneration
Competitive salary as per the candidate s experience and proficiency. Final designation of successful candidate will be based on qualification and experience.
Application deadline instructions
Interested candidates should send a CV, a cover letter describing their modelling experience, and two samples of published analytical work at apply at IFOREST
Immediate opening. Position open until filled. iFOREST is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

description:
FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Job Description


Lead Analyst, Finance Quantitative Offices (FQO), Treasury

Value Proposition

  • Play a key role in a global financial modeling team that is pivotal in a top 25 US bank s strategic decision making, capital planning and regulatory compliance.
  • An opportunity to build cutting edge analytics and modeling capabilities for the bank by leveraging a blend of technical & quantitative prowess, financial acumen and excellent communication skills.

Job Details

Position Title: Lead Analyst, FQO, Treasury

Career Level: P3

Job Category: Manager

Role Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Bengaluru, India

About the Team:

The FQO group is a part of the Corporate Treasury team within First Citizens Bank. This team is responsible for developing, maintaining, and monitoring Pre-Provision Net Revenue (PPNR), Balance Sheet Management (BSM) and other financial models that are consumed for First Citizens Bank s CCAR stress testing as well as internal business/financial planning activities. FQO interacts closely with Finance and Treasury, Business units, Risk, Senior Management, and Model Risk Management (MRM) to ensure models are fit for use.

Impact

FQO team plays a critical role in capital planning for the bank, by developing models that project the balance sheet and net income/expenses in different economic scenarios. These serves regulatory expectations around stress testing (CCAR), as well as enable the bank to take strategic business decisions related to capital distribution, share buyback etc. Balance Sheet Management models aid in EVE calculations which are pivotal in Asset-Liability Management for the bank.

This role entails playing a lead role in the model development team, and hence contributing significantly to develop and enhance sophisticated models based on sound statistical techniques and robust data. It will involve interesting and challenging opportunities to continuously evolve the model suite and processes around model lifecycle as the bank grows rapidly and has heightened regulatory requirements.

Key Deliverables

Model Data, Development & Maintenance:


Support Treasury and Capital Markets teams through the assessment, implementation, enhancement, monitoring, and governance of vendor-provided derivative pricing, valuation, and risk models used for valuation, risk management, and stress testing.

Manage data extraction, quality, reconciliation and processing at different levels of aggregation in coordination with FQO data/governance and IT teams.

Analyze market, trade, valuation, and model output data to assess model performance, identify anomalies, and support valuation and risk management decisions.

Support key decisions and provide support across all phases of model development including qualitative/quantitative methodology design, exploratory data analysis, variable selection, performance testing and documentation; modeling components include Deposits, Loans, Commitments and Net Interest Revenues/Expenses.

Perform ongoing monitoring of vendor pricing and valuation models, investigate model performance issues, conduct root cause analysis, and support remediation activities.

Support model implementation for new or re-developed models including data reconciliation, model execution logic, implementation testing, and documentation.

Contribute to process enhancements and automation related to model development process, documentation, monitoring and production activities.

Partner with businesses, Finance and Treasury, Risk, and Model Risk Management to ensure PPNR is contributing to a consistent and controlled approach across the end-to-end CCAR process.

Governance & Controls:


Engage with Model Risk Management (MRM) team to ensure models are fit for use as per bank policies and standards and resolve model findings/limitations.

Support review and challenge process for stress test results and business overlays in collaboration with PPNR and business teams.

Support governance team to establish and execute controls around data quality/reconciliation and model execution process.

Stakeholder management:


Accountable for effective communication across Business units, MRM, Risk/Finance teams and working groups/committees including toll gate meetings, model review/challenge discussions etc.

Manage onshore stakeholders including senior modeling leads and collaborate effectively across model development/maintenance activities.

Skills and Qualification (Functional and Technical Skills)

Functional Skills:

Strong knowledge of US regulatory landscape including CCAR/DFAST regulations and SR 11-7 guidelines.

Solid understanding of financial products and derivative instruments including interest rate swaps, caps/floors, swaptions, FX derivatives, futures, and options. Knowledge of Treasury and Capital Markets activities is preferred.

Knowledge of Interest Rate Risk (IRR) and related concepts.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills for engagement with senior leadership and stakeholders.

Efficient and well organized, able to work under tight deadlines.

Outstanding attention to detail, accuracy, and ability to multitask.

Technical Skills:

In-depth understanding of statistical analysis and econometric modeling including sampling, segmentation, linear/logistic regression, time series forecasting, stress testing techniques concepts/techniques etc.

Good understanding of best practices related to data management, quality and processing for modeling purposes.

Experience working on data extraction, quality controls and processing for modelling purposes using SQL and/or statistical programming languages.

Experience with at least one statistical programming language such as Python, R or SAS.

Education & Experience:

Masters/Bachelors degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Statistics, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance or Applied Economics and related fields.

5+ years of relevant experience in derivative pricing, model validation, model risk management, quantitative analytics, Treasury/Capital Markets modeling, or vendor model governance. Experience with valuation models and regulatory model risk management frameworks is preferred.

description:
Heb jij technisch inzicht, commerciële flair en een passie voor klantencontact? Wil je klanten begeleiden bij het kiezen van de ideale buitenzonwering en meebouwen aan de groei van een familiebedrijf? Dan ben jij misschien de collega die we zoeken!

Wat houdt jouw functie in?

Als vertegenwoordiger begeleid je klanten van het eerste contact tot de uiteindelijke bestelling. Je combineert technisch advies met een commerciële aanpak en zorgt ervoor dat elke klant de oplossing vindt die bij zijn wensen past.
