title: Lead Clinical SAS Programmer
description:
Job Summary

Position: Lead Clinical SAS Programmer. Function: Clinical Statistical Programming / Biometrics. Location: Remote.

We are seeking an experienced Lead Clinical SAS Programmer to support global clinical development programs and regulatory submissions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAS programming, CDISC SDTM and ADaM standards, clinical trial analysis, and the development and validation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), along with prior experience supporting global clinical trials, including oncology studies, and collaborating with US-based CROs, sponsors, biostatisticians, and cross-functional clinical development teams. The role requires the ability to independently manage study-level programming deliverables, provide technical guidance to programming team members, and deliver high-quality clinical datasets and reports in accordance with study specifications, SOPs, regulatory requirements, and agreed timelines.

Responsibilities

Clinical SAS Programming Technical Leadership

  • Lead and independently execute clinical statistical programming activities for assigned studies, ensuring timely delivery, accuracy, quality, and compliance with project requirements
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize SAS programs using Base SAS, DATA steps, PROC SQL, macros, and other relevant SAS procedures
  • Develop reusable SAS macros, programming templates, utilities, and standardized solutions for clinical data processing, analysis, and reporting
  • Build, transform, derive, and reconcile clinical datasets from clinical databases, source datasets, and external data transfers
  • Troubleshoot complex programming issues, investigate SAS log errors and warnings, and optimize program performance
  • Review programming specifications, provide technical guidance, conduct code reviews, and support junior programmers
  • Ensure consistent implementation of programming standards, reusable code, naming conventions, and documentation practices across assigned studies

SDTM, ADaM Regulatory Submission Deliverables

  • Develop, maintain, and validate CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets in accordance with applicable standards, study specifications, and regulatory requirements
  • Program standard and study-specific SDTM domains and ADaM datasets, including ADSL and analysis datasets based on study design
  • Implement analysis derivations, treatment variables, population flags, baseline definitions, visit windows, analysis parameters, and other study-specific requirements
  • Maintain traceability from source data through SDTM and ADaM datasets to final analysis outputs
  • Prepare, review, or support development of define.xml, dataset specifications, metadata, and other required submission documentation
  • Review and resolve applicable Pinnacle 21 validation findings and CDISC conformance issues
  • Ensure deliverables are submission-ready and comply with sponsor standards, company SOPs, and health authority requirements

TLF Development, Statistical Analysis Reporting

  • Develop, program, review, and validate TLFs in accordance with the protocol, Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP), mock shells, and approved programming specifications
  • Program safety and efficacy outputs, including demographic summaries, subject disposition, adverse event summaries, laboratory analyses, concomitant medication listings, and efficacy endpoints
  • Support oncology-specific analyses, as applicable, including tumor response assessments, response rates, progression-free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS), and other time-to-event endpoints
  • Support pharmacokinetic (PK) data processing and reporting for applicable studies
  • Collaborate with biostatisticians to clarify statistical methods, analysis populations, derivations, and reporting requirements
  • Support preparation of clinical study reports and statistical summary documentation by providing validated datasets, tables, listings, figures, and programming inputs
  • Ensure consistency between analysis datasets, statistical outputs, table shells, and reporting specifications

Quality Control Independent Validation

  • Develop and execute appropriate QC and validation strategies for clinical datasets, SAS programs, TLFs, and other programming deliverables
  • Perform independent programming, code review, output comparison, reconciliation, and other validation activities per project requirements
  • Review SAS logs, investigate discrepancies, document findings, and ensure timely resolution of issues
  • Verify that analysis datasets and outputs conform to the SAP, programming specifications, study standards, and regulatory expectations
  • Maintain complete and accurate programming documentation, QC evidence, version history, and audit-ready records
  • Ensure final deliverables meet established quality standards and are appropriately reviewed before release or submission

Global Trial Oncology Study Support

  • Support global clinical trials across Phase I-IV development programs, depending on assigned study requirements
  • Apply understanding of clinical development, study protocols, data structures, statistical analysis requirements, and regulatory reporting processes
  • Support oncology clinical trials with familiarity in oncology-specific endpoints, tumor assessment data, response criteria, and time-to-event analyses
  • Collaborate with US-based CROs, global sponsor teams, biostatisticians, clinical data management teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders
  • Participate in global project meetings, specification discussions, study status reviews, and issue-resolution activities
  • Review clinical data transfers and ongoing study data to identify data quality concerns and potential impacts on analysis or reporting, escalating to appropriate teams

Cross-Functional Collaboration Study Management

  • Work closely with Biostatistics, Clinical Data Management, and other project stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve data and programming issues
  • Provide technical input into SAPs, mock shells, programming specifications, annotated CRFs, and related study documentation
  • Review CRF annotations and data specifications for consistency with planned analyses and programming requirements
  • Collaborate with Clinical Data Management on data validation requirements, edit checks, data review, and data cleaning activities, as applicable
  • Communicate study progress, programming risks, dependencies, and potential delays to programming leads, statistics leads, and project stakeholders
  • Track milestones, manage assigned deliverables, and proactively address issues affecting study timelines or submission readiness
  • Maintain complete records and archive programming deliverables, datasets, outputs, specifications, and documentation per company procedures

title: Lead, On Demand, Digital Products
description:
About us

Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India s leading premium flexible workspace operators - GPTW certified (Nov 2024 - Nov 2025, Dec 2025 - Dec 2026). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 85 centres, 9.8 million square ft (operational area) (as of October 2026). WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customized and curated solutions for various office space needs.

For more information, please visit our website

About the role

The On Demand team operates within the Digital Products vertical. The portfolio includes Day Passes, Day Pass Plus, Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings, sold through the WeWork India app and website, myHQ, and other aggregator and corporate channels.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of the On Demand business: revenue and PL, the product portfolio, pricing and promotions, inventory and day-to-day operations, the myHQ partnership and other channels, and the digital booking experience. It sits at the intersection of business, product and operations, working closely with Tech Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI and Sales teams, as well as external partners.

The team member will be responsible for growing On Demand revenue profitably by improving how the business is priced, distributed, operated and measured, and by shaping the next set of On Demand products, while ensuring a seamless booking and on-site experience for members.

Role and responsibilities

Revenue and PL

  • Own the On Demand PL and deliver monthly and annual revenue targets, tracking performance on both a gross booking value and a realised revenue (net of partner share) basis.

  • Build and maintain the monthly forecast and revenue bridge, breaking performance down by product, channel, city and building to explain what moved, why, and what needs to change.

  • Drive growth across every lever (volume, price, product mix and capacity) while protecting realisation on discounted and partner-led sales.

  • Reconcile On Demand revenue across booking systems, partner reports and finance records, including monthly aggregator invoicing and partner settlements, and resolve revenue leakage, unbilled bookings and data gaps.

On Demand products

  • Own the full product suite (Day Pass, Day Pass Plus, 5 and 10 Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings), including positioning, terms and policies, and lifecycle decisions.

  • Track how each product performs and how it affects the rest of the portfolio (incremental revenue versus cannibalisation), and decide when to scale, reposition, reprice or retire a product.

  • Grow B2B bulk bookings and Bookable Private Office demand from companies and teams, working with the All Access Sales team and myHQ s B2B team.

  • Identify frequent On Demand users and teams and work with the All Access Sales team to move them up the product ladder to All Access Plus, All Access Basic or All Access Pay Per Use.

Pricing and promotions

  • Own building-level pricing for all On Demand products, including periodic price reviews, phased price revisions and measuring their impact on orders, revenue and realisation.

  • Plan and govern offers and discounts across WeWork and partner channels: set budgets and approval rules, avoid discounting in buildings already at capacity, and run post-offer readouts on incremental volume and cost.

  • Set up partner, co-marketing and member offers on the Offer Engine (coupon codes), and work with the Tech team on new offer formats where needed.

Operations and inventory

  • Manage day-to-day operations. Member queries, coordination with myHQ. Responding to tickets etc.

  • Own day-to-day On Demand operations across locations, including product and inventory set-up, building launches and exits, booking issues, cancellations and refunds, and escalations, in coordination with Community and Regional Operations teams.

  • Manage inventory and capacity: monitor building-level utilisation, flag buildings that are at capacity or under-used, and work with Community teams on adding desks, reallocating inventory and opening new locations to On Demand.

  • Manage the dynamic private office inventory behind Day Pass Plus and Bookable Private Offices, including planning ahead for upcoming private office move-outs.

  • Monitor member experience through post-visit surveys (NPS), support tickets and on-ground feedback, and close the loop on recurring issues such as booking friction, crowding and service gaps.

myHQ and channel partnerships

  • Manage the myHQ partnership end to end, covering joint business planning, inventory and pricing alignment, campaigns and offers, customer support and escalations, B2B opportunities and monthly revenue-share settlements.

  • Run regular performance reviews with myHQ on volume, discount levels, new-user acquisition and revenue quality, and agree actions and governance for future offers.

  • Manage other aggregator and API partners, from onboarding and booking flows to monthly invoicing and reconciliation, and build new distribution channels such as corporate, employer and HR benefits partnerships.

Product and digital experience

  • Own the On Demand booking journey on the WeWork India app and website (discovery, product pages, checkout, payment and confirmation), working with Tech Product teams to improve conversion, reduce drop-offs and grow the share of direct bookings.

  • Write clear business requirements and user stories, prioritise the On Demand roadmap and backlog, run UAT and manage launches for new features and products.

  • Own On Demand tracking and analytics requirements: define funnels and events (e.g. Mixpanel), make sure bookings, revenue and failed transactions are captured accurately and in line with data privacy requirements, and use the data to run experiments.

  • Work with Marketing on demand generation, including website and in-app content, CRM and lifecycle campaigns, performance marketing and building-level activations.

Strategy and new initiatives

  • Shape the On Demand strategy and annual plan, including targets, growth levers, business cases and the product roadmap.

  • Generate and test new revenue ideas (new products, bundles, corporate offerings, partnerships and channels) through quick, low-cost pilots with clear success and stop criteria.

  • Keep track of the market, including flexible workspace operators, aggregators, pricing and customer trends, and feed those insights into pricing, product and posit ioning decisions.

Reporting and stakeholder management

  • Run the On Demand operating cadence: weekly performance checks and monthly business reviews that end in clear decisions, owners and timelines.

  • Maintain the On Demand tracker and dashboards (revenue versus target; product, channel, city and building views; AOV and utilisation) and prepare leadership reviews and presentations.

  • Partner with BI to fix data quality issues and close data gaps such as order counts, repeat rates, funnel conversion and utilisation.

  • Act as the single point of contact for On Demand across Tech Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI, Legal and Sales, keeping everyone aligned on priorities, timelines and one shared set of numbers.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor s Degree required in a related field; an MBA is a plus

  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience (preferably in Product, Category, Business Operations or Revenue Management within consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, travel/hospitality or flexible workspace)

  • Proven ownership of revenue targets or a PL, with a track record of moving business metrics

  • Strong analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and comfort working with large booking and revenue datasets

  • Experience working with Tech Product teams on requirements, prioritisation, testing and launches

  • Good understanding of pricing, promotions and unit economics

  • Experience managing external partners, aggregators or marketplace channels is a plus

  • Exposure to product analytics and BI tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Tableau) is a plus; SQL is a plus

  • Excellent communication, writing and presentation skills, including presenting to senior leadership

  • Ownership mindset and comfort working across teams without direct authority in a fast-paced environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. title: Data & MarTech Analyst
description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a senior, hands-on Data MarTech Analyst, engaged as an external consultant, to keep our marketing tracking, attribution and measurement stack accurate and continuously improving. A baseline tracking audit has already been completed. This role takes it forward through continuous and incremental assessments, hands-on remediation and a documented playbook.
You will be the single point of contact between our marketing, technology and data teams on all tracking and measurement matters, combining deep MarTech expertise with strong data analysis. The role focuses on measurement and on the technical / MarTech implementation of the changes needed. Marketing and campaign decisions remain with the marketing teams. The role works closely with the marketing teams (including Country CMOs), Finance (revenue and new-customer definitions), Legal / data protection (consent), Engineering and external vendors.
Channel scope: Paid Online Marketing is the highest priority. CRM (Email, Push, WhatsApp), offline sales and other additional sales channels (including affiliates and referral) and SEO / organic (including AEO and GEO) follow, with roughly equal priority.


Responsibilities
  • Tracking, Channel Mapping Attribution Foundation: This underpins every interaction, conversion and performance assessment across all channels.
  • Maintain the channel mapping and UTM / naming taxonomy (hierarchy, rules, priority ranks and owners per channel) for Paid, CRM, offline sales / additional sales channels, affiliates, SEO / organic and app, applied consistently across all markets.
  • Define and maintain conversion, event and customer definitions (e.g., purchase and value, new vs. returning customer), attribution rules and windows, and deduplication logic across web, app, CRM and offline sales / additional sales channels, keeping one offline-sales definition across ad exclusion, new-customer KPIs and CRM segments.
  • Keep the tracking plan, dataLayer / event specification and mapping logic aligned with data pipeline rules and business reporting, and manage the impact of mapping changes on historical data.
  • Maintain the event dictionary across web, Android and iOS: consistent event names, one customer ID shared by web, app and the mobile measurement partner, local currency with ISO codes, and consent respected.
  • Own the per-platform attribution windows and models, and the sources of truth (e.g., GA4, the mobile measurement partner).
  • Review the channel-mapping rulebook and pipeline logic, propose fixes, and simulate mapping changes before go-live; provide a UTM generator and a custom channel group.
  • Find and fix the root causes of Direct traffic and (not set) landing pages that distort organic and AI-assistant attribution (tracking, mapping and referrer rules).


Hands-on Tool Administration Remediation
  • Configure and fix tracking directly in Google Tag Manager (web and server-side), GA4, Google Ads, Meta, TikTok and mobile measurement tools (e.g., Adjust, Firebase): tags, pixels, Conversions API, enhanced conversions, consent mode, and audiences and exclusion lists.
  • Ensure the conversion signals sent to paid platforms are correct (one purchase conversion per order, with order ID and local-currency revenue), since they drive bidding.
  • Where code changes are required, write clear tickets with acceptance criteria for Engineering, then QA and verify the fixes in production.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements to the MarTech stack, work effectively with external partners and vendors, and review and accept their deliverables against agreed specifications.
  • Recommend and specify technical SEO, AEO and GEO improvements with the SEO and Engineering teams (e.g., rendering, structured data, AI crawler access), and verify them after release.
  • Own the integration of product catalogs and feeds with ad and shopping platforms (e.g., Google Merchant Center, Meta and TikTok catalogs, AI-assistant ads and product feeds) and the feed-management tools behind them: requirements, account and market set-up, feed rules, diagnostics and disapproval monitoring, and consistent product IDs across feed, pixel events and order data.
  • Administer the web / app analytics property: access, data streams, reporting currency, retention, internal traffic, key events, linkings, raw-data export and session continuity across domains.
  • Administer Search Console and other webmaster tools: properties, access, sitemap submissions, and monitoring of errors and alerts.
  • Audit and fix privacy and consent: no personal data in clear, hashed identifiers only, consent applied per market and passed to all platforms.
  • Configure mobile measurement: privacy-framework schemas (e.g., SKAN), reattribution, event clean-up, partner mapping, deep-link standards and SDK currency.
  • Plan and validate tracking migrations (e.g., server-side tagging, conversion APIs): parallel run, one-release switch, rollback and monitoring; define which orders feed the platforms server-side APIs, with a shared event ID.
  • Validate CRM and CDP event tracking (including push opens) and audience syncs to the CDP and ad platforms, with consent checks.
  • Define requirements and acceptance criteria for home-grown tracking, CRM and mobile-measurement solutions, contribute hands-on to their development if we build rather than buy, and support build-vs-buy evaluations.


Continuous Monitoring Incremental Assessments
  • Run recurring health checks: tag firing, conversions vs. orders reconciliation, UTM compliance, unassigned / (not set) traffic and consent impact, plus tracking QA before and after every major release, before every peak (e.g., Black Friday, anniversary) and at every new-market rollout.
  • Run incremental assessments by platform, channel and market, building on the completed baseline audit: extend it to all markets, close untested steps, drive the remediation backlog through to closure, and own open decisions and the decision log.
  • Set up automated monitoring and alerts on tracking-quality KPIs (e.g., conversion drops, cost spikes, broken events, shifts in unassigned traffic), in coordination with the BI team.
  • Analyse search and AI crawler traffic from logs and CDN reports, identify wrongful blocks, and recommend the allow / block policy for Security and Engineering to apply.
  • Monitor indexation (indexed-but-blocked pages, 404 and soft-404, redirect errors, sitemap quality), and raise prioritized findings with impact for Engineering.
  • Monitor page experience (Core Web Vitals field data) by market and template, report trends, and flag regressions after releases.
  • Validate structured data per market after each release.


Analytics, Insights Reporting
  • Build analytics and quick reports (SQL on the GA4 BigQuery export and order data, and the BI / reporting tools in place) that reconcile platform, GA4, mobile measurement and internal figures, by channel, market, device and customer type.

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Engineer with 5-7 years of hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, managing, and supporting enterprise security solutions across the following domains:


  • Endpoint Security (EPP, EDR, XDR)
  • Email Security
  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP)

The candidate should have strong technical knowledge and practical experience in security solution deployment, policy configuration, troubleshooting, customer engagements, Proof of Concepts (POCs), technical demonstrations, and post-implementation support.

The role will involve working closely with customers, internal presales teams, OEMs, and technology partners to deliver enterprise cybersecurity projects.


Key Responsibilities-


A. Endpoint Security (EPP / EDR / XDR)

  • Deploy, configure, and manage enterprise endpoint security solutions.
  • Implement EDR/XDR, next-generation antivirus, endpoint protection, and ransomware prevention solutions.
  • Configure endpoint security policies, application control, device control, and threat prevention.
  • Monitor and investigate endpoint security alerts and suspicious activities.
  • Perform malware investigation, threat hunting, endpoint isolation, containment, and remediation.
  • Troubleshoot endpoint agent deployment, communication, performance, and policy-related issues.
  • Integrate endpoint security platforms with SIEM, SOAR, and SOC solutions.
  • Conduct endpoint security assessments, POCs, and technical demonstrations.

Preferred OEM Technologies:

  • SentinelOne Singularity
  • CrowdStrike Falcon
  • Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
  • Palo Alto Networks Cortex XDR
  • Trend Micro Vision One
  • Check Point Harmony Endpoint
  • Sophos Intercept X
  • Trellix Endpoint Security
  • Fortinet FortiEDR

B. Email Security

  • Implement and manage enterprise email security solutions.
  • Configure email security gateways and cloud-based email security platforms.
  • Implement anti-spam, anti-phishing, malware protection, and advanced threat protection policies.
  • Configure Business Email Compromise (BEC) protection and account takeover prevention.
  • Implement URL protection, attachment sandboxing, impersonation protection, and email authentication controls.
  • Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
  • Integrate email security solutions with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
  • Troubleshoot email delivery, mail flow, quarantine, policy, and integration issues.
  • Conduct email security assessments, POCs, and customer demonstrations.

Preferred OEM Technologies:

  • Check Point Harmony Email & Collaboration
  • Proofpoint
  • Mimecast
  • Microsoft Defender for Office 365
  • Trend Micro Email Security
  • Fortinet FortiMail
  • Cisco Secure Email

C. Data Loss Prevention (DLP)

  • Deploy, configure, and manage enterprise DLP solutions.
  • Implement Endpoint DLP, Network DLP, Email DLP, and Cloud DLP.
  • Configure data classification, discovery, monitoring, and protection policies.
  • Implement controls to prevent unauthorized data transfer through USB, removable media, email, web uploads, and cloud applications.
  • Configure sensitive data identification using predefined and custom data patterns.
  • Implement data protection policies for PII, financial information, confidential documents, and intellectual property.
  • Configure data encryption, policy-based blocking, alerting, and user notifications.
  • Monitor DLP incidents, investigate policy violations, and recommend remediation.
  • Integrate DLP solutions with Microsoft 365, cloud applications, SIEM, and other enterprise security platforms.
  • Conduct DLP assessments, POCs, and technical demonstrations.

Preferred OEM Technologies:

  • Forcepoint DLP
  • Symantec DLP
  • Trellix DLP
  • CoSoSys Endpoint Protector
  • Seclore
  • GTB Technologies
  • Microsoft Purview Information Protection and DLP

4. Technical Skills & Competencies

Candidates should have good knowledge and practical experience in:

  • Endpoint security architecture, EPP, EDR, and XDR.
  • Email security architecture, email gateways, and cloud email protection.
  • Data Loss Prevention architecture and data classification.
  • Windows operating systems, Linux, and macOS.
  • Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, and Google Workspace.
  • Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Group Policy.
  • Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SMTP, and network protocols.
  • Security incident investigation and troubleshooting.
  • SIEM integration and security event monitoring.
  • Cloud security fundamentals and enterprise security best practices.

5. Customer Engagement & Project Responsibilities

  • Understand customer technical requirements and existing security infrastructure.
  • Conduct technical assessments and recommend appropriate security solutions.
  • Independently execute security solution deployment and implementation projects.
  • Participate in customer meetings, technical discussions, and requirement-gathering sessions.
  • Conduct product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (POCs).
  • Prepare implementation plans, technical documentation, SOPs, and deployment reports.
  • Provide L2/L3 technical support and resolve customer issues.
  • Coordinate with OEMs and distributors for technical escalations and support.
  • Support internal presales teams with technical inputs, solution validation, and customer presentations.
  • Provide knowledge transfer and technical training to customer IT teams.

6. Experience & Qualification

  • 5-7 years of overall IT / Information Security experience.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of relevant hands-on experience in one or more of the following domains:
    • Endpoint Security / EDR / XDR
    • Email Security
    • Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
  • Experience in enterprise security solution deployment and administration.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant OEM certifications will be an added advantage.
  • Experience working with System Integrators, cybersecurity OEMs, or enterprise IT environments is preferred.

7. Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft SC-200 / SC-300 / SC-400
  • CrowdStrike Falcon Certifications
  • SentinelOne Technical Certifications
  • Palo Alto Cortex XDR Certifications
  • Check Point Security Certifications
  • Forcepoint DLP Certifications
  • Proofpoint / Mimecast Certifications
  • Relevant OEM technical certifications.

8. Key Behavioural Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Good verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to independently manage customer technical engagements.
  • Strong customer-facing and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams and technology partners.
  • Willingness to travel to customer locations when required.

title: Sr Statistician - Global MSAT
description:
Job Summary
This role offers you the chance to lead statistical activities within our global Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) team. You will work closely with teams across functions and countries to apply your statistical expertise to improve manufacturing processes, support product development, and ensure high-quality supply. We value collaborative problem solvers who communicate clearly and take ownership with care. Join us to grow your career while making a real impact on patient outcomes by helping bring medicines to life faster and better.


Job Purpose
Work with global multidisciplinary teams to accelerate statistically driven process understanding and problem solving in Global Supply Chain by driving business results with data-based insights and robust statistical methodologies.


Responsibilities
  • As a Subject Matter Expert in Statistics, help drive the statistically driven capability of GSC (Global Supply Chain) across all sites and functions, identifying and exploring opportunities for product and process optimisation and guiding the appropriate interpretation of statistical evidence for decisions.
  • Elaborate and communicate sophisticated statistical concepts, displaying information visually and making the patterns and insights revealed in data clear and compelling; communicate concepts and results in a way that is understandable to stakeholders and demonstrate storytelling with data, both verbally and visually.
  • Maintain and influence internal global networks to adopt rigorous and sound statistical approaches and standardise methodologies globally.
  • Work Model: This is an on-site role based in India. We offer a supportive environment where inclusion is valued, and your unique perspective is welcomed. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work and grow both professionally and personally.
  • Act as an essential partner within cross-functional global teams by providing statistical expertise to help interpret statistical outputs and use these alongside other scientific understanding to drive outcomes aligned to values, particularly for deviations, investigations and improvement projects.
  • Lead the statistical analysis, reporting and communication of results and conclusions in the form of technical documents and presentations in accordance with regulatory and internal guidance, taking full ownership and accountability of all statistical content.
  • Design and lead appropriate statistical studies, including study design and sample size calculations, process and method validation, assay or process trending, assay or process transfers and similar applications relevant to MSAT and global manufacturing operations.
  • Ensure high-quality statistical evaluation and reporting, e.g. for regulatory dossiers, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements (e.g. QMS, SOPs, Ph.Eur., ICH/FDA guidelines) and ensuring integrity, traceability and reproducibility of statistical evaluations.
  • Influence internal policies, guidelines and SOPs to ensure appropriate statistical application and data evaluation in manufacturing, MSAT and quality systems.
  • Actively participate in, and when required lead, the wider statistics and data science network (MSAT, Quality, TRD and RD, as well as the GPS community) to develop, align and standardise data evaluation methods, methodologies and conventions, ensuring that best practices are incorporated into local ways of working at GCC.
  • Upskill the organisation through coaching, mentoring and training of non-statisticians and junior statisticians and data scientists on the appropriate application of statistics and data evaluation tools for their business processes.
  • Contribute statistical expertise to MSAT activities including process optimisation and troubleshooting, investigations and technology development, process validation, continuous improvement, technical support, regulatory compliance, data analysis and reporting, training and audit readiness for global site operations.


Qualifications
  • Masters degree or PhD in statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, or related field, with a strong focus on Statistics.
  • Provides a comprehensive understanding of statistical theory required for the application and leadership of appropriate methodologies in a complex manufacturing and MSAT environment.


Skills
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Bioinformatic Analysis
  • Computational Biology
  • Data Analysis Tools
  • Data Visualization
  • Data Storytelling
  • Genomics
  • Life Science
  • Machine Learning (ML)

title: Manager - Data Analytics
description:

The Internal Audit Department provides an independent appraisal function to support effective management controls. The Audit Analytics Software Development (AASD) Team supports Internal Audit and Company stakeholders by delivering innovative, relevant, and timely analytics, applications, and automation solutions.

People Leadership and Team Management

  • Set individual goals and performance expectations; hold regular one-on-ones; conduct formal performance evaluations; and provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and career development support in accordance with HHIN processes.

  • Partner with U.S.-based AASD leadership to establish and align team priorities, performance objectives, technical standards, and delivery expectations for HHIN-based analysts.


Analytics Development and Technical Delivery

  • Use Python extensively to ingest, clean, transform, validate, analyze, and automate data; write reliable, well-documented, reusable code and apply appropriate testing, version control, and error-handling practices.

  • Apply HCA Healthcare-approved development practices, data governance, access controls, information security standards, and confidentiality requirements when handling data.

Education Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field is required.

description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Job Description

What you'll be doing:

You will be the architecture owner for Experian's endpoint-aligned secure access and data protection capabilities, bringing Proxy, CASB, and endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) into consistent Zero Trust architecture. You will define the target architecture, standards, policy patterns, telemetry, and lifecycle roadmap while providing accountable leadership through the transition from the legacy Skyhigh, AnyConnect, Prisma, and Trellix estate.

  • Define Endpoint Security Architecture - Establish standards, reference architectures, policy guardrails, and configuration baselines for Proxy, CASB, Endpoint DLP, device posture, and identity-based access.
  • Lead SSE Transformation - Govern the Secure Service Edge (SSE) migration, including coexistence, cutover planning, rollback strategy, and operational readiness.
  • Integrate Proxy, CASB DLP - Create a unified security model across web traffic inspection, data protection, CASB controls, and secure access policies.
  • Drive Zero Trust Access - Design access policies based on identity, device health, application context, and least-privilege principles, integrated with Okta and endpoint services.
  • Manage Technology Lifecycle - Maintain roadmaps and mitigate risks related to legacy and end-of-support security platforms.
  • Enhance Security Operations - Define monitoring, telemetry, alerting, reporting, and incident response capabilities to support sustainable operations.
  • Secure Collaboration Environments - Partner with Network, UC, and Facilities teams to ensure secure connectivity and monitoring for offices and conferencing spaces.
  • Provide Technical Leadership - Lead engagement with security vendors and collaborate across Security, Identity, Network, Endpoint, Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams.
  • Support Governance Strategy - Deliver architecture decisions, roadmaps, risk assessments, and recommendations for leadership and governance forums.
  • You will be reporting to VP of Engineering
Qualifications

What are we looking for:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network security, endpoint security, secure web gateway/proxy, SSE/SASE, CASB, or DLP architecture within.
  • Proven experience designing and governing identity-aware Zero Trust access and data protection patterns across endpoints, virtual workspaces, cloud services, remote access, and office environments.
  • Deep technical expertise in secure web gateways, traffic inspection, policy design, endpoint DLP, CASB, identity integration (e.g., Okta), device posture, certificate lifecycle, logging, and telemetry.
  • Demonstrated leadership of major platform migrations and warm cutovers - including lifecycle transitions and end-of-life remediation - while maintaining operational continuity.
  • Strong cross-functional delivery leadership at the intersection of Workplace, Network, Endpoint, Identity, Security, Data Protection, and service operations, with disciplined program governance (incident, problem, change, capacity, risk, and vendor management).

title: Insurance Follow-up Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Insurance Follow-up Specialist ensures that the healthcare provider and facility receive timely and accurate payments from insurance companies. This position involves thorough follow-up on outstanding claims and working to resolve any issues that may delay payment. The Insurance Follow-up Specialist ensures the efficient management of insurance claims, contributing to the financial stability and operational success of the healthcare provider and facility.

Responsibilities
  • Regularly review and monitor outstanding insurance claims to ensure timely resolution and payment.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value or aged claims for immediate follow-up.
  • Contact insurance companies via phone, email, or electronic portals to inquire about the status of unpaid claims.
  • Escalate issues to insurance representatives or supervisors when necessary to expedite resolution.
  • Document all communication and actions taken on each claim in the billing system.
  • Update patient accounts with the current status of claims and expected payment dates.
  • Resubmit corrected claims to insurance companies when errors are identified.
  • Work closely with billing, and coding teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure accurate claims submission.
  • Communicate effectively with healthcare providers and clinical staff to obtain additional information or clarification needed for claims processing.
  • Assist patients with calling their insurance plans to resolve claim processing issues.
  • Document detailed and organized follow-up activities, including communication logs, and claim statuses.
  • Ensure that documentation is complete and compliant with internal policies and external regulations.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of claims follow-up.
  • Ensure that all follow-up activities comply with federal and state regulations, as well as payer-specific requirements.
  • Adhere to HIPAA guidelines to protect patient information and maintain confidentiality.
  • Stay updated on changes in insurance guidelines, billing regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Participate in training and professional development opportunities to maintain and enhance expertise in insurance follow-up procedures.
Minimum Requirements

Required Education/Course(s)/Training:

  • High school diploma/equivalent or higher.
  • 5 + years of experience in A/R follow-up.

Required Certification/Registration:

  • None.
  • Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR) preferred.

Skill Set Requirement:

  • Ability to analyze claims, identify issues, and develop solutions.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail in reviewing and following up on claims.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues related to claims processing.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective interaction with insurance representatives, patients, and internal teams.
  • Understanding of healthcare billing regulations, HIPAA compliance, and insurance guidelines.
  • Proficient in payment review systems, hospital information systems and coding methodologies.
  • Intermediate knowledge of CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding standards.
  • Communicate orally and in written form.
  • Understand insurance terms and payment methodologies.

$18.01 - $26.25/hr

  • Monday - Friday, full-time, day shift

title: SAP Cloud Platform Lead
description:
The SAP Cloud Platform Lead is responsible for the governance, architecture, operations, and continuous evolution of the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) across the enterprise.

This role acts as the central owner of the SAP BTP platform, ensuring the platform is secure, scalable, operationally stable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and Clean Core principles.

The role combines platform architecture governance with operational leadership, overseeing platform standards, environment strategy, security architecture, DevOps enablement, and platform lifecycle management.

The SAP Cloud Platform Lead works closely with ERP Technical Architecture, Integration and Application delivery domains, and enterprise architecture teams to enable scalable and governed SAP platform adoption across cloud and hybrid landscapes.

In addition, this role is responsible for coaching and developing the BTP Operations Specialist, gradually transitioning operational responsibilities while evolving the platform capability toward stronger architecture governance and strategic enablement.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Platform Strategy & Governance

  • Define and maintain BTP reference architecture
  • Define and enforce Clean Core and extension principles
  • Define platform standards, governance frameworks, and best practices
  • Align BTP roadmap with enterprise architecture and SAP strategy
  • Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB)

Platform Architecture & Security

  • Define subaccount and environment strategy
  • Define IAM and security architecture (IAS / IPS, SSO, role concepts)
  • Define transport, DevOps, and connectivity architecture
  • Ensure secure and scalable hybrid architecture across SAP landscapes
  • Define reusable patterns and developer guidelines

Platform Operations & Lifecycle Management

  • Own BTP global account and subaccount lifecycle
  • Govern entitlement and service management
  • Ensure operational stability, monitoring, logging, and support processes
  • Oversee transport management, CI/CD, and platform tooling
  • Manage platform compliance, audit support, certificates, and connectivity
  • Coordinate SAP OSS support, escalation, and SAP user administration

Platform Enablement & Continuous Improvement

  • Support onboarding of new projects and teams onto BTP
  • Promote reusable services, templates, and standards
  • Evaluate new BTP services and innovation opportunities
  • Drive automation and operational efficiency improvements
  • Support FinOps optimization and consumption governance

3. COMPLEXITY OF THE JOB

The role operates within a complex hybrid SAP landscape, combining cloud-based BTP services with on-premise ERP systems and external platforms.

The SAP Cloud Platform Lead must manage:

  • Multiple BTP services across integration, application, and data domains
  • Multi-environment cloud platform (Neo & Cloud Foundry) with varying workloads and service types
  • Rapidly evolving cloud technologies and SAP innovations
  • Cross-functional dependencies between platform, integration, and applications
  • Global teams and projects with varying levels of maturity
  • The need to balance standardization, flexibility, and innovation

The role requires deep technical hands-on expertise and the ability to influence decisions without direct authority.

4. EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LANGUAGE, & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Academic Level:
  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related fields
  • Desirable: Masters degree in Computer science, Engineering
  • Language(s) and level of proficiency:
  • English, required professional proficiency
  • Spanish, desirable
  • Knowledge/Experience:
  • 8-10 years of experience in SAP architecture or enterprise integration
  • 5+ years of hands on experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
  • Strong experience designing and operating enterprise-scale SAP hybrid landscape (cloud and on-premise)
  • BTP Architecture and governance
  • Platform operations, monitoring and lifecycle management
  • DevOps, CI/CD, transport management, Cloud ALM
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • SAP Integration Suite
  • BTP Extension technologies (CAP, UI5)
  • IAS / IPS and identity & access management
  • BTP platform services and environment management
  • SAP Cloud Connector
  • BTP Launchpad / Fiori apps
  • BAS, GitHub, or other developer tools
  • Strong understanding, and preferably execution experience, of Clean Core and SAP extension strategy
  • Experience with cloud platform (Azure) is a plus
  • Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, and platform operations concepts
  • Experience leading or mentoring technical teams and coordinating with global stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills
  • Enthusiastic about new technology and innovation, eager to gain hands-on experience with new things.

description:
Founded in 1982, Shaw Bransford & Roth is a boutique litigation and government affairs law firm in Washington, D.C. We are a premier federal employment and federal practice group. We represent individuals and federal agencies in a wide array of civil and administrative litigation on employment issues, security clearance proceedings, attorney disciplinary matters, and federal government investigations. Our Government & Public Affairs practice provides representational and communications services for various federal employee professional associations.

Shaw Bransford & Roth has a unique practice area within the public employment niche and is seeking a Legal & Operations Assistant. We are a tight-knit group of attorneys and professionals. Our workplace emphasizes congeniality. We seek self-motivated applicants and value teamwork, collaboration, and employee engagement. We are looking for a motivated individual to provide clerical, administrative, and operational assistance and be involved in every component of the law firm.

This position supports attorneys and the entire office in collaboration and coordination with other professional support staff. The selected candidate should be willing to learn software platforms and become adept at proofreading and document management. The candidate will also be customer-service oriented, with great attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to switch gears easily. A high level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion in handling confidential client information, as well as the ability to work well with people at all levels inside and outside the firm.

Full-time, in-office role in downtown Washington, D.C. (Farragut North Metro, Red Line). Local D.C. metro area applicants only. This is not a paralegal position and will not evolve into a legal or paralegal track.

STARTING SALARY FOR THIS POSITION IS $70,000.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Maintain discretion and keep firm and client matters and materials in the strictest confidence.
  • Prepare, process, and file new client matters, prepare and process conflict checks, and open client files.
  • Handle heavy filing, organize, and maintain extensive sets of files, both paper and electronic, offsite and in-office
  • Perform limited legal research on Westlaw and PACER
  • Proofread legal documents accurately, prioritizing to meet deadlines.
  • Interact with and provide professional-level support to all staff and clients.
  • Serve as cross-functional point of contact for special administrative projects to support firm workflow.
  • General office duties such as answering telephones and preparing copies, greeting clients and guests, managing conference rooms and supplies, and other duties as assigned.
SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
  • Outstanding organizational skills and strong attention to detail
  • Sound independent judgment and common sense, with a moderate degree of supervisory attention.
  • Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to quickly learn and work across a wide range of office functions.
  • Excellent listening and verbal and written communication skills
QUALIFICATIONS
  • 5-7 years' experience in an office setting
  • Proficient or Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suites
  • Excellent time management skills to balance responsibilities and participate in special projects.
  • Exceptional computer skills with the ability to learn new software applications quickly.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Legal Blue Book and proofreading experience
  • Legal administrative experience
  • Familiarity with legal technologies and document management software is a plus, but not a requirement.
BENEFITS
  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental & vision costs are covered for employees.
  • 401K with safe harbor
  • Commuter benefits
  • Brand new office space with building amenities (gym with showers, secure bike room, rooftop outdoor seating, lunch area, cold brew, and bubble water taps, etc.)

title: Manex & Digital Executive
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a dynamic Manex Digital Executive to support the efficient management of Unilevers Manex (Manufacturing Excellence) programs and drive digital transformation initiatives within our operational framework. This role involves data analysis, project coordination, and the implementation of digital tools to optimize performance and foster continuous improvement across our manufacturing sites.

Job Responsibilities:

Assist in the planning, execution, and monitoring of Manex initiatives, including World Class Manufacturing (WCM) and other continuous improvement methodologies.
Collect, analyze, and interpret manufacturing data to identify trends, opportunities for improvement, and areas of concern.
Develop and maintain digital dashboards and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to Manex programs.
Support the implementation and integration of digital tools and technologies (e. g. , IoT, AI, advanced analytics) to enhance operational efficiency and data-driven decision-making.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e. g. , production, engineering, IT) to ensure alignment and successful delivery of Manex and digital projects.
Prepare and deliver presentations on Manex performance and digital initiative progress to various stakeholders.
Support the development and delivery of training programs related to Manex principles and digital tools for factory personnel.
Identify and advocate for best practices in manufacturing excellence and digital transformation within Unilever.
Assist in documenting processes, procedures, and lessons learned from Manex and digital projects.

Job Qualifications:

Bachelors degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical), Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
Proven experience (1-3 years) in a manufacturing environment, preferably with exposure to continuous improvement methodologies (e. g. , WCM, Lean, Six Sigma).
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis tools (e. g. , Excel, Power BI, Tableau).
Familiarity with digital technologies and their application in manufacturing (e. g. , MES, IoT platforms, automation).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams.
Strong project coordination and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Proactive and results-oriented mindset with a passion for driving continuous improvement and digital innovation.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

title: MEL Expert
description:
Job Summary

IPE Global seeks an experienced Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Expert to lead the monitoring, analytics, learning, and evidence generation for a Digital Governance and Social Protection Programme. The role will establish an integrated monitoring and learning system that tracks household-level progress from identification and validation through entitlement linkage, benefit receipt, grievance resolution, and sustained income security. The position will strengthen Programme performance through real-time dashboards, decision-support systems, data quality assurance, implementation research, and evidence generation to inform adaptive management and future scale-up.

Location

Patna, Bihar (India)

Contract

One-year fixed-term contract, renewable based on project performance, funding availability, and organizational requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design and operationalize the Programme MEL framework, results framework, indicators, and reporting systems.
  • Develop monitoring protocols for household listing, validation, entitlement mapping, benefit delivery, grievance redressal, and graduation outcomes.
  • Establish systems for routine data quality assessment, verification, and performance monitoring.
  • Lead periodic reviews of programme progress, implementation quality, and operational performance.
  • Lead development of dashboards, scorecards, and analytical products to support decision-making at district and state level.
  • Analyse entitlement gaps, scheme coverage, exclusion errors, service delivery bottlenecks, and household progression.
  • Generate actionable insights to improve programme implementation.
  • Support refinement of vulnerability scoring, prioritisation models, and decision-support tools.
  • Document implementation lessons, innovations, and best practices.
  • Produce analytical reports, policy briefs, presentations, and knowledge products.
  • Build monitoring and data use capacities of state and district programme teams.
  • Develop standard operating procedures, reporting templates, and monitoring tools.
  • Conduct periodic training on data quality, analysis, and evidence-based decision making.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree Statistics, Economics, Public Policy, Data Science, Development Studies, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in monitoring and evaluation of large government or development programmes.
  • Experience working with digital platforms, MIS, dashboards, and decision-support systems.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Experience in social protection, livelihoods, poverty reduction, or governance programmes preferred.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, Excel, SPSS or similar analytics platforms is desirable.
  • Excellent report writing and presentation skills

title: Sr Program Manager, Audit Intelligence
description:
Job Summary
Senior Program Manager, Audit Intelligence, Bengaluru | Coupang Careers Senior Program Manager, Audit Intelligence Description


Role Overview
As an Audit Intelligence Senior Program Manager, you will design and scale repeatable intelligence products that continuously monitor customer trust risks, growth drivers, competitive posture, and operational gaps. Moving beyond isolated ad-hoc analyses, you will build automated detection mechanisms that proactively direct organizational attention to high-leverage opportunities. You will transform strategic business questions into scalable AI-driven discovery workflows, turning raw signals into sustainable operational capabilities.


Why This Role Matters
As Coupang scales, the volume of potential opportunities and risks grows exponentially. The challenge is no longer finding data. The challenge is identifying which signals matter. This role builds the intelligence systems that continuously monitor the ecosystem and proactively surface the highest-value customer, commercial, and market opportunities before competitors, customers, or business stakeholders identify them.
You will create intelligence products that help the organization continuously monitor customer trust, pricing competitiveness, and customer value perception.
Examples include, but are not limited to, Blue Badge Trust intelligence, customer competitiveness scorecards, pricing trust deterioration detection, customer-value monitoring, and price sharpness opportunity identification.
You will develop systems that identify where growth, selection quality, and commercial performance can be improved.
Examples include, but are not limited to, Selection opportunity engines, underserved assortment detection, demand decline monitoring, seasonal opportunity discovery, new SKU acceleration frameworks, and tail-of-tail optimization programs.
You will create mechanisms that continuously monitor market dynamics and competitor activity.
Examples include, but are not limited to, competitiveness monitoring, competitor promotion surveillance, market-share risk detection, and category-level competitive position tracking.
Build Automated Task Generation Systems
You will develop frameworks capable of automatically generating prioritized task rooms and investigation queues.
Examples include creating workflows that automatically generate audit opportunities when competitiveness deteriorates, assign categories requiring intervention, or create task rooms for demand-spike and competitiveness investigations.
You will build intelligence products that allow leaders to quickly understand where pricing risks and opportunities exist.
Examples include executive dashboards, AI-generated intelligence summaries, weekly competitiveness reviews, customer trust scorecards, and opportunity prioritization reports.
You will identify opportunities to use AI agents and copilots to improve discovery, investigation, reporting, and prioritization activities.
Examples include GPT-generated business insights, Gemini-assisted market research, Devin-supported workflow automation, and Kiro-enabled task orchestration.


Basic Qualifications
  • 7+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience leading cross-functional programs.
  • Strong analytical and business judgment skills.
  • Experience building operational mechanisms or analytical frameworks.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Marketplace, pricing, or retail experience.
  • AI product, automation, or workflow experience.
  • SQL, Python, or advanced analytics skills.
  • Product and Engineering partnership experience.


Hybrid Work Model
Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts as a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work.

title: Director of Activities
description:

JOB PURPOSE:

philosophy. In collaboration with the Administrator, allocates resources in an efficient and economic manner to ensure each resident achieves the highest practicable physical, mental and psycho

social well-being.

2. Develops and provides individual and group activities for Residents that reflect interests of

iv. Schedule outings for the Residents (museums, plays, luncheons, tours, shopping)

ii. Checks on the Residents (by request) with daily phone calls.

xvii. Organize bulletin boards in each building.

xviii. Provide transportation to residents’ appointments and other events.

xix. Maintenance on both pianos.

title: Partnerships Operations Specialist - AI Partners
description:
Role Overview


Location: Greater Noida

Partnerships Operations Specialist

At Coforge, we bring together frontier AI, cloud and data platforms with industry expertise, advisory practices, forward-deployed engagement and AI-first engineering to help clients reimagine their people, processes and products Our Ecosystems & Partnerships team works across hyperscalers, AI labs and enterprise technology partners to turn that ambition into production AI, measurable client outcomes and compounding growth We connect strategy and investment with joint solutions, commercial execution and delivery, building businesses across company boundaries Join us to shape what comes next and help bring it to life with clients and partners

Get close to the work our delivery teams do and turn it into evidence the business can use You will own partner-operations workstreams for an assigned Global Delivery Unit (GDU), uncover client use cases, build credible performance reporting and help turn delivery experience into partner credentials, case studies and new opportunities Bring curiosity, technical interest and the confidence to ask the next question and keep asking until the work is clear

Your initial focus is OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI/Grok, Mistral, NVIDIA and open-weight models You will develop depth in enterprise AI and agent use cases, deployment evidence, adoption measures and reusable capability narratives The team shares methods and rotates responsibilities across reporting, technical evidence, marketing content and partner programs so you build breadth as well as a specialty


Key Responsibilities

  • Build working relationships inside your assigned GDU Interview delivery leaders, architects and project teams to uncover partner technology in use, the client problem, the solution, deployment status and measurable outcomes
  • Turn delivery findings into clear case-study drafts, capability summaries, partner submissions and sales material Work with technical, account and marketing teams to verify claims, secure required approvals and make the evidence reusable
  • Build and maintain Excel analysis, dashboards and performance reports Reconcile delivery, CRM and partner records; explain discrepancies, trends and business implications Keep pipeline, bookings, revenue, platform usage and funding distinct
  • Independently run several workstreams with clear owners, dependencies, milestones and decisions Secure commitments, challenge incomplete evidence constructively, follow through and escalate with options when progress is blocked
  • Coordinate relevant partner registrations, funding, credentials, competencies and enablement with Alliance Leads and Operations colleagues Learn the actual requirements of each assigned partner and maintain accurate supporting evidence
  • Rotate shared responsibilities across analytics, technical evidence, marketing and case-study development Document methods, coach colleagues and maintain a trained backup for the processes you own Organize learning sessions, share useful practices and recognize others contributions
  • Use AI and automation to improve research, analysis and reporting Check sources and outputs, protect access and client information, and measure improvement including review effort

Job Requirements

  • Evidence of independently delivering analytical, technical, commercial, marketing or operations workstreams with limited guidance Structure ambiguous problems, test assumptions and adapt as evidence changes Relevant work and substantial project experience both count; tenure alone does not establish readiness
  • Strong Excel and data-analysis skills, including joining and reconciling datasets, formulas, pivot tables, data-quality checks and clear charts Build usable dashboards in Power BI or a comparable tool and explain what the numbers mean
  • Technical fluency in cloud, data and enterprise AI sufficient to interview delivery practitioners, understand an architecture or use case, and distinguish production results from plans or proofs of concept Learn unfamiliar platforms quickly
  • Clear business English and confident stakeholder engagement Lead working sessions, ask specific follow-up questions, challenge appropriately, provide direct feedback and turn discussion into decisions and next steps
  • Ability to write concise, evidence-backed case studies, presentations and performance commentary for technical and business audiences Explain the client problem, your findings, the outcome and its limitations
  • Sound commercial judgment, attention to accuracy and dependable follow-through across competing priorities Balance client, partner and Coforge interests, seek feedback and apply lessons across workstreams
  • Hold a current, verifiable cloud, data or AI certification relevant to the assignment before hire The hiring manager will confirm the accepted credential Course attendance or training badges alone do not satisfy this requirement

A Master's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience Demonstrate a practical AI-assisted workflow and explain how you validate its output


Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI/Grok, Mistral, NVIDIA and open-weight models, through delivery, partner programs, analytics, consulting, technical marketing or solution development

SQL, Power Query, CRM or partner-portal experience; automation, technical writing, customer references or case-study development

Relevant graduate study, including an MBA, and additional technical certifications are weighted favorably


How We Work

Join a shared team based in Greater Noida and Bengaluru, reporting to the Director, Partnerships Programs & Operations Regular attendance at the designated Coforge office and direct engagement with delivery colleagues are expected Each specialist has a primary GDU assignment and an initial platform specialty; shared responsibilities rotate with clear handovers Agree working hours that overlap with the teams supported Travel is based on business needs


What Good Looks Like

Delivery teams trust you to understand their work Leaders can act on your reporting Client stories and partner submissions are accurate, approved and reusable Workstreams move without repeated prompting, and the team becomes more capable through what you share


Your First 90 Days

Map your GDU stakeholders and delivery portfolio, establish a reliable reporting baseline, take ownership of a partner workstream, and produce a verified case-study draft with a clear approval path Share one practical improvement and train a colleague to use it


For more insights, connect with SANJANA MEHRA

title: Maint Dir HCC
description:
JOB PURPOSE:
The Maintenance Director assumes administrative authority, responsibility and accountability to maintain the facility physical plant and essential mechanical, electrical and patient/resident care equipment in safe operating condition. Manages employees in provision of maintenance services that protect the health and safety of patients/residents, personnel and the public and provided are consistent with Life Safety Code of the National Fire Protection Association and with all state and federal laws and regulations.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  1. Collects, reviews maintenance requisitions from all unit and departments of facility.
  2. Reviews information, establishes priorities, assigns staff or inspects, replaces, repairs, or otherwise resolves the problem.
  3. Establishes and conducts scheduled maintenance throughout physical plant and for all equipment.
  4. Maintains and tests the emergency power system to ensure availability of power to all entrances, exits fire detection alarms and extinguishing equipment, and life support systems in the event electrical supplies are interrupted.
  5. Must be able to perform all perform all daily duties of maintenance staff and maintains all essential equipment (e.g., boiler room equipment, nursing unit/medication room refrigerators, kitchen refrigerator/freezer, and laundry equipment) in safe operating condition.
  6. Establishes procedures to ensure the availability of potable water to essential to essential areas in the event of loss of normal water supply.
  7. Monitors acceptable range of temperatures and immediately starts repairs to eliminate hazards for facility residents, staff and others
  8. Communicates directly with residents, families, legal representatives to identify appropriate to individuals needs and abilities
  9. Monitors the performance of maintenance staff by observing staff on all units, on all shift and interviewing facility staff, residents, and families.
  10. Performs quality assurance functions, including compliance rounds, on daily basis to evaluate compliance with state and federal laws and regulations, and facility policies and procedures.
  11. Develops and updates maintenance policies and procedures that reflect the philosophy and objectives of the facility and are consistent with state and federal regulations.
  12. Completes required documentation and record keeping of maintenance activities. Audits records of maintenance staff for accuracy, completeness. Implements approaches to improve department record keeping practices.
  13. Collaborate with consultants with timely responses to requests for information and suggestions to improve quality of maintenance services.
  14. Monitors staff for compliance with OSHA mandates on workplace safety including hazard communication and blood borne pathogens. In cases of workplace exposure, provides immediate first-aide and refers employee to appropriate facility staff member for post-exposure follow-up.

title: Medical Records Coordinator
description:
JOB PURPOSE:
Assumes authority, responsibility and accountability for the responsibility and accountability for the record keeping procedures and storage of all clinical records in a manner consistent with facility policies and procedures, professional standards and state and federal laws and regulations for long term care facilities. Establishes and implements policies to ensure that records are complete, accurately documented, and readily accessible and systematically organized. Collaborates with Nursing Home Administrator to allocate department resources in an efficient and economic manner to achieve department objectives.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  1. Ensures that all clinical records contain sufficient information to identify the resident; a record of the resident’s assessments; the plan of care and services provided; the results of any preadmission conducted by the State and, progress notes.
  2. Initiates and participates in the development of facility policies and procedure to ensure that medical records are complete, accurately documented, readily accessible and systematical organized
  3. Develops and implements record storage and retrieval system that complies with applicable record retention laws maintains accessibility of records.
  4. Inspects closed records for completeness. Systematically organizes closed medical records for long term storage. Reports delays in completing records to Nursing Home Administrator.
  5. Develops and maintain appropriate safeguards against unauthorized access and use of computer based medical records.
  6. Evaluates medical records forms and record format. Makes recommendations for change to continuously improve quality of facility records and record keeping practices.
  7. Evaluates, through record reviews of open and closed records, compliance with medical record documentation policies. Reports finding to Nursing Home Administrator and Director of Nursing Services.
  8. Develops and conducts educational programs for facility staff to explain and discuss documentation policies and practices. Provides training and staff development opportunities to ensure that staff can distinguish between confidential/non-confidential information and release information only in compliance with facility policies.
  9. Maintains, updates and distributes the lists of facility approved abbreviations and definitions.
  10. Provides access to all records pertaining to residents (including current medical record) within 24 hours of oral or written request of resident or legal representative. Makes photocopies available with two working days of request.
  11. Develops and implements safeguards against loss, destruction, unauthorized access or use of clinical record information including procedures to maintain confidentiality of all information contained in resident’s record and to obtain authorized consents to release information. Releases information without written consent of resident or legal representative only when required by law.
  12. Advises Administration, physicians, facility staff on applicable requirements regarding the control, use and release of clinical information. Advises Administration on ways to safeguard confidentiality of medical records of facility staff.
  13. Conducts periodic quality control assessments of staff implementation of medical records policies and procedures. Analyzes findings and develops, implements ways to improve performance.
  14. Collects and displays clinical data requested by Administration, facility committees, regulatory agencies, or accrediting bodies.
  15. Participates in the development of the department budget. Provides relevant financial information to Nursing Home Administrator regarding department financial needs and status.
  16. Communicates with Nursing Home Administrator on daily basis to discuss medical record and budget issues. Recommends to Nursing Home Administrator numbers and type of personnel needed to meet facility needs in compliance with state and federal laws and regulations.
  17. Actively participates in long term care survey process by instruction staff in matters of conduct and disclosure, maintaining a presence at all times surveyors are on-site and directing the timely collection of information required by the survey team.
  18. Demonstrates concern for identified problems and undertakes corrective action while survey is in progress if appropriate. Gathers and presents supplemental documentation to avoid potential deficiencies. Collaborates with Nursing Home Administrator to develop responses to survey report as needed.
  19. Maintains current skills and knowledge through continuing education. Applies information to job responsibilities. Performs other duties as assigned by Supervisor.

MINIMUM EDUCATION REQUIRED:
High school diploma or equivalent.
MINIMUM EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
One (1) year experience as medical records practitioner in long term care facility.
ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS: (Preferred qualifications)
Preferred current certification as an Accredited Records Technician. Certification as a Registered Records Administrator preferred.
