title: Penetration Tester
description:
At Battelle, your expertise in national security plays a direct role in safeguarding our nation and shaping global security strategies. Join our team and become part of a distinguished community of professionals dedicated to developing innovative solutions for complex threats and challenges. As a proven developer and system integrator, we leverage next-generation science, engineering, and technology to secure and protect critical assets—on the ground, in the air, in space, at sea, and across the cyber landscape.

Here, you will apply cutting-edge technology and research to strengthen national defense strategies, ensuring a safer future for generations to come. At Battelle, you're not just building a career; you're upholding a legacy of protecting national interests and promoting peace and stability worldwide.

Job Summary

We are currently seeking a Penetration Tester. This position is a full-time opportunity located in Arlington, Virginia.

Battelle's Mission Focused Tools Business Line is seeking a Penetration Tester to support the research, development, test, and evaluation of security systems and technologies for the Department of Homeland Security, operating out of Battelle's Crystal City Operations. The selected candidate will work across technical areas including non-intrusive inspection systems, physical security technology, command and control integration, operational technology, industrial control systems, embedded systems, and other specialized mission-support technologies.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in test and evaluation, cybersecurity assessment, technical analysis, and quality-focused delivery, with the ability to engage directly with clients, vendors, and stakeholders in both laboratory and field environments.

Responsibilities

As a Penetration Tester, the selected individual will support the research, development, test, and evaluation of security systems and technologies for the Department of Homeland Security. Responsibilities may include:

  • Conducting cybersecurity assessments, vulnerability assessments, and security control validation in support of federal acquisition-based test and evaluation activities
  • Performing penetration testing and utilizing technical tools for packet capture, configuration validation, data collection, and data analysis
  • Developing and presenting clear, high-quality technical reports for government, engineering, and stakeholder audiences
  • Supporting test planning, test execution, data reduction, and data analysis in both laboratory and field environments
  • Engaging directly with government clients, vendors, and stakeholders on a regular basis to support program objectives
  • Supporting engineering design reviews and participating in Integrated Product Team (IPT) activities
  • Contributing to technology maturation throughout the developmental lifecycle
  • Participating in technical conferences, supporting proposal development, and contributing to white papers and other research products identifying opportunities for future technology development or operational improvement
  • Ensuring quality-focused delivery in accordance with ISO 9001 Quality Management System standards

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (BS or BA) or higher in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, information technology, data science, physical sciences, mathematics, or a related technical discipline
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret and TSA Security Suitability; sole U.S. citizenship required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of technical work experience with a BS/BA degree, or minimum of 2 years with an MS or higher degree
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity, risk assessment, test and evaluation, vulnerability assessment, security control validation, systems engineering, operational technology assessment, or related technical evaluation activities
  • Experience using technical tools to support cybersecurity assessments, test execution, data collection, data analysis, vulnerability review, configuration validation, packet capture, and technical reporting
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical observations, analyze test results, and develop and present technical reports for diverse audiences
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in both laboratory and field settings
  • Travel up to 25% required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current TSA Security Suitability
  • Current Secret Security Clearance or higher
  • Experience in the test and evaluation of Transportation Security Equipment (TSE), security screening technologies, non-intrusive inspection systems, detection systems, or other DHS mission-support technologies
  • Defense Acquisition University (DAU) T&E Level I, II, and/or III certification or equivalent
  • Experience assessing cybersecurity risks in operational technology, industrial control systems, embedded systems, scientific systems, laboratory systems, command and control systems, or other specialized non-traditional IT environments
  • Experience applying statistics or data analysis to analyze and report test results
  • Experience designing, implementing, or supporting data collection hardware, instrumentation, sensors, logging methods, or other data collection techniques

Benefits: Live an Extraordinary Life
We care about your well-being, not just on the job. Battelle offers comprehensive and competitive benefits to help you live your best life.

  • Balance life through a compressed work schedule: Most of our team follows a flexible, compressed work schedule that allows for every other Friday off—giving you a dedicated day to accomplish things in your personal life without using vacation time.
  • Enjoy enhanced work flexibility, including a hybrid arrangement: You have options for where and when you work. Our Together with Flexibility model allows you to work 60% in-office and 40% remote, with Monday and Tuesday as common in-office days, dependent on team and position needs.
  • Take time to recharge: You get paid time off to support work-life balance and keep motivated.
  • Prioritize wellness: Stay healthy with medical, dental, and vision coverage with wellness incentives and benefits plus a variety of optional supplemental benefits.
  • Better together: Coverage for partners, gender-affirming care and health support, and family formation support.
  • Build your financial future: Build financial stability with an industry-leading 401(k) retirement savings plan. For most employees, we put in 5 percent whether you contribute or not, and match your contributions on top of that.
  • Advance your education: Tuition assistance is available to pursue higher education.

A Work Environment Where You Succeed
For brilliant minds in science, technology, engineering and business operations, Battelle is the place to do the greatest good by solving humanity’s most pressing challenges and creating a safer, healthier and more secure world.

You will have the opportunity to thrive in a culture that inspires you to:

  • Apply your talent to challenging and meaningful projects
  • Receive select funding to pursue ideas in scientific and technological discovery
  • Partner with world-class experts in a collaborative environment
  • Nurture and develop the next generation of scientific leaders
  • Give back to and improve our communities

title: Sr Analyst, Research
description:
Senior Analyst - Research, JLL Business Services (JBS)

Role Overview
The Market Analysis is the single source of data for Strategy Research teams. It holds third-party market data, internal forecasts, Fair Value inputs and model outputs, all mapped to one common data model of geography, sector and field hierarchies. This role sits between data engineering and the research teams. You will work with engineers to build the pipelines that load data into Market Analysis, and you will own the quality, consistency and documentation of that data once it is there.


Key Responsibilities
  • Ingest and map data into Market Analysis. Work with data engineering to design and run pipelines that load third-party and internal datasets into Market Analysis. Examples include Oxford Economics, MSCI, NCREIF, Altus, Green Street, JLL data and Fair Value input files. Map each dataset to the data model, assigning every value of its required classifications. Handle scheduled refreshes and user template uploads.
  • Own definitions and classification. Maintain the data dictionary, the sector classification and its cross-walks to external taxonomies, and the multi-level geography hierarchy. Decide, with research owners, when a third-party category maps to an existing entry and when it needs a new one. Document the judgement calls made at ingest so they stay consistent over time.
  • Protect the structure of the database. Because the platform does not enforce key relationships automatically, run regular integrity checks. These include records with no valid parent, broken or circular hierarchy chains, nodes sitting at the wrong level, duplicate entries and formatting defects such as stray whitespace that silently break joins.
  • Automated quality checks.
    • Range bands, stale or constant values, missing periods, and accounting-identity checks, for example completions minus withdrawals against the change in stock.
    • Detection of restatements and reclassifications by comparing each new load against prior versions held in the database's version history.
    • Checks that mandatory classifications are present on every record before data is released to users.
  • Monitor and report. Build dashboards covering data freshness, coverage by region and sector, check failures and an open-issue log.
  • Work with data owners. Route exceptions to named owners, including regional quant teams, research teams, Securities and the JLL data teams. Track issues to resolution, coordinate changes to hierarchies and definitions, and keep lineage and version history documented.
  • Govern access and licensing. Make sure vendor data is used within its license terms and that access follows the firm's information-classification and access-control requirements.
  • Keep the data usable downstream. Market Analysis feeds dashboards, Excel downloads, Databricks data lake modelling pipelines and AI tools that query it directly with SQL. Make sure metadata and definitions are clear enough that these consumers pull the right data without manual interpretation.


Required Skills Qualifications
  • Experience: A bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative, information systems or related discipline, with 3-5 years in data management, data quality or analytics engineering.
  • SQL: Advanced, including validation, reconciliation and anti-join checks on large tables, and querying JSON-structured data. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
  • Python: For ingestion scripts and automated checks (PySpark is a plus).
  • Data modelling: Working knowledge of reference and master data, hierarchies, keys and versioned or time-variant data. Familiarity with hub-and-satellite (Data Vault) patterns is an advantage.
  • BI tools: Power BI or Tableau, for operational dashboards.
  • Ways of working: Disciplined documentation. Comfortable working with owners across time zones and chasing issues through to closure.


What Sets You Apart
  • Experience with Databricks or Unity Catalog, and with data-validation frameworks.
  • Git.
  • Familiarity with real estate or economic data sources and their classification systems (for example MSCI, NCREIF or Altus data sources).
  • A data governance certification, such as DAMA CDMP.
  • Hands-on experience managing data licensing constraints.

title: Migration Specialist Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Project Engineer/Migration Specialist to deliver Microsoft 365, identity, and migration projects for our clients. This is hands-on cloud engineering, not advisory work: you build and harden tenants, untangle hybrid identity, manage devices through Intune, and move mail, files, and users between platforms without losing data or a weekend.

You will work across many client tenants at once, typically with two to five projects running in parallel at different stages. Each project is yours to execute discovery, build, pilot, cutover, handover with a senior engineer available for architecture calls.

The experience bar

  • 5-10 years in IT overall, with at least 2 years administering Microsoft 365 and Entra IDacross more than one organization or tenant.
  • At least five migrations you personally executed mailbox, tenant-to-tenant, file, or Active Directory domain with the tooling you used named.
  • You own the technical execution and escalate architecture decisions. You are not expected to design a client's identity strategy from scratch; you are expected to implement one correctly and spot when it is wrong.

What you'll do

Migrations

  • Run mailbox, tenant, file, and domain migrations end to end using various migration tools discovery, pilot group, cutover plan, cutover, post-cutover support.
  • Agree rollback criteria and a downtime window with the client before the window opens, and hold to them.
  • Reconcile what actually moved against what was supposed to move, and chase the difference.

Microsoft 365 and Entra ID

  • Run mailbox, tenant, file, and domain migrations end to end using various migration tools — discovery, pilot group, cutover plan, cutover, post-cutover support.
  • Agree rollback criteria and a downtime window with the client before the window opens and hold to them.
  • Reconcile what moved against what was supposed to move and chase the difference.

Azure and endpoints

  • Deploy and maintain Azure infrastructure: VMs, virtual networks, NSGs, site-to-site VPN, Azure Files, Azure Backup, and Azure Virtual Desktop where clients use it.
  • Manage client devices through Intune: Autopilot enrolment, compliance and configuration profiles, app packaging and deployment, BitLocker and Defender policy, update rings.

Delivery and handover

  • Write the as-built documentation into IT Glue and brief the service desk, so nothing undocumented is left behind.
  • Keep project time and status current in the PSA so account managers can see where things stand.
  • Join client calls to explain what is changing, what will briefly break, and when.

Required qualifications

All four of the pillars below are required. Within each, you should be able to do most of what is listed without supervision.

1. Microsoft 365 administration

  • Exchange Online: mail flow, connectors, transport rules, shared and resource mailboxes, mailbox delegation, message trace, retention basics
  • Mail DNS: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Autodiscover, and what TTL does to a cutover
  • SharePoint Online and OneDrive: site and library creation, permission inheritance, sharing policies, sync troubleshooting
  • Microsoft Teams: provisioning, guest access, and how Teams relates to the SharePoint site behind it
  • Microsoft 365 admin center, license assignment, and group-based licensing

2. Entra ID (formerly Azure AD)

  • Users, groups, dynamic groups, administrative roles and units
  • Entra Connect Sync or Cloud Sync: installation, OU and attribute filtering, and resolving sync errors
  • Hybrid join versus Entra join, and when each applies
  • Conditional Access policy design, MFA rollout, SSPR, and why security defaults are not enough
  • Enterprise applications and SAML or OIDC single sign-on

3. Azure

  • Virtual machines, virtual networks, NSGs, public IPs, site-to-site VPN
  • Azure Files with AD DS or Entra authentication; Azure Virtual Desktop basics
  • Azure Backup and Recovery Services vaults
  • Subscriptions, resource groups, RBAC, and enough cost management to not surprise a client

4. Intune

  • Enrollment: Windows Autopilot, co-management, BYOD, Apple and Android enrollment
  • Compliance policies, configuration profiles, and the Settings Catalog
  • App deployment: Win32 packaging (.intunewin), Store apps, and line-of-business apps
  • BitLocker policy and Defender for Endpoint onboarding
  • Update rings and Windows Update for Business

5. Migration delivery— demonstrable experience in at least two of:

  • On-premises Exchange to Exchange Online: cutover, staged, or hybrid using the Hybrid Configuration Wizard
  • Tenant-to-tenant migration following an acquisition, divestiture, or rebrand
  • Google Workspace or IMAP to Microsoft 365
  • File server or NAS to SharePoint Online, OneDrive, or Teams
  • Active Directory domain migration or consolidation: ADMT, SID history, forest trusts, UPN suffix change, workstation re-domain
  • Another MDM platform into Intune

6. Windows Server and AD DS

  • Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, file and print services
  • Hyper-V setup and configuration

7. PowerShell

  • Bulk operations against Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph, and Entra
  • You read and modify scripts rather than only running ones you found

8. Working style

  • Experience working on a fully remote team.
  • Client-facing: comfortable explaining a downtime window to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Documentation discipline — across many tenants, undocumented work is lost work.
  • Available for scheduled after-hours and weekend cutover windows.
  • Prior MSP or multi-client experience.

Required qualifications

  • Security and compliance:Microsoft Purview (DLP, retention, sensitivity labels, eDiscovery), Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, Secure Score remediation, CIS benchmarks, HIPAA or CMMC-adjacent client work
  • Privileged identity:Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, entitlement management
  • Automation:Power Automate, Power Apps, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Graph API scripting beyond cmdlets

Helpful Qualifications

  • Microsoft 365 backup and BCDR:Veeam, Datto, Dropsuite, Afi, Acronis, Keepit
  • Hypervisors:VMware ESXi, Nutanix Acropolis
  • Other platforms:AWS, Google Workspace administration, Egnyte, Citrix ShareFile, Cloudflare, QuickBooks Online
  • Apple ecosystem:macOS and iOS deployment, Apple Business Manager, Jamf, Mosyle, or Intune for Mac
  • Network and edge:SonicWall and Fortinet firewalls, Cisco Meraki and Ubiquiti wireless, Cisco and Dell switching
  • Storage:QNAP, Synology, and Dell NAS, particularly as a migration source
  • MSP tooling:ConnectWise Manage and Automate, Sention, Autotask, Kaseya, NinjaOne, Datto RMM, IT Glue, Hudu; multi-tenant M365 administration tools such as Nerdio, inforcer, CIPP; password management such as Keeper; M365 migration tools such as BitTitan.

Certifications

At least one current Microsoft role-based certification, or demonstrable equivalent experience. Examples:

  • MS-102- Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert
  • SC-300- Identity and Access Administrator
  • MD-102- Endpoint Administrator
  • AZ-104- Azure Administrator Associate
  • AZ-800 / AZ-801- Windows Server Hybrid Administrator
  • MS-700- Teams Administrator
  • SC-200- Security Operations Analyst

title: Senior Software Security Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Security Engineer to develop high-quality training and evaluation tasks for frontier AI coding models. You will transform real-world open-source vulnerabilitiesincluding CVEs, security advisories, and bug reportsinto Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across multiple programming languages.

This role combines software security research, vulnerability reproduction, benchmark development, automated testing, and technical review. The goal is to create realistic tasks that evaluate whether AI systems can identify, understand, exploit, and securely remediate software vulnerabilities without relying on superficial pattern matching or known patches.

What does day-to-day look like

  • Source and analyze real-world vulnerabilities from CVEs, security advisories, bug reports, and open-source repositories.
  • Classify vulnerabilities using the most specific applicable CWE and map them to relevant OWASP Top 10 categories where appropriate.
  • Reproduce vulnerabilities and develop reliable proof-of-vulnerability tests.
  • Build Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, and Swift.
  • Write realistic task instructions that describe the security issue without revealing the vulnerable code, exploit details, or expected fix.
  • Create reproducible Docker-based environments with pinned dependencies and clear setup procedures.
  • Harden verifiers against gaming, overfitting, test manipulation, and hardcoded solutions.
  • Screen out tasks that can be solved by copying a well-known upstream patch without understanding the vulnerability.
  • Review and score AI-generated patches and reasoning using clearly defined technical rubrics.
  • Document vulnerability context, reproduction steps, expected behavior, patch requirements, test methodology, and review decisions.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.
  • Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10.
  • Ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and write proof-of-vulnerability tests.
  • Hands-on experience with security tooling, including sanitizers, fuzzers, and static-analysis tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep.
  • Strong proficiency with Git, Linux, Bash, and Docker.
  • Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, research-oriented environment.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.

title: Data Visualization Analyst, Functional Analytics Stream
description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade Power BI reports and dashboards that translate complex data from the GCP data platform into clear, actionable business insights for the O9 solution landscape. Additionally, contribute to the evaluation and adoption of Databricks AI BI Dashboards as the team prepares for the mid-2027 platform migration.

How you will contribute

You will:
  • You will ensure that the reporting and analytics layer is optimised to meet business demands - delivering accurate, timely, and visually compelling insights that drive better decision-making across the O9 solution landscape.
  • You will serve as a consultant on reporting issues and resolutions, recommending actions to improve report performance, data accuracy, and user experience.
  • As the team prepares for the Databricks migration, you will play an active role in shaping the future-state reporting strategy by evaluating AI BI Dashboards and contributing to migration planning.
  • This role will also require you to collaborate with data engineering and business teams, support vendor governance activities, ensure adherence to reporting standards and governance processes, and contribute to continuous improvement of the DA reporting catalogue.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
  • Using data analysis to make recommendations to analytic leaders
  • Understanding in best-in-class analytics practices
  • Knowledge of Indicators (KPIs) and scorecards
  • Knowledge of BI tools like Tableau, Excel, Alteryx, R, Python, etc. is a plus
More about this role

What you need to know about this position:

Power BI Report Development Maintenance
  • Design, build, and publish production-quality Power BI reports and dashboards aligned to business KPIs and stakeholder requirements.
  • Modify, enhance, and optimise existing reports - improving visuals, DAX calculations, data models, query performance, and user experience based on evolving business needs.
  • Implement best practices for Power BI development: star-schema modelling, measure tables, row-level security (RLS), bookmarks, drill-throughs, and consistent design standards.
  • Manage report lifecycle - version control, development/test/production promotion, and scheduled refresh configuration.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve report-level incidents (broken refreshes, incorrect aggregations, visual errors) as part of L2/L3 support.

Backend Data Understanding (GCP / BigQuery)
  • Develop a thorough understanding of the GCP backend - BigQuery datasets, tables, views, and stored procedures - that feed Power BI reports.
  • Write and optimise SQL queries in BigQuery to validate data, investigate discrepancies, and support ad-hoc analysis requests.
  • Collaborate with the GCP Data Engineering pod to understand pipeline logic, data lineage, transformation rules, and refresh schedules so that reports accurately reflect the source-of-truth.
  • Identify and flag data quality issues at the reporting layer; work with the DQ function (Ataccama) and data engineers to trace root causes and implement fixes.
  • Document data mappings between GCP source objects and Power BI datasets to maintain a clear lineage from source to report.

Databricks AI BI Dashboards
  • Participate in the evaluation and POC development of Databricks AI BI Dashboards (formerly Lakeview Dashboards) as part of the planned Databricks migration.
  • Build prototype AI BI dashboards connected to Databricks SQL warehouses, exploring natural-language query capabilities and AI-assisted visualisation features.
  • Assess migration pathways for existing Power BI content to Databricks AI BI - identifying which reports are candidates for migration vs. those that remain on Power BI.
  • Stay current on Databricks AI BI product developments, Genie spaces, and dashboard best practices; share learnings with the wider team.

Data Governance Quality at the Reporting Layer
  • Enforce data governance standards in the reporting layer - consistent naming conventions, certified datasets, usage tracking, and access controls.
  • Support FMT governance activities for reporting objects, ensuring SLAs and defined rules are met for governed data objects.
  • Implement and maintain data validation checks within Power BI (e.g. comparison measures, anomaly flags) to catch discrepancies before they reach business users.

Stakeholder Engagement Continuous Improvement
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders and product owners to gather requirements, translate them into report specifications, and iterate on designs through review cycles.
  • Conduct report walkthroughs and training sessions to improve user adoption and self-service capability.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate or retire redundant reports, reducing maintenance overhead and improving the overall reporting catalogue.
  • Contribute to the teams knowledge base - documenting report logic, common troubleshooting steps, and design patterns for reuse.

What extra ingredients you will bring:
  • Building and maintaining enterprise Power BI solutions at scale
  • Understanding backend data structures (tables, views, transformations) and tracing data from source to report
  • Working collaboratively with data engineering teams and business stakeholders
  • Evaluating and adopting new BI technologies (Databricks AI BI, modern dashboard tools)
  • Stakeholder management and the ability to present data insights clearly
  • Managing reporting services delivery, support, and operational excellence
  • Working in a global IT function with regional or global responsibilities in an environment like Mondel z International
  • Working effectively with IT outsource partners

Education / Certifications:
Bancheros Degree or PG

Job specific requirements:
  • 5-7 years of hands-on Power BI development experience, including report design, DAX, Power Query (M), and data modelling.
  • Strong SQL skills - ability to write, read, and optimise complex queries in BigQuery or equivalent cloud data warehouses.
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts - star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and ETL/ELT patterns.
  • GCP familiarity - working knowledge of BigQuery (tables, views, scheduled queries), Cloud Storage, and basic IAM/access concepts.
  • Power BI Service administration - experience with workspaces, dataset management, scheduled refresh, row-level security (RLS), and deployment pipelines.
  • Data visualisation best practices - ability to design intuitive, accessible, and performant dashboards that tell a clear story.
  • Troubleshooting support mindset - comfortable performing root-cause analysis on data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues.
  • Strong communication skills - ability to translate technical data concepts for business audiences and collaborate effectively across global teams.

Preferred Skills:
  • Databricks experience - exposure to Databricks SQL, AI BI Dashboards (Lakeview), Genie, or Unity Catalog.
  • Python or PySpark basics for data exploration or automation tasks.
  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Talend, Aecorsoft, or Apache Airflow (understanding pipeline schedules and dependencies).
  • Familiarity with data quality tools - Ataccama, Great Expectations, or similar.
  • Power BI embedded analytics or paginated reports experience.
  • Exposure to Terraform or CI/CD for report deployment automation.
  • Experience working in a global IT function with regional or global responsibilities in an environment like Mondel z International.

title: AI/ML Research Engineer
description:
Job Description
We are seeking an AI/ML Research Engineer (NLP Knowledge Graphs) to join our Applied AI Solutions team. This is a junior-to-mid level role: the ideal candidate has around 2-4 years of hands-on experience applying NLP and machine learning (or an MSc with strong research or internship experience), and wants to grow into a research-minded engineer who can take an idea from paper to working prototype.
You will research, prototype and evaluate ways of extracting structure and meaning from scholarly content - entities, relations, topics and emerging research areas - and of representing it in knowledge graphs and ontologies that can power better discovery, search and recommendation across Taylor Francis. You will report to the Director of Applied AI Solutions, who in turn reports to the CTO.
The Applied AI Solutions team is a small, senior, research-led group within the CTO organisation. We are the part of Taylor Francis that works on problems that are on nobody s product roadmap yet - discovery, peer review, research integrity and making scholarly content machine-consumable - and we turn the most promising ideas into evidence, working prototypes and business cases that Engineering and the business can adopt.
What you ll be doing:
  • Work as part of a small, research-led team on a few strategic AI bets each year, each ending in a decision-grade artefact: a working prototype, the evidence behind it and a business case.
  • Research, prototype and evaluate NLP approaches for extracting entities, relations and topics from scholarly articles, books and metadata.
  • Help design, populate and evolve knowledge graphs, ontologies and taxonomies that represent Taylor Francis content and the research landscape around it.
  • Build and benchmark semantic and hybrid retrieval approaches, including embedding models and graph-enhanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Contribute to the team s technology radar by scouting, trialling and writing up new open-source libraries, models and tools for knowledge extraction and search.
  • Build test sets, metrics and evaluation harnesses so that every claim we make about a model or tool is backed by evidence.
  • Support the hand-over of graduating prototypes to Engineering teams, with clear documentation and a written definition of what done means.
  • Present results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, and contribute to papers, articles and conference submissions.
What we re looking for:
Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop NLP pipelines for tasks such as named-entity recognition, relation extraction, entity linking and disambiguation, topic modelling and classification over scholarly text, using transformer models and LLMs.
  • Build, populate and query knowledge graphs in a graph database or triple store (e.g., Neo4j, RDF/SPARQL stores) and evaluate their quality and coverage.
  • Support the design and expansion of ontologies, taxonomies and controlled vocabularies, working with Editorial and subject-matter experts.
  • Detect and track emerging topics and research areas using clustering, topic modelling and embedding-based techniques.
  • Evaluate embedding models, chunking strategies, rerankers and retrieval configurations for semantic search and RAG on scholarly content.
  • Create gold-standard datasets and annotation guidelines, and define metrics (e.g., precision/recall/F1, nDCG) for reproducible evaluation.
  • Design and run well-controlled experiments, tracking them with tools such as MLflow or Weights Biases so results can be reproduced.
  • Prototype rapidly using LLM APIs and open-source models for knowledge extraction and enrichment.
  • Write clean, tested and documented Python code that other engineers can pick up and extend.
  • Prepare hand-over documentation and support Engineering teams during the build phase of prototypes that graduate to production.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Editorial and other business teams to turn open-ended problems into well-posed research questions.
  • Assist with vendor, model and tool comparisons, including preparing benchmark results for internal and external audiences.
  • Keep up with the research literature and relevant venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, SIGIR, ISWC/ESWC) and share what is relevant with the team.
Qualifications
Qualifications :
Good to have certifications
  • Neo4j Certified Professional (or equivalent graph database certification)
  • DeepLearning.AI or Hugging Face NLP / LLM specialisation certificates
  • Cloud ML or AI certification (e.g., AWS Machine Learning, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer)
Technical Skills:
  • 2-4 years of experience applying NLP and machine learning in industry or research (or an MSc with relevant research or internship experience).
  • Strong Python, including scientific libraries (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and writing readable, tested code.
  • Hands-on experience with NLP libraries and frameworks such as spaCy, Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch.
  • Practical knowledge of knowledge graphs and semantic technologies: property graphs and/or RDF, OWL and SKOS, with query experience in Cypher and/or SPARQL.
  • Understanding of information retrieval and semantic search: embeddings, vector search (e.g., FAISS, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, pgvector), hybrid retrieval and RAG.
  • Experience designing evaluation: test sets, annotation, metrics, error analysis and statistical sanity-checking of results.
  • Working familiarity with LLM APIs and structured-output prompting for information extraction.
  • Experience with Git, Linux, SQL and reproducible experiment environments (notebooks, virtual environments, containers).
  • Ability to read research papers and reproduce their results from the paper or open-source repository.
  • Experience with a cloud platform (AWS preferred) is a plus.
Soft Skills:
  • Curious, rigorous and sceptical: comfortable saying the evidence does not support this and showing why.
  • Clear written and spoken communication, including explaining technical results to non-technical colleagues.
  • Comfortable working under the technical direction of senior engineers while taking ownership of well-defined pieces of work.
  • Able to manage several experiments at once and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.
  • A keen eye for detail and a commitment to reproducible, high-quality work.
Preferred:
  • Experience with scholarly or scientific text and metadata (e.g., Crossref, OpenAlex, ORCID, ROR, PubMed).
  • Exposure to ontology and taxonomy tooling (e.g., Prot g , PoolParty, SKOS editors).

title: Data & Analytics Engineer
description:
Job Summary

As a Data Analytics Engineer at Brainstack Technologies, you will design and build the data pipelines, ETL processes, and data models behind reliable reporting and analytics. You will write and optimise SQL, build Power BI dashboards that give stakeholders clear, accurate visibility into business performance, and apply version control and CI/CD to data pipeline and analytics code. The role suits an analytical, curious, detail-oriented engineer who enjoys turning reporting needs into reliable data solutions. This is a work-from-home position. Overlap with working hours in the Sydney time zone is mandatory.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build data pipelines and ETL processes to move and transform data reliably across company systems.
  • Develop and maintain data models that support reliable, well-structured reporting and analytics.
  • Write and optimise SQL across data pipelines, reporting layers, and ad hoc analysis.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that give stakeholders clear, accurate visibility into business performance.
  • Apply data structures and algorithms thinking to design efficient, scalable data processes.
  • Apply version control and CI/CD practices to data pipeline and analytics code, ensuring changes are tested and deployed safely.
  • Apply AI tools and literacy to accelerate data engineering, analysis, and reporting work.
  • Contribute to data warehouse design, database administration, or solution architecture where relevant.
  • Work closely with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting needs and translate them into reliable data solutions.

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience.
  • Strong SQL skills, comfortable writing and optimising complex queries across large datasets.
  • Solid experience with data modelling, structuring data for reliable and maintainable reporting.
  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines and ETL processes.
  • Experience building data visualisations and dashboards, ideally in Power BI.
  • Good grounding in data structures and algorithms.
  • Practical experience with version control (e.g. Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Working AI literacy - comfortable using AI-assisted tools to support data engineering and analysis.
  • Analytical and curious, detail-oriented, a strong problem solver who communicates well and can work independently.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Azure.
  • Exposure to data warehousing.
  • Exposure to database administration.
  • Exposure to solution architecture.

title: Manager, IT Security
description:
Job Purpose\:

The Manager IT Security leads and strengthens Britam Group’s IT and Information Security function across Technology Security, Data & Information Security, and Cybersecurity in all businesses and operating markets.

Reporting directly to the Chief Digital & Technology Officer (CDTO), the role provides strategic leadership and oversight to protect the Group’s technology infrastructure, cloud environments, data and information assets, applications, digital channels and services. It reduces material security risk, strengthens operational resilience, and ensures regulatory obligations are met.

The role develops and drives execution of the Group IT and Information Security strategy, governance framework, operating model, policies, standards and multi-year roadmap. It leads specialist security operations, sets Group-wide security requirements, and provides independent oversight and assurance of controls. Working with business, data and Technology leaders, the role ensures risks are identified, assessed and addressed, while implementation and operation of controls remain the accountability of the respective asset and service owners. The role also develops and maintains the Group’s security standards for AI, covering staff use of AI tools, protection of sensitive data from external AI services and security assurance of AI solutions, within the Group’s AI governance arrangements. The role operates in alignment with, and in support of, the Group’s enterprise risk governance framework owned by Group Risk & Compliance.

Success is measured by measurable improvements in security maturity and posture, reduced exposure to material technology, data and cyber risks, effective threat detection and incident response, regulatory compliance, and the secure enablement of business growth and digital transformation.

Key responsibilities

A. Strategy, Governance & Leadership

  • Develop and recommend the integrated Group IT Security strategy and multi-year roadmap covering technology, data and cybersecurity, aligned to Britam’s enterprise priorities and approved risk appetite.

  • Establish and maintain Group-wide security governance, policies, standards, control requirements, decision rights and escalation arrangements within delegated authority.

  • Lead delivery of the approved security programme and maintain a clear view of material risks, control effectiveness, regulatory obligations and emerging threats across operating markets.

  • Provide concise, business-oriented security reporting to the CDTO and relevant executive governance forums; support Board and committee reporting through established management and Risk channels.

  • Manage the approved security budget, investments, resources and managed service providers, ensuring cost-effective controls and demonstrable programme outcomes.

B. Technology, Cloud & Identity Security

  • Set security architecture and control requirements for infrastructure, networks, endpoints, databases, business systems, cloud services and hybrid technology platforms.

  • Oversee the design and effectiveness of technical security controls, including identity and privileged access, authentication, endpoint protection, network and cloud security.

  • Establish Group requirements for secure configuration, hardening and access review; monitor material control gaps and the remediation undertaken by accountable Technology owners.

  • Ensure security requirements are addressed in significant architecture decisions, infrastructure changes, platform upgrades and operational resilience initiatives.

  • Set the security requirements for, and oversee adoption of, secure-by-design and risk-based Zero Trust principles across the technology estate.

C. Data Security & Information Protection

  • Own the Group’s data security requirements, standards and assurance approach for information protection throughout its lifecycle.

  • Establish control requirements for information classification, access, encryption, secure transfer, storage, retention and disposal in partnership with Data & AI and business data owners.

  • Lead and oversee security capabilities for data loss prevention, sensitive data access monitoring and protection of information across systems, data platforms, analytics, cloud and third parties.

  • Ensure security assurance is applied to material data pipelines, integrations, APIs, analytics environments and AI solutions, and that significant exposures are addressed by responsible owners.

  • Develop, maintain and recommend for approval the Group’s AI security standards and access controls, including approved use of AI tools by staff, protection of sensitive data from exposure to external AI services, and security assurance of AI models and integrations; AI use-case approval and risk governance remain with the Group’s AI governance forum and Group Risk & Compliance.

  • Work with the Data Protection Officer on technical and organisational safeguards supporting personal data protection, while preserving the DPO’s privacy and regulatory accountability.

D. Cybersecurity Operations & Incident Response

  • Lead Group cybersecurity monitoring, threat detection, investigation and incident response capabilities, including any internally operated or outsourced Security Operations Centre

  • Maintain effective threat intelligence, security-event visibility and response arrangements for critical technology services and digital channels.

  • Own the security incident-response framework, including severity classification, escalation, coordination, investigation, containment and relevant notification triggers.

  • Coordinate material incident response with accountable Technology and business owners, Group Risk, Legal, Data Protection and crisis-management teams; operational service recovery remains with the service owners.

  • Ensure material incidents result in documented root-cause analysis, lessons learnt, accountable remedial actions and regular preparedness simulations.

E. Application Security, DevSecOps & Vulnerability Management

  • Set and oversee security requirements for applications, digital channels, APIs, integrations and emerging technology solutions, including AI-enabled services.

  • Work with Digital & Engineering to embed risk-based security reviews, testing and DevSecOps controls into software and technology delivery without transferring software engineering ownership.

  • Govern enterprise vulnerability management, penetration testing and independent technical security assessments across applications, platforms, infrastructure and cloud services.

  • Ensure critical and high-risk findings are prioritised by business impact, assigned to accountable owners and monitored against agreed remediation timelines.

  • Provide proportionate security assurance of material technology change before production release and escalate unresolved significant security exposures.

F. Security Risk, Compliance & Assurance

  • Oversee identification, evaluation and monitoring of material technology, data and cybersecurity risks in alignment with Group enterprise risk management.

  • Maintain security control and assurance frameworks aligned with applicable regulatory requirements and recognised practices including ISO/IEC 27001 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

  • Provide risk treatment recommendations, challenge ineffective controls and escalate material exceptions; formal residual-risk acceptance remains with authorised business or Technology risk owners.

  • Coordinate security contributions to regulator reviews, internal and external audits and independent assessments; track agreed actions, overdue findings and repeat weaknesses to closure or formal acceptance.

  • Monitor changes in security-related obligations across Britam’s jurisdictions and ensure the security function responds appropriately.

G. Third-Party Security & Operational Resilience

  • Establish and maintain proportionate security due diligence and continuing assurance for material technology suppliers, cloud providers, data processors and managed security services.

  • Monitor material supplier security exposure, service-provider performance and remediation of significant weaknesses with Procurement, Risk and accountable contract or service owners.

  • Ensure security requirements are embedded in technology resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements for critical services.

  • Provide risk-based security assurance for major transformation programmes, strategic partnerships, acquisitions and significant technology changes

H. People, Culture & Capability Development

  • Build and lead a high-performing IT Security team with appropriate specialisms, clear responsibilities, succession and development plans.

  • Lead security awareness and behaviour change programmes, using evidence of safer practices and reduced human-related exposure, not training completion alone.

  • Build shared security ownership across Technology, Data, Risk and business teams through clear advice, practical challenge and collaborative problem-solving.

  • Continually improve security capability, governance and service effectiveness while positioning security as an enabler of trusted digital growth.

  • Delegated Authority\: As per the approved Delegated Authority Matrix.

title: Azure AD B2C Lead
description:
Role: AZURE AD B2C LEAD
Location: Hyderabad, India

This is a technical leadership role focused on Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID, customer identity architecture, hands-on delivery, platform modernization, and cross-functional technical direction. The Lead is expected to establish standards and target-state architecture while remaining sufficiently hands-on to implement, troubleshoot, and drive critical identity initiatives.

What We Need This Lead To Own

  • Lead the end-to-end architecture, implementation, modernization, and operational maturity of Boses customer identity platform using Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID.
  • Serve as the primary technical lead and subject matter expert for Azure customer identity, with strong working knowledge of the broader Azure environment, services, architecture patterns, dependencies, and platform capabilities.
  • Design secure, scalable, and seamless authentication and authorization experiences across Bose customer-facing digital platforms, including web, mobile, e-commerce, support, and connected-product ecosystems.
  • Provide technical leadership across identity architecture and broader Azure platform decisions, connecting customer identity requirements to cloud, application, API, security, and platform engineering needs.
  • Define target-state identity architecture, reusable enterprise patterns, engineering standards, and implementation guidance.
  • Remain hands-on with custom policies, integrations, automation, troubleshooting, architecture validation, and critical delivery work.
  • Lead technical decisions, architecture reviews, design discussions, and resolution of complex identity and Azure platform issues.
  • Apply FinOps principles and practical cloud-security judgment to architecture and implementation decisions.

Core Technical Responsibilities

1. Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID Leadership & Architecture

  • Architect and implement Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID tenant configurations for customer-facing applications.
  • Own user journeys, custom policies, built-in user flows, identity providers, claims providers, and orchestration steps.
  • Build secure authentication experiences for sign-up, sign-in, account linking, password reset, profile updates, and account recovery.
  • Configure and optimize social identity provider integrations and other required external identity providers.
  • Design scalable identity patterns supporting multiple applications, brands, regions, and customer segments.
  • Establish tenant strategy, environment separation, configuration management, release governance, and reusable implementation standards across development, test, staging, and production.
  • Lead technical reviews and provide direction to engineers implementing customer identity capabilities.

2. Azure Architecture & Cloud Platform

  • Provide architectural leadership beyond B2C, demonstrating strong understanding of Azure services, resources, networking, compute, storage, integration, monitoring, security, and platform dependencies.
  • Evaluate architecture choices across the Azure environment and ensure identity services integrate effectively with broader cloud platforms and enterprise applications.
  • Guide scalability, availability, resiliency, performance, operational readiness, and platform modernization decisions.
  • Translate business and application requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable Azure architecture patterns.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineering, platform, application, security, and infrastructure teams on cross-platform architecture decisions.

3. Authentication, Authorization, IAM & Customer Identity Experience

  • Lead modern authentication patterns including MFA, adaptive authentication, passwordless authentication, biometric authentication support, and risk-based access controls where applicable.
  • Define secure session management, token lifecycle, refresh-token handling, logout behavior, and single sign-on patterns.
  • Implement and govern OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, federation, SSO, MFA, and API authorization standards.
  • Apply IAM principles to customer and application identity use cases, including authentication, authorization, federation, identity lifecycle, and access controls.
  • Architect role-based and attribute-based authorization models for customer, partner, support, and administrative access scenarios.
  • Lead customer account linking, identity federation, duplicate-account handling, and account migration strategies.

4. Application, API & Digital Platform Integration

  • Lead integration of Azure AD B2C / Entra External ID with web applications, mobile applications, APIs, microservices, e-commerce platforms, CRM platforms, and customer-support systems.
  • Design secure API access patterns using scopes, app registrations, API permissions, token validation, and delegated/application authorization models.
  • Guide application engineering teams on identity SDKs, authentication middleware, authorization controls, and secure token handling.
  • Support integrations with customer profile platforms, marketing platforms, loyalty systems, commerce systems, and connected-device ecosystems.
  • Define API gateway and backend-service authentication patterns for customer-facing and machine-to-machine interactions.
  • Ensure identity architecture supports scalable digital experiences across global markets and high-volume customer traffic.

5. Custom Policy Engineering & Identity Automation

  • Develop and maintain Azure AD B2C custom policies using Identity Experience Framework (IEF).
  • Build reusable policy components, claims transformations, technical profiles, REST API integrations, and orchestration patterns.
  • Integrate custom policies with external REST APIs for customer validation, entitlement checks, fraud controls, profile enrichment, consent validation, and account lifecycle workflows.
  • Automate tenant configuration, policy deployment, application registrations, secret rotation, and environment promotion using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Build version-controlled deployment patterns for B2C policies, configuration artifacts, and application integration settings.
  • Establish automated testing, validation, rollback, and release controls for identity configuration changes.

6. FinOps & Cloud Cost Management

  • Apply FinOps principles to cloud architecture, resource utilization, cost visibility, optimization, governance, and accountability.
  • Evaluate architecture and resource decisions for cost efficiency without compromising security, performance, scalability, or reliability.
  • Partner with cloud/platform teams to identify optimization opportunities, establish cost controls, and improve ongoing cloud financial governance.

7. Security, Privacy & Compliance

  • Apply strong practical cloud-security knowledge to Azure and identity architecture; deep cybersecurity specialization is not required.
  • Design identity controls aligned with enterprise security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Implement secure handling of customer PII, consent records, preferences, authentication data, and profile attributes.
  • Apply least-privilege access, privileged-access controls, certificate management, secret management, and secure credential lifecycle practices.
  • Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, legal, and compliance teams to ensure customer identity architecture supports applicable regulatory obligations.
  • Define audit logging, monitoring, anomaly detection, and investigation capabilities for authentication events and identity-related security incidents.
  • Ensure identity design aligns with Zero Trust principles, secure-by-design practices, and Bose enterprise security standards.

8. Monitoring, Observability & Operational Readiness

  • Implement monitoring and observability for authentication success/failure rates, policy errors, token issues, suspicious login activity, and external identity provider failures.
  • Integrate identity telemetry with enterprise monitoring and logging platforms such as New Relic, LogicMonitor, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and SIEM platforms.
  • Define operational dashboards, alert thresholds, service health monitoring, and incident-response procedures for customer identity services.
  • Build automated diagnostics and remediation workflows for recurring authentication, policy, and integration failures.
  • Drive reduction of customer-impacting identity incidents through proactive monitoring, root-cause analysis, and resilient architecture patterns.
  • Establish runbooks, support procedures, escalation paths, and operational documentation for identity platform support teams.

9. Technical Leadership, Governance & Stakeholder Management

description:

The Automation Risk & Controls Senior Advisor position will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for advancing a balanced operational risk, IT risk, and automation governance program across Provider Experience and Operations (PX&O), with particular emphasis on claims and provider operations.

This individual will partner with business, technology, and development teams to embed practical and sustainable risk and control requirements across business processes, applications, automations, and emerging technologies. The individual will establish control requirements, challenge proposed solutions, monitor and escalate risks, support remediation, and enable SOX and SOC audit readiness without serving as the independent audit function or as an automation developer.

Candidates who reside within 50 miles of the following locations will be required to perform onsite 3 days per week: Bloomfield, CT; Chattanooga, TN; Denver, CO; St. Louis, MO; and Scottsdale, AZ.

title: Postdoctoral Position in Atomic-Scale Light-Matter Interaction and Spin-Photon Interfaces in Nanographenes
description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

Postdoctoral Position in Atomic-Scale Light-Matter Interaction and Spin-Photon Interfaces in Nanographenes

The nanotech@surfaces Laboratory is a dynamic team of quantum nanoscientists exploring the frontier of low-dimensional material systems using cutting-edge scanning probe microscopy.

Your tasks

Within the Werner Siemens Foundation project CarboQuant, you will be in charge of an interdisciplinary research effort exploring atomic-scale light-matter interaction in hybrid chromophore-nanographene systems. Your goal is to understand and engineer spin-photon coupling, single-molecule photophysics and excited-state dynamics. To achieve this, you will combine light-coupled scanning tunneling microscopy techniques: STM-induced luminescence (STML), tip-enhanced photoluminescence (TEPL), and ultrafast lightwave-driven tunneling (THz-STM). You will collaborate closely with partners in the CarboQuant consortium and support the supervision of PhD and master students.

Your profile

We seek a highly motivated experimentalist with a PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field, who is eager to take a leading role in an interdisciplinary research project. Candidates should have a strong background in surface science, optics, or molecular photophysics. Prior experience with low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy is a strong asset; experience with ultra-high vacuum, optical spectroscopy, or ultrafast optics is advantageous. Programming skills in Python are expected. We value scientific curiosity, independence, and initiative, combined with a collaborative spirit and enthusiasm for exploring new scientific frontiers in an international research environment. Excellent communication skills in English are required.

Our offer

We offer the opportunity to take on a leading role in a young research team and to become part of a stimulating and collegial work environment. You will conduct pioneering studies on single-molecule quantum systems using a unique combination of light-coupled scanning tunneling microscopy techniques. You will collaborate with top researchers globally, shaping a competitive research portfolio in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment. Located in the Zurich area, the Swiss Federal Laboratories for Materials Science and Technology (Empa) offer outstanding infrastructure, a broad interdisciplinary environment and competitive salaries.
The position is available starting early 2027 or upon agreement, with a planned duration of at least two years.

We foster a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities. Our commitment is documented in our Diversity Action Plan and refers to specific goals, which are implemented and further developed on a regular basis.

You don't meet every single requirement? We are aware that particularly women and individuals from minority backgrounds often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we also value motivation, commitment and a willingness to learn. If you see yourself in this role, we would love to receive your qualified application, even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

title: SOC
description:
As the SOC lead, you will lead the day-to-day operations of Tata Technologies' Security Operations Center, ensuring continuous monitoring, rapid detection, investigation, and response to cyber threats across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments.


You will work closely with Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Endpoint, Identity, and Application Security teams to enhance the organization's cyber resilience while leveraging modern security technologies such as Palo Alto Cortex XSIAM and Cortex XDR.


This role requires a blend of strong technical expertise, operational leadership, and stakeholder management to continuously improve the organization's security posture.


Key Responsibilities

1. Security Operations

(i) Lead and manage the Enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC) supporting global operations.

(ii) Oversee L1, L2, and L3 SOC analysts, ensuring effective 24x7 monitoring, investigation, and response to security incidents.

(iii) Drive operational excellence by establishing SOC metrics, SLAs, dashboards, and continuous service improvements.

(iv) Develop and maintain SOC standard operating procedures (SOPs), incident response playbooks, and operational runbooks.

2. Threat Detection & Security Monitoring

(i) Manage and optimize Palo Alto Cortex XSIAM and Cortex XDR platforms for enterprise-wide threat detection and response.

(ii) Develop, tune, and maintain detection rules, correlation logic, analytics, and automation workflows to improve detection accuracy and reduce false positives.

(iii) Conduct proactive threat hunting using behavioral analytics, threat intelligence, and the MITRE ATT&CK Framework.

(iv) Monitor security telemetry from endpoints, servers, network devices, cloud platforms, identity services, and business applications.

3. Incident Response & Cyber Defense

(i) Lead the investigation and response to complex cybersecurity incidents, including malware, ransomware, phishing, insider threats, account compromise, and data exfiltration.

(ii) Coordinate containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review activities with internal teams and external stakeholders.

(iii) Perform root cause analysis (RCA), identify indicators of compromise (IOCs), and recommend corrective and preventive actions.

(iv) Support digital forensic investigations and evidence preservation where required.

4. Cloud Security Operations

(i) Monitor and respond to security events across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments.

(ii) Ensure visibility into cloud-native security services such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Activity Logs, AWS CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and related telemetry.

(iii) Identify cloud misconfigurations, suspicious activities, identity-based attacks, and privilege escalation attempts.

(iv) Collaborate with cloud engineering teams to strengthen cloud security posture.

5. Vulnerability & Exposure Management

(i) Lead the enterprise Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) program.

(ii) Coordinate internal and external penetration testing activities and ensure timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities.

(iii) Prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability, business criticality, and threat intelligence.

(iv) Monitor remediation progress and provide risk-based reporting to leadership.

6. Security Engineering & Automation

(i) Support the integration of enterprise security technologies into the SOC ecosystem.

(ii) Develop automation workflows and playbooks to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.

(iii) Ensure high-quality log onboarding, normalization, enrichment, and visibility across enterprise systems.

7. Governance & Stakeholder Management

(i) Prepare executive dashboards, incident reports, and SOC performance metrics for senior leadership.

(ii) Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Identity, Application Security, and Business teams to improve cyber defense capabilities.

(iii) Support regulatory audits, customer assessments, and compliance initiatives related to security operations.


Required Qualifications

(i) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline.

(ii) 12to15 years of experience in Information Security, with at least 7 years in Security Operations or Cyber Defense.

(iii) Proven experience managing enterprise-scale Security Operations Centers (SOC) supporting global organizations.

(iv) Experience leading security incident investigations and cyber response activities.

description:
Role overview

The Azure Migration Support Engineer is the client-facing support role during each wave of a Dallas data center migration to Microsoft Azure. The role covers the cutover bridge, post-migration hypercare, end-user communications, and migration status tracking in Power BI. It works the night shift in India so that it overlaps US business hours.

1. Cutover bridge support

  • Join the bridge for each scheduled cutover window, including US evenings and weekends.
  • Follow the wave runbook: run pre-checks, track step completion, and record timings and issues.
  • Run post-cutover smoke tests: server reachability, logins, DNS resolution, file shares, and key application access.

  • Keep known-issue and how-to notes current for end users and the client's helpdesk.

4. Migration tracking and reporting (Power BI)

  • Update the client's Power BI assessment dashboard with each server's status: Not Started, Planned, Migration in Progress, Migrated, Decommissioned.
  • Keep an alternative tracker if the dashboard is unavailable or inaccurate.
  • Provide wave metrics and hypercare data for weekly status reports.

5. Decommissioning support

title: TC-CS-AD-Cyber LDE Profesional
description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY GDS CYBER LARGE DEAL GROUP
Cyber Solutions Architect
Pre-Sales | Client Storytelling | Commercial & Pricing | Turnkey Cyber Services
Executive mandate to Shape and lead differentiated, executable and commercially compelling turnkey cyber services propositions for strategic pursuits, converting complex client priorities into a persuasive value story, integrated architecture, delivery model and price-to-win.
The opportunity
The Cyber Large Deal Engine brings together Business Case Researchers, Cyber Domain Specialists, Solution Architects, and Finance & Commercial Specialists to create an integrated deal-shaping capability, connecting client and market insight, deep cyber expertise, end-to-end solution architecture, and commercial modelling to build propositions that are differentiated, deliverable and positioned to win.
It is a senior pursuit leadership position for an architect who can operate credibly across the boardroom, the solution room and the commercial model. The role requires breadth across cyber domains, depth in at least one major cyber capability, and the judgement to integrate specialist inputs into one coherent, differentiated and deliverable proposition.
Role accountabilities
Lead strategic solutioning and pursuits
  • Own the solution from qualification and discovery through business case build out , architecture, proposal development, governance, oral presentation, negotiation and BAFO.
  • Establish the solution strategy, win themes, design principles and response plan for complex RFPs, RFIs and proactive pursuits.
  • Translate client requirements into an integrated managed services model spanning people, process, technology, governance, service management and transformation.
  • Define scope, architecture, operating model, transition approach, delivery footprint, staffing model, service levels, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
  • Mobilise and lead multidisciplinary contributors across domains and geographies, ensuring one solution, one story and one commercial position.
Create a compelling customer story
  • Frame the clients business context, cyber risk and operational challenge before presenting the solution.
  • Convert technical complexity into an outcome-led narrative that is relevant to CISOs, CIOs, business executives and procurement leaders.
  • Connect solution choices to measurable outcomes such as risk reduction, resilience, control effectiveness, experience, operational efficiency and cost transparency.
  • Lead executive discovery sessions, workshops, whiteboarding, solution walkthroughs, oral pitches and solution-defence discussions.
  • Anticipate objections and competitive alternatives, articulating clearly why the proposition is credible, differentiated, scalable and valuable.
Own commercial solutioning and pricing
  • Translate the solution into a robust bottom-up cost model covering resource pyramids, effort, delivery locations, platforms, licences, transition and ongoing run costs.
  • Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive, sustainable and traceable pricing, with clear linkage between scope, service levels, cost and price.
  • Evaluate fixed-price, consumption-based, unit-based, outcome-aligned and hybrid charging models based on client context and risk allocation.
  • Optimise the solution through automation, standardisation, global delivery leverage, right-shoring, reusable assets and platform choices without compromising outcomes.
  • Understand margin drivers, contingencies, contractual dependencies and change levers; support commercial governance, negotiation, BAFO and renewal decisions.
Architect integrated turnkey cyber services
  • Provide broad solution leadership across Identity and Access Management, Privileged Access Management, Customer IAM, Non-Human Identity, Threat Detection and Response, SOC, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting.
  • Bring familiarity with major platforms including SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Splunk and CrowdStrike.
  • Design for cloud, on-premise and hybrid environments, integrating EY capabilities, alliance partners, technology vendors and client-retained responsibilities.
  • Know when to make an architectural decision and when to engage a deep specialist, while retaining accountability for the integrity of the end-to-end solution.
  • Position AI-enabled security operations, automation and platform-led delivery where they create a credible and measurable client advantage.
Build repeatable deal-engine capability
  • Create and improve reference architectures, solution patterns, estimators, pricing models, proposal content, assumptions libraries and executive storytelling assets.
  • Capture pursuit insights, commercial benchmarks and lessons learned to improve future speed, consistency and win quality.
  • Coach solution contributors on structured solutioning, client storytelling, estimation discipline and executive presentation.
Decision scope and influence
  • Recommends the end-to-end solution strategy, architecture, delivery model and commercial assumptions for assigned pursuits.
  • Challenges requirements and design choices that reduce value, increase delivery risk or weaken competitiveness.
  • Balances client outcomes, architectural integrity, delivery feasibility, commercial sustainability and speed to market.
  • Influences partners, pursuit leaders, SMEs, alliances, delivery executives and commercial stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Escalates material solution, delivery, contractual and financial risks with clear options and recommendations.
Measures of success
  • Pursuit impact: Quality and competitiveness of strategic proposals; contribution to progression and wins.
  • Client impact: Clarity of the story, executive confidence and alignment to measurable outcomes.
  • Commercial quality: Accurate, traceable estimates and sustainable pricing with risks made explicit.
  • Solution integrity: Integrated, scalable and deliverable solutions with clear ownership and dependencies.
  • Execution discipline: Timely mobilisation, governance and high-quality outputs under pursuit deadlines.
  • Capability uplift: Reusable assets, improved consistency and stronger solutioning maturity across the engine.
Experience and capabilities
  • Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in cyber consulting, solution architecture, pre-sales or managed services, with demonstrated leadership of large and complex pursuits.
  • Proven ability to move fluently between executive business conversations, cyber architecture, operating model design and commercial/pricing discussions.
  • Depth in at least one major cyber domain, combined with sufficient breadth to shape integrated solutions across multiple capabilities.
  • Practical experience building bottom-up estimates, cost models and pricing inputs for managed services opportunities.
  • Exceptional customer presence, storytelling, writing, facilitation and presentation skills, including leadership of oral pitches and solution defence.
  • Strong analytical judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs under ambiguity, commercial pressure and demanding deadlines.
  • Experience working across distributed global teams and with alliance partners, technology vendors, finance, legal, risk and contracting stakeholders.
  • Bachelors degree such as BTech/BE or equivalent; MCA or another relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
Preferred credentials and exposure
  • Relevant certifications in security architecture, IAM, cloud security, SIEM/SOC or major technology platforms.
  • Experience in competitive deal shaping, transformation programmes, renewals and transition from incumbent providers.
  • Experience creating reusable propositions, reference architectures, estimators or pricing assets.
  • Working knowledge of regulatory, legal, compliance and contractual considerations for managed services.
  • Ability to operate effectively with international stakeholders and support Europe and US working hours when required.
Leadership profile
  • Client-first: listens before designing and anchors the proposition in the clients priorities.
  • Commercially astute: understands that the strongest architecture must also be executable, priceable and competitive.
  • Persuasive: makes complex ideas simple and turns technical capability into business value.
  • Integrative: creates alignment across specialists, geographies, partners and competing priorities.
  • Accountable: owns the quality and integrity of the whole solution, not only an individual component.
  • Composed under pressure: brings structure, pace and judgement to high-value pursuits with incomplete information.
Why this role matters
The Cyber Solutions Architect will directly influence the quality, differentiation and commercial strength of EYs most strategic turnkey cyber services pursuits. The role offers the opportunity to shape major client transformations, work across leading technology ecosystems and build the repeatable solutioning capability of the Cyber Large Deal Engine.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
